title_zh: 研究院​特邀南京农业大学人工智能学院计智伟教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 9 月 22 日上午，南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀南京农业大学人工智能学院计智伟教授来校作学术报告，报告的主题是“ Big data computing, modeling, and application ”。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持报告会，学院教师和研究生线下线上 30 多人参会。
blocks.text_en: On the morning of September 22, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Professor Ji Zhiwei from the School of Artificial Intelligence of Nanjing Agricultural University to give an academic report. The theme of the report was "Big data computing, modeling, and application." Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over the report meeting. More than 30 people, including teachers and graduate students from the school, attended the meeting offline and online.

blocks.text_zh: 计智伟主要从生物分子网络的系统建模方法、复杂生物系统的 3D 多尺度建模、人工智能优化的生物信息计算等三个方面，深入探讨了生物大数据挖掘和系统建模等多组学数据融合分析与计算等问题。在互动环节，与会师生踊跃提问，并就生物分子网络、大数据计算与模式识别、复杂生物系统的建模与预测等与计教授进行了广泛而深入的交流，会场学术气氛浓厚。
blocks.text_en: Ji Zhiwei mainly explored issues such as multi-omics data fusion analysis and calculation such as biological big data mining and system modeling from three aspects: system modeling methods of biomolecular networks, 3D multi-scale modeling of complex biological systems, and biological information computing optimized by artificial intelligence. During the interactive session, participating teachers and students actively asked questions and had extensive and in-depth exchanges with Professor Ji on biomolecular networks, big data computing and pattern recognition, modeling and prediction of complex biological systems, etc. The academic atmosphere at the venue was strong.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院致力于研究与开发医学影像、病理、多组学、电子病历等医疗大数据以及人工智能等信息技术，以辅助医生改善疾病的预防、诊断、治疗和预后。研究院正扎实推进各项工作，促进新工科和新医科融合发展。
blocks.text_en: The Smart Medical Research Institute is committed to researching and developing medical big data such as medical imaging, pathology, multi-omics, and electronic medical records, as well as information technologies such as artificial intelligence to assist doctors in improving disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. The institute is making solid progress in various tasks to promote the integrated development of new engineering and new medical sciences.

blocks.text_zh: 圆桌会议
blocks.text_en: Roundtable

blocks.text_zh: 议 题 ：
blocks.text_en: Topic:

blocks.text_zh: 1. 医学图像人工智能的挑战与未来；
blocks.text_en: 1. Challenges and future of medical image artificial intelligence;

blocks.text_zh: 2. 如何实现病理与传统医学图像融合；
blocks.text_en: 2. How to achieve the fusion of pathology and traditional medical images;

blocks.text_zh: 3. 医工交叉与联邦学习；
blocks.text_en: 3. Medical-industrial intersection and federated learning;

blocks.text_zh: 4. 医疗影像 AI 软件在临床应用中面临的困难、原因及解决办法；
blocks.text_en: 4. Difficulties, causes and solutions faced by medical imaging AI software in clinical applications;

blocks.text_zh: 5. 医学影像分析领域是否需要大规模預训练的基础模型？
blocks.text_en: 5. Does the field of medical image analysis require large-scale pre-trained basic models?

blocks.text_zh: 6. 在很多医学影像分析问题上，很难获取绝对的金标 准，考虑到医生标注的差异性和随机性，如何让医学影像分析算法不受标注误差的影响？
blocks.text_en: 6. In many medical image analysis problems, it is difficult to obtain an absolute gold standard. Considering the variability and randomness of doctors’ annotations, how can the medical image analysis algorithm not be affected by annotation errors?

blocks.text_zh: 7. 如何解决医学影像分析算法换一个中心、换一批数据性能就有可能下降的问题？
blocks.text_en: 7. How to solve the problem that the performance of the medical image analysis algorithm may decrease when changing a center or changing a batch of data?

title_zh: 研究院特邀新加坡A*STAR陈正华研究员来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 11 月 25 日下午，南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡 A*STAR 陈正华研究员来校作学术报告，报告主题为 “Data-Efficient and Model-Efficient Learning for Time- series Data Analytics” 。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，线下、线上参会的教师、研究生及本科生共 30 余人。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of November 25, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited researcher Chen Zhenghua from Singapore A*STAR to the school to give an academic report. The theme of the report was "Data-Efficient and Model-Efficient Learning for Time-series Data Analytics". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. There were more than 30 teachers, graduate students and undergraduates participating offline and online.

blocks.text_zh: 陈正华博士的报告主要从数据高效和模型高效两方面介绍了三种时间序列数据的分析技术：（ 1 ）自监督学习；（ 2 ）领域适应；以及（ 3 ）知识蒸馏。陈博士首先介绍了适用于时间序列的自监督学习框架，不同于图像和 NLP ，该自监督框架引入了时间和上下文对比，更适用于学习未标记时间序列数据的表示。然后，陈博士介绍了时间序列信号在域适应方向的研究，并展示了其团队研发的基准测试评估套件 ADATIME ，该套件为广大科研人员提供了公平、全面的评估不同时间序列域适应的方法。最后，陈博士介绍了一种基于知识蒸馏的异构网络压缩方法，并从算法和计算能源的角度阐述并总结了模型高效的必要性和发展趋势。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Chen Zhenghua’s report mainly introduced three time series data analysis technologies from the aspects of data efficiency and model efficiency: (1) self-supervised learning; (2) domain adaptation; and (3) knowledge distillation. Dr. Chen first introduced a self-supervised learning framework suitable for time series. Different from images and NLP, this self-supervised framework introduces time and context contrast and is more suitable for learning the representation of unlabeled time series data. Then, Dr. Chen introduced the research on domain adaptation of time series signals, and demonstrated the benchmark evaluation suite ADATIME developed by his team, which provides researchers with a fair and comprehensive method to evaluate the domain adaptation of different time series. Finally, Dr. Chen introduced a heterogeneous network compression method based on knowledge distillation, and elaborated and summarized the necessity and development trends of efficient models from the perspectives of algorithms and computational energy.

blocks.text_zh: 在互动环节，与会师生积极踊跃提问，就复杂控制系统、大数据计算与模式识别、深度学习模型的软 - 硬件加速、算法优化等问题与陈博士进行了广泛而深入的交流，会场学术气氛浓厚。
blocks.text_en: During the interactive session, participating teachers and students actively asked questions and had extensive and in-depth exchanges with Dr. Chen on issues such as complex control systems, big data computing and pattern recognition, software-hardware acceleration of deep learning models, and algorithm optimization. The academic atmosphere at the venue was strong.

blocks.text_zh: 陈正华博士简介：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Dr. Chen Zhenghua:

blocks.alt_zh: 研究院特邀新加坡A*STAR陈正华研究员来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 陈正华博士分别在电子科技大学和新加坡南洋理工大学获得学士和博士学位。目前担任新加坡科技研究局（ A*STAR ）研究科学家、 PI 、实验室主任和博士生导师。研究领域为小数据和小模型深度学习及其在物联网数据分析中的应用。近年来发表 90 余篇顶级期刊和会议论文（包括顶级期刊 IEEE TNNLS 、 Tcyber 、 TIE 、 TII 和 CCF A 类会议 AAAI 、 IJCAI 、 ICCV 、 NeurIPS 等）、其中 5 篇论文入选 ESI 高被引论文、 1 篇论文入选 ESI 热点论文、 1 篇论文入选中国百篇最具影响力国际学术论文；以第一作者编写英文专著一部（ World Scientific 出版、亚马逊在售）；论文谷歌学术引用 5000+ ；主持或共同主持 10 项新加坡国家研究基金会项目，总项目经费超 6000 万人民币；受邀担任中科院二区期刊 Neurocomputing 和 IEEE TIM 副主编和中科院一区期刊 IEEE JAS 青年编委；连续三年（ 2020 、 2021 和 2022 ）入选全球前 2% 顶尖科学家（斯坦福大学发布）、曾荣获 A*STAR 职业发展奖 (Career Development Award) 、 CCF A 类会议 CVPR 2021 UG2+ 挑战赛冠军、 IEEE 会议最佳论文提名奖等；目前担任 IEEE 传感器学会新加坡分部副主席（ 2023 年起担任主席）和 IEEE 高级会员。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Chen Zhenghua received his bachelor's and doctorate degrees from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and Nanyang Technological University, Singapore respectively. Currently serving as a research scientist, PI, laboratory director and doctoral supervisor at the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) in Singapore. The research field is small data and small model deep learning and its application in Internet of Things data analysis. In recent years, he has published more than 90 papers in top journals and conferences (including top journals IEEE TNNLS, Tcyber, TIE, TII and CCF Class A conferences AAAI, IJCAI, ICCV, NeurIPS, etc.), of which 5 papers were selected as ESI Highly Cited Papers, 1 paper was selected as ESI Hot Paper, and 1 paper was selected as one of the 100 Most Influential International Academic Papers in China; he wrote an English monograph (World) as the first author Scientific Publishing, available on Amazon); 5,000+ Google Scholar citations for papers; Hosted or co-hosted 10 Singapore National Research Foundation projects, with total project funding exceeding RMB 60 million; Invited to serve as deputy editor-in-chief of Neurocomputing and IEEE TIM, the journals of the second region of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and IEEE JAS Youth Editorial Board of the journals of the first region of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; selected into the top 2% in the world for three consecutive years (2020, 2021 and 2022) Top scientist (published by Stanford University), has won the A*STAR Career Development Award, CCF Class A conference CVPR 2021 UG2+ Challenge Champion, IEEE Conference Best Paper Nomination Award, etc.; currently serves as the Vice Chairman of the Singapore Branch of the IEEE Sensor Society (chairman from 2023) and a senior member of IEEE.

title_zh: 徐军教授入选人工智能与图像处理全球前2%顶尖科学家榜单

blocks.text_zh: 2022 年 10 月 10 日，由斯坦福大学 John P.A.Ioannidis 教授团队发布的全球前 2% 顶尖科学家榜单更新了 2022 年版本。智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授入选美国斯坦福大学全球前 2% 顶尖科学家榜单。入选的两个研究领域分别为： 1. 人工智能与图像处理 (Artificial Intelligence & Image Processing) ， 2. 核医学与医学成像 (Nuclear Medicine & Medical Imaging)。
blocks.text_en: On October 10, 2022, the list of the top 2% of the world's top scientists released by the team of Professor John P.A. Ioannidis of Stanford University was updated to the 2022 version. Professor Xu Jun, executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute, was selected into the list of the top 2% of the world's top scientists at Stanford University in the United States. The two selected research fields are: 1. Artificial Intelligence & Image Processing, 2. Nuclear Medicine & Medical Imaging.

blocks.text_zh: 美国斯坦福大学全球前 2% 顶尖科学家榜单是 Elsevier 和斯坦福大学 John P. A. Ioannidis 教授团队合作的具有全球影响力的项目成果，为全球学术界提供了一个面向科学家长期科研表现的衡量指标，旨在更客观、更真实地反映科学家全球影响力。榜单以 Scopus 数据库为依据，使用了如下六种关键因素的指标来进行打分： 1 )总引用量； 2 ) Hirsch H-index ； 3 )共同作者修正的 Schreiber Hm-index ； 4 )单独作者； 5 )单独或者第一作者； 6 )单独、第一或者最后作者的文章引用量，根据其 “ 生涯影响力 ” 和 “ 年度影响力 ” ，从 22 个领域和 176 个子领域，近 700 万名科学家中遴选出世界排名前 2% 的科学家。本次榜单 统计数据时间节点为 1960-2022 年，涵盖全球 200,409 位科学家。分为 “ 终身科学影响力排行榜（ 1960-2022 ） ” 和 “2022 年度科学影响力排行榜 ” 两个榜单。
blocks.text_en: The list of the top 2% of the world's top scientists at Stanford University in the United States is the result of a globally influential project jointly conducted by Elsevier and the team of Professor John P. A. Ioannidis of Stanford University. It provides the global academic community with a measure of scientists' long-term scientific research performance, aiming to reflect scientists' global influence more objectively and truly. The list is based on the Scopus database and uses the following six key factors for scoring: 1) Total citations; 2) Hirsch H-index; 3) Schreiber Hm-index modified by co-authors; 4) Sole author; 5) Sole or first author; 6) The number of citations of articles of the sole, first or last author, based on their "career influence" and "annual influence", from 22 fields and 176 In each subfield, the top 2% of scientists in the world are selected from nearly 7 million scientists. The statistical time node of this list is from 1960 to 2022, covering 200,409 scientists around the world. It is divided into two lists: "Lifetime Scientific Influence Ranking (1960-2022)" and "2022 Scientific Influence Ranking".

blocks.text_zh: 从2022年前2%科学家国家分布来看，全球具有最多影响力科学家的国家仍为美国( 占全球 39.88%)、英国( 占全球 9.29%)和德国( 占全球 5.49%)。 标注中国大陆（CHN）的科学家7795名(占全球3.99%)，比第三版增加852人，超过日本， 在全球排第五位， 日本排名从第五降为第六；印度维持第十四；韩国排名维持第十七。 亚洲国家的排名依次为大陆、日本、印度、韩国。
blocks.text_en: Judging from the country distribution of the top 2% of scientists in 2022, the countries with the most influential scientists in the world are still the United States (accounting for 39.88% of the world), the United Kingdom (accounting for 9.29% of the world) and Germany (accounting for 5.49% of the world). There are 7,795 scientists labeled as Mainland China (CHN) (accounting for 3.99% of the world), an increase of 852 compared to the third edition, surpassing Japan and ranking fifth in the world. Japan's ranking dropped from fifth to sixth; India remained at 14th; South Korea remained at 17th. The ranking of Asian countries is mainland China, Japan, India, and South Korea.

title_zh: 祝贺鲁浩达同学顺利通过博士学位论文答辩

blocks.text_zh: 2023 年 1 月 10 日上午，智慧医疗研究院的鲁浩达同学顺利通过了题为《基于组织形态学分析的小鼠生精管自动分期》博士学位论文答辩。答辩委员会成员包括东南大学计算机科学与工程学院陈阳教授，新加坡科技局（ A*Star ）生物信息研究所余维淼教授，南京大学鼓楼医院病理科樊祥山教授，美国西北大学医学院生殖科学研究中心、南京医科大学生殖医学国家重点实验室徐宇君教授，东北大学医学与生物信息工程学院李晨教授，南京信息工程大学计算机学院付章杰教授、袁晓彤教授，南京信息工程大学人工智能学院（未来技术学院）王向学副教授，由陈阳教授任答辩主席。焦一平老师为答辩秘书。答辩委员会委员的背景跨越了临床医学、生殖医学、生物医学、计算机、人工智能等多个学科，委员来自中国、美国、新加坡共三个国家。鲁浩达同学博士论文答辩完成，标志着智慧医疗研究院在生殖医学领域的研究进入了新的阶段。
blocks.text_en: On the morning of January 10, 2023, Lu Haoda from the Smart Medical Research Institute successfully passed the defense of his doctoral thesis entitled "Automatic staging of mouse seminiferous ducts based on histomorphological analysis". Members of the defense committee include Professor Chen Yang from the School of Computer Science and Engineering of Southeast University, Professor from the Singapore Science and Technology Agency (A*Star) ) Professor Yu Weimiao from the Institute of Bioinformatics, Professor Fan Xiangshan from the Pathology Department of Nanjing University Drum Tower Hospital, Professor Xu Yujun from the Reproductive Science Research Center of Northwestern University School of Medicine and the State Key Laboratory of Reproductive Medicine at Nanjing Medical University, Professor Li Chen from the School of Medicine and Bioinformatics Engineering at Northeastern University, Professor Fu Zhangjie and Professor Yuan Xiaotong from the School of Computer Science at Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, and Associate Professor Wang Xiangxue from the School of Artificial Intelligence (School of Future Technology) at Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology. Professor Chen Yang served as the defense chair. Teacher Jiao Yiping is the defense secretary. The backgrounds of the defense committee members span across multiple disciplines such as clinical medicine, reproductive medicine, biomedicine, computer science, and artificial intelligence. The members come from three countries: China, the United States, and Singapore. The completion of Lu Haoda's doctoral thesis defense marks that the Smart Medical Research Institute's research in the field of reproductive medicine has entered a new stage.

blocks.alt_zh: 祝贺鲁浩达同学顺利通过博士学位论文答辩

blocks.text_zh: 答辩海报
blocks.text_en: Defense poster

blocks.text_zh: 鲁浩达同学的博士学位论文针对 H&E 染色的小鼠生精管图像，首次建立了基于组织形态学的精细智能分期系统，主要的工作包括：
blocks.text_en: Lu Haoda’s doctoral thesis established for the first time a sophisticated intelligent staging system based on histological morphology based on H&E stained mouse seminiferous duct images. The main work includes:

blocks.text_zh: 1 、作为精细分期系统的基础，针对生精管分割、初始分期语义分割、多类型生殖细胞分割等问题，提出了边缘重叠滑窗、多尺度学习、多任务学习等策略，有效提升了各任务的分割性能、鲁棒性与泛化性；
blocks.text_en: 1. As the basis of the fine staging system, strategies such as edge overlapping sliding windows, multi-scale learning, and multi-task learning are proposed to address issues such as seminiferous duct segmentation, initial staging semantic segmentation, and multi-type germ cell segmentation, which effectively improve the segmentation performance, robustness, and generalization of each task;

blocks.text_zh: 2 、针对生精管早期、中期、晚期各组内的精细分期问题，利用组织病理学形态的先验知识，提取细胞形态学、空间拓扑结构、细胞方向与纹理等丰富量化特征，并结合特征选择算法与机器学习模型实现自动分期，其分期准确度已经达到了具有五年从业经验的病理医生水平。
blocks.text_en: 2. Aiming at the problem of fine staging within each group of early, middle and late seminiferous ducts, we use prior knowledge of histopathological morphology to extract rich quantitative features such as cell morphology, spatial topology, cell direction and texture, and combine feature selection algorithms and machine learning models to achieve automatic staging. The staging accuracy has reached the level of a pathologist with five years of experience.

blocks.text_zh: 3 、在具体的精细分期问题中，引入了 DtG 滤波器、病理无关与病理相关的自监督辅助任务、纹理特征可视化、 Grad-CAM 等技术，有效提升了分期系统的精度与可解释性。
blocks.text_en: 3. In specific fine staging problems, DtG filters, pathology-independent and pathology-related self-supervised auxiliary tasks, texture feature visualization, Grad-CAM and other technologies are introduced to effectively improve the accuracy and interpretability of the staging system.

blocks.alt_zh: 祝贺鲁浩达同学顺利通过博士学位论文答辩

blocks.text_zh: 鲁浩达博士论文篇章结构
blocks.text_en: Chapter structure of Lu Haoda's doctoral thesis

blocks.text_zh: 该精细分期系统可用于辅助生殖医学领域展开针对生精管发育缺陷导致的雄性不育问题的定量化研究，也为其他计算病理研究提供了新的解决思路。未来将进一步针对基因缺陷小鼠的生精管展开研究，以探寻生精发育缺陷背后的复杂机制。
blocks.text_en: This fine staging system can be used in the field of assisted reproductive medicine to conduct quantitative research on male infertility problems caused by defects in seminiferous duct development, and also provides new solutions for other computational pathology studies. In the future, further research will be conducted on the seminiferous ducts of genetically defective mice to explore the complex mechanisms behind spermatogenic development defects.

blocks.text_zh: 研究院关于生精管切片分析的工作起源于 2017 年初，智慧医疗研究院徐军教授和南京医科大学生殖医学国家重点实验室徐宇君教授在一次学术会议中的偶然交流，促成了这一项合作。该系列工作 首次 基于组织形态学定量分析建立了小鼠睾丸常规 H&E 切片的智能生精管自动分期系统。目前计算病理领域的工作多数聚焦于肿瘤病理，本工作面向非肿瘤病理，具有很大的挑战性，很多技术路线均为首次尝试，也是生精管组织病理图像分析方面的开创性工作。与目前基于荧光成像的分析方法相比，该工作面向常规 H&E 切片，具有更好的实用性和推广性，但其技术难度陡增。
blocks.text_en: The institute's work on seminiferous duct section analysis originated in early 2017. Professor Xu Jun from the Smart Medical Research Institute and Professor Xu Yujun from the State Key Laboratory of Reproductive Medicine at Nanjing Medical University had an accidental exchange at an academic conference, which led to this cooperation. This series of work is the first to establish an intelligent seminiferous duct automatic staging system for conventional H&E sections of mouse testicles based on quantitative histomorphological analysis. At present, most work in the field of computational pathology focuses on tumor pathology. This work is oriented to non-tumor pathology and is very challenging. Many technical routes are attempted for the first time. It is also a pioneering work in pathological image analysis of seminiferous duct tissue. Compared with current analysis methods based on fluorescence imaging, this work is oriented to conventional H&E sections and has better practicability and generalizability, but its technical difficulty increases sharply.

blocks.text_zh: 鲁浩达同学经过 5 年多的刻苦研究与持之以恒的努力，克服了诸多困难，成功建立了基于 H&E 的小鼠生精管自动分析系统。这一系列工作得到了美国 UIUC 男性生殖病理学著名专家 Rex A Hess 、俄勒冈州健康与科学大学男性不育遗传分析领域著名学者 Don Conrad 教授团队等关注，论文发表后得到了美国麻省理工学院 - 哈佛 MIT-Harvad 多学科融合研究所，麻省理工电气工程与计算机系、数据科学系、哈佛大学病理系、生物统计系、麻省总医院精神病学系、哈佛大学干细胞与再生生物学系、俄勒冈州健康与科学大学美国国家灵长类动物研究中心（美国七大联邦资助的国家研究中心之一）遗传学系、匈牙利 Semmelweis 大学妇产科系、病理系、心理系等多学科专家的共同关注和引用。
blocks.text_en: After more than 5 years of hard research and perseverance, Lu Haoda overcame many difficulties and successfully established an automatic analysis system for mouse seminiferous ducts based on H&E. This series of work has attracted the attention of Rex A Hess, a famous expert in male reproductive pathology at UIUC in the United States, and the team of Professor Don Conrad, a famous scholar in the field of male infertility genetic analysis at Oregon Health and Science University. After the paper was published, it received MIT-Harvad Multidisciplinary Institute of Integration, MIT Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Department of Data Science, Department of Pathology and Department of Biostatistics of Harvard University, Department of Psychiatry at Massachusetts General Hospital, Department of Stem Cell and Regenerative Biology at Harvard University, Department of Genetics at the National Primate Research Center (one of the seven federally funded national research centers in the United States) at Oregon Health and Science University, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Department of Pathology, Department of Psychology, Semmelweis University in Hungary, and other multidisciplinary experts.

blocks.text_zh: 南京医科大学生殖医学国家重点实验室 & 美国西北大学医学院 徐宇君教授
blocks.text_en: State Key Laboratory of Reproductive Medicine, Nanjing Medical University & Professor Xu Yujun, Northwestern University School of Medicine

blocks.text_zh: 鲁浩达博士论文的完成得到了很多学者的帮助和支持，首先是徐宇君教授及其团队的长期支持。徐宇君教授是江苏省特聘教授、南京医科大学特聘教授；美国西北大学妇产科和精神病及行为科学系兼职教授，江苏省科技创新男性生殖医学团队领军人才，博士生导师，是雄性生殖发育领域著名学者。徐宇君教授致力于研究哺乳动物的生殖发育和干细胞的调控机制，尤其是高度保守的的根本性机理和在生殖相关疾病作用的转化医学研究。前期通过对于动物界生殖细胞发育发生的比较生物学和基因组学分析，发现存在高度保守的调控配子发生的核心机器和组成成分，其中包括最常见的致男性不育的 DAZ 基因家族。目前正通过基因敲除和转基因动物模型（小鼠，果蝇）深入研究 DAZ 家族及其它核心成员的功能，解析其在生殖发育和干细胞维持及分化中的作用机理。
blocks.text_en: The completion of Lu Haoda's doctoral thesis received help and support from many scholars, first of all, the long-term support of Professor Xu Yujun and his team. Professor Xu Yujun is a Distinguished Professor of Jiangsu Province and a Distinguished Professor of Nanjing Medical University; an adjunct professor of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology and Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences of Northwestern University; a leading talent in the scientific and technological innovation male reproductive medicine team of Jiangsu Province; a doctoral supervisor; and a well-known scholar in the field of male reproductive development. Professor Xu Yujun is committed to studying mammalian reproductive development and the regulatory mechanisms of stem cells, especially the highly conserved fundamental mechanisms and translational medical research on the role of reproductive-related diseases. Through comparative biology and genomic analysis of germ cell development in the animal kingdom, it was discovered that there are highly conserved core machines and components that regulate gametogenesis, including the DAZ gene family, the most common cause of male infertility. Currently, the functions of the DAZ family and other core members are being studied in depth through gene knockout and transgenic animal models (mouse, Drosophila), and their mechanisms of action in reproductive development and stem cell maintenance and differentiation are being analyzed.

blocks.text_zh: 荷兰乌得勒支大学 & 阿姆斯特丹大学 Rooij D.G. de Dirk 教授
blocks.text_en: Professor Rooij D.G. de Dirk, University of Utrecht & University of Amsterdam, Netherlands

blocks.text_zh: 该工作还得到了荷兰乌得勒支大学 &阿姆斯特丹大学的Dirk教授的帮助和支持，Dirk教授是常规H&E染色小鼠睾丸病理分期领域全球范围内最权威的学者，70多岁高龄的他对工作的认真和执着让我们都非常敬佩，他愿意把自己毕生积累的基于常规H&E染色病理切片的生精管分期的经验知识用于AI模型的训练。尽管已经退休，他仍然愿意从头开始学习使用病理标注软件，不厌其烦地对大量生精管一一仔细检查并标记分期，为模型的构建提供了极其宝贵的训练数据。病理是一个“高冷”的领域，目前 基于常规H&E染色病理切片精确区分生精管I-XII期发育阶段的专家很少，特别是在没有PAS染色辅助的情况下，仅仅基于常规H&E切片精准识别I-XII期难度极大。Dirk教授是该领域全球少有的几位权威专家，没有他的专业数据标注研究院在这个领域的一系列研究将难以开展。也正因此，研究中使用的用于训练模型的标注数据包含了Dirk教授分析生精管分期长期积累的经验和知识。
blocks.text_en: This work also received the help and support of Professor Dirk from Utrecht University and the University of Amsterdam in the Netherlands. Professor Dirk is the most authoritative scholar in the world in the field of conventional H&E stained mouse testicular pathological staging. We all admire his seriousness and persistence in his work in his 70s. He is willing to use his lifelong accumulated experience and knowledge of seminiferous duct staging based on conventional H&E stained pathological sections for the training of the AI model. Although he has retired, he is still willing to learn to use pathological annotation software from scratch, and takes the trouble to carefully examine and mark the stages of a large number of seminiferous ducts one by one, providing extremely valuable training data for the construction of the model. Pathology is a "cold" field. Currently, there are very few experts who can accurately distinguish the development stages of seminiferous ducts I-XII based on conventional H&E stained pathological sections. Especially without the assistance of PAS staining, it is extremely difficult to accurately identify stages I-XII based only on conventional H&E sections. Professor Dirk is one of the few authoritative experts in this field in the world. Without his professional data annotation institute, it would be difficult to carry out a series of research in this field. For this reason, the annotated data used to train the model in the study contains Professor Dirk’s long-term accumulated experience and knowledge in analyzing the staging of seminiferous ducts.

blocks.text_zh: 此外，本工作的顺利开展也离不开美国埃默里大学 & 佐治亚理工大学 Anant Madabhushi 教授和新加坡科技局 (A*Star) 余维淼教授在不同阶段的点拨和支持。研究院对各位专家学者的全力支持深表感谢，并期待更深入、更广泛的合作。
blocks.text_en: In addition, the smooth development of this work would not have been possible without the guidance and support at different stages from Professor Anant Madabhushi of Emory University & Georgia Tech University and Professor Yu Weimiao of the Agency for Science and Technology of Singapore (A*Star). The institute expresses its deep gratitude to all experts and scholars for their full support and looks forward to deeper and broader cooperation.

blocks.text_zh: 鲁浩达同学先后毕业于南京信息工程大学自动化专业、系统科学专业，获工学学士、理学硕士学位，并于 2018 年推免进入南京信息工程大学电子与信息工程学院，攻读信息与通信工程专业博士学位，导师为徐军教授，主要研究方向为组织病理图像计算。期间，获国家留学基金委资助赴新加坡南洋理工大学进行联合培养一年。鲁浩达同学攻读博士学位期间，以一作或共同一作发表 SCI 一区论文两篇， SCI 二区、三区、北大核心论文若干，参与多项国家自然科学基金项目并多次获得奖学金与挑战赛奖项。 答辩委员会和研究院师生向鲁浩达同学表示热烈祝贺！
blocks.text_en: Lu Haoda graduated from Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, majoring in automation and system science, with a bachelor's degree in engineering and a master's degree in science. In 2018, he was recommended to enter the School of Electronics and Information Engineering, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, to study for a doctorate in information and communication engineering. His supervisor is Professor Xu Jun, and his main research direction is histopathological image calculation. During this period, he was funded by the China Scholarship Council to conduct joint training at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore for one year. During Lu Haoda's doctoral studies, he published two SCI Area 1 papers as the author or co-author, several SCI Area 2, 3, and Peking University core papers. He participated in many National Natural Science Foundation projects and won many scholarships and challenge awards. The defense committee and teachers and students of the graduate school extend warm congratulations to Lu Haoda!

blocks.text_zh: 该工作首次基于常规 H&E 切片的组织形态学分析构建了小鼠睾丸精子 12 个发育阶段的自动分期系统。从技术上，该工作基于 H&E 切片，在不依赖 PAS 染色的情况下分析难度较大。该工作针对高分辨率全景切片，开发了用于生精管的分割、多类精子细胞和多个病理同心层区域的精准识别的深度学习系统。该研究在数据标注等阶段得到了 Dirk 教授的全力支持。在研究过程中，为了描述生精管独特的病理结构以及细胞层面的细微特征，论文尝试并对比了大量方案，最终获得成功。这项工作凝聚了十多名学者与研究生多年的努力，研究人员跨越生物、医学、病理、工程多领域和中国，欧洲（荷兰），美国三个国家 / 地区。跨学科与跨国家的深入合作促成了本项研究，各个环节都具有至关重要的作用。
blocks.text_en: This work is the first to construct an automated staging system for 12 developmental stages of mouse testicular sperm based on histomorphological analysis of conventional H&E sections. Technically, this work is based on H&E sections, which are difficult to analyze without relying on PAS staining. This work developed a deep learning system for the segmentation of seminiferous ducts, accurate identification of multiple types of sperm cells and multiple pathological concentric layer regions for high-resolution panoramic slices. This research received full support from Professor Dirk in the data annotation and other stages. During the research process, in order to describe the unique pathological structure of the seminiferous tubules and the subtle characteristics at the cellular level, the paper tried and compared a large number of solutions, and finally succeeded. This work embodies the efforts of more than a dozen scholars and graduate students over many years. The researchers span the fields of biology, medicine, pathology, and engineering, as well as three countries/regions: China, Europe (Netherlands), and the United States. In-depth cross-disciplinary and cross-country collaboration contributed to this research, with all links playing a crucial role.

blocks.text_zh: 论文的创新点包括： 1 、运用了“人在回路”的思想，通过组织学专家与深度学习模型的交互式学习模式，实现了以更少的标注数据完成较困难的四种类型生精细胞（精原细胞、精母细胞、圆形精子、支持细胞）全自动分割，有效提升了模型的性能； 2 、建立了面向大规模组织切片四种生精细胞的定量分析特征描述系统， 3 、基于定量特征定量揭示生精管在 I-XII 发育阶段四种生精细胞的变化规律和趋势。 4 、针对生精管分析问题，建立了由多个深度学习模型组成的分析系统。四种生精细胞在 I-XII 发育阶段处在漫长的动态变化中，而人工能够标记的细胞仅有“沧海一粟”，描述这一连续而动态的变化过程极具挑战性。在此方面，未来可继续探索新的分析框架与机器学习模型。
blocks.text_en: The innovation points of the paper include: 1. Using the idea of "people in the loop", through the interactive learning mode of histology experts and deep learning models, it is possible to complete the fully automatic segmentation of the four difficult types of spermatogenic cells (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, round spermatozoa, supporting cells) with less annotated data, effectively improving the performance of the model; 2. Establishing a quantitative analysis feature description system for four types of spermatogenic cells in large-scale tissue sections, 3. Quantitatively revealing the presence of seminiferous ducts in I-XII based on quantitative features Change patterns and trends of four types of spermatogenic cells during developmental stages. 4. Aiming at the problem of seminiferous duct analysis, an analysis system composed of multiple deep learning models was established. The four types of spermatogenic cells undergo long and dynamic changes in developmental stages I-XII, and the number of cells that can be artificially labeled is only "a drop in the ocean." It is extremely challenging to describe this continuous and dynamic change process. In this regard, new analysis frameworks and machine learning models can continue to be explored in the future.

blocks.text_zh: 区分小鼠生精上皮周期的 12 个发育阶段对于理解动态精子发生过程非常重要，例如野生型小鼠与不育小鼠在 I-III 期和 IV-V 期具有关键性的区别。然而，由于相邻生精阶段在形态学上的相似性，各分期的精确区分极具挑战性。为此，本文提出了一种新颖的自动方法用于精子发生分期 (CSS) 的研究。 CSS 模型包括四个部分： (i) 用于提取与分割每一个生精小管的曲细精管分割模型； (ii) 基于多尺度学习 (MSL) 方法整合曲细精管的局部和全局信息，以区分 I-V 期和 VI-XII 期； (iii) 基于多任务学习 (MTL) 方法克服训练数据有限的困难，实现了 I-V 阶段的精细分期； (iv) 建立了由 204 维图像特征构成的描述系统，基于细胞级和图像级特征区分 I-III 期和 IV-V 期生精管。实验结果表明，使用本文所提出的 MSL 和 MTL 相结合的方案，在人工标注较为有限时其表现显著优于经典的单尺度和单任务模型。此外，研究发现部分图像特征在 I-III 期和 IV-V 期之间具有区别性，与病理学先验知识相符。总结而言， CSS 模型不仅可以为组织学家提供解决方案，便于对精子发生阶段进行定量分析识别，也能够帮助他们发现新的计算机化图像的生物标志物。
blocks.text_en: Distinguishing the 12 developmental stages of the mouse seminiferous epithelial cycle is important for understanding the dynamic spermatogenesis process, such as the critical differences between wild-type and infertile mice in stages I-III and IV-V. However, precise differentiation of the stages is extremely challenging due to the morphological similarities between adjacent spermatogenic stages. To this end, this article proposes a novel automated method for the study of spermatogenesis staging (CSS). The CSS model includes four parts: (i) a seminiferous tubule segmentation model for extracting and segmenting each seminiferous tubule; (ii) based on the multi-scale learning (MSL) method to integrate local and global information of the seminiferous tubules to distinguish stages I-V and VI-XII; (iii) based on the multi-task learning (MTL) method to overcome the difficulty of limited training data and achieve fine staging of I-V stages; (iv) established by 204 A description system composed of three-dimensional image features, which distinguishes stage I-III and stage IV-V seminiferous ducts based on cell-level and image-level features. Experimental results show that using the combined MSL and MTL solution proposed in this article, its performance is significantly better than the classic single-scale and single-task models when manual annotation is limited. Furthermore, some image features were found to be distinctive between stages I-III and IV-V, consistent with prior knowledge of pathology. In summary, the CSS model can not only provide a solution for histologists to facilitate quantitative analysis and identification of spermatogenesis stages, but also help them discover new biomarkers from computerized images.

title_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of March 6, 2023, at the invitation of Professor Yu Weimiao from the Institute of Bioinformatics of the Singapore Institute of Technology, Professor Xu Jun, Executive Director of the Smart Medical Research Institute, visited the Institute of Bioinformatics and was invited to give an academic report titled "Computational radiology and pathology for disease prevention, diagnosis, and prognosis" at the Institute of Bioinformatics.

blocks.alt_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 报告主要围绕智慧医疗研究院正在开展的以机器学习驱动的放射影像学和组织学图像分析及影像和组织病理等多模态多尺度数据融合等相关研究成果的讨论。放射影像学和常规组织病理学切片图像中包含很多有价值的临床诊断、治疗和预后等信息。随着先进的医学图像分析和高分辨率数字病理扫及成像技术的快速发展，我们可以更方便地从放射影像学和常规组织病理学图像中获得疾病的多尺度图像生物标记物描述，例如毫米尺度和微米尺度的图像表型描述，其中很多是人眼无法区分的图像模式。通过定量地获取这些疾病的图像模式和表型描述，我们可以构建模型辅助医生更准确地检测和诊断疾病，并尝试评估或预测疾病的复发风险、疾病侵袭性程度、长期生存率以及患者对治疗的响应。近10多年来，智慧医疗研究院团队一直致力于机器学习驱动的放射影像学和组织学图像分析工具的研究和开发，通过构建基于放射影像和组织学图像的“图像生物标记物”模型，期望未来能够更好地辅助医生实现疾病的预防、诊断和预测疾病进展以及对患者对治疗的响应。
blocks.text_en: The report mainly focuses on the discussion of related research results being carried out by the Smart Medical Research Institute on machine learning-driven radiology and histology image analysis and multi-modal and multi-scale data fusion of imaging and histopathology. Radiographic imaging and conventional histopathological section images contain a lot of valuable information for clinical diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. With the rapid development of advanced medical image analysis and high-resolution digital pathology scanning and imaging technology, we can more easily obtain multi-scale image biomarker descriptions of diseases from radiological imaging and conventional histopathology images, such as millimeter-scale and micron-scale image phenotype descriptions, many of which are image patterns that are indistinguishable to the human eye. By quantitatively obtaining image patterns and phenotypic descriptions of these diseases, we can build models to assist doctors in detecting and diagnosing the disease more accurately, and try to assess or predict the risk of disease recurrence, disease aggressiveness, long-term survival, and patient response to treatment. For more than 10 years, the Smart Medical Research Institute team has been committed to the research and development of machine learning-driven radiological imaging and histological image analysis tools. By building an "image biomarker" model based on radiological imaging and histological images, it is expected that in the future it can better assist doctors in preventing, diagnosing and predicting disease progression as well as patient response to treatment.

blocks.alt_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 报告中徐军介绍了研究院近期发表的相关研究成果，主要包括：1）基于肝脏CT影像组学模型预测肝细胞癌的微血管浸润，2）慢性粒细胞白血病的计算机辅助诊断，3）胆管癌患者肿瘤微环境的定量分析和生存预测，4）非小型细胞肺癌患者对免疫治疗的响应预测，5）基于乳腺组织学图像定量分析的三阴性乳腺癌亚型分类和预后分析，以及 6）小鼠曲细生精管分期及细胞组成成分分析。最后，徐军还介绍了智慧医疗研究院的医工团队情况及研究领域。
blocks.text_en: In the report, Xu Jun introduced the relevant research results recently published by the institute, which mainly include: 1) prediction of microvascular infiltration of hepatocellular carcinoma based on liver CT radiomics model, 2) computer-aided diagnosis of chronic myelogenous leukemia, 3) quantitative analysis of tumor microenvironment and survival prediction of cholangiocarcinoma patients, 4) prediction of response to immunotherapy in patients with non-small cell lung cancer, 5) triple-negative breast cancer subtype classification and prognosis analysis based on quantitative analysis of breast histology images, and 6) Staging and cell composition analysis of mouse seminiferous tubules. Finally, Xu Jun also introduced the medical team and research fields of the Smart Medical Research Institute.

blocks.alt_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 本次学术报告由新加科技局生物信息研究所余维淼教授主持，旨在聚焦双方感兴趣的领域，进一步加强两个单位教师和学生的相互了解，深入合作和交流。在问答与互动环节，与会人员与徐军进行了广泛深入地讨论和交流。 最后， 生物信息研究所 Kwee Kuan教授对报告做了总结。 本次学术报告的参会人员 除了新加坡科技局本单位的研究人员外，还包括华大基因，默沙东等全球领先的医药公司的研究人员。报告采用了线下线上混合的方式，其中线下参会人员40多人，线上30多人。
blocks.text_en: This academic report was hosted by Professor Yu Weimiao from the Institute of Bioinformatics of the Singapore Institute of Science and Technology. It aimed to focus on areas of interest to both parties, further strengthen mutual understanding between teachers and students of the two units, and in-depth cooperation and exchanges. During the Q&A and interactive session, the participants had extensive and in-depth discussions and exchanges with Xu Jun. Finally, Professor Kwee Kuan from the Institute of Bioinformatics summarized the report. In addition to researchers from the Singapore Science and Technology Agency, participants in this academic report also include researchers from the world's leading pharmaceutical companies such as BGI and Merck. The report adopted a mixed offline and online approach, with more than 40 offline participants and more than 30 online participants.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院和 新加坡科技局生物信息研究所在人才培养、科学研究等方面已经开展了多年的合作。目前在计算病理、前列腺癌智能自动Gleason分级、小鼠生精管自动分期等方面已经合作发表了多篇高水平论文。此次报告也是疫情之后，中新双方团队的第一次面对面交流。双方计划在科研项目联合申请，教师的交流与合作，硕士、博士等高层次人才培养方面进一步加强合作。
blocks.text_en: The Smart Medical Research Institute and the Institute of Bioinformatics of the Singapore Science and Technology Agency have cooperated for many years in talent training and scientific research. Currently, many high-level papers have been jointly published in areas such as computational pathology, intelligent automatic Gleason grading of prostate cancer, and automatic staging of mouse seminiferous ducts. This report is also the first face-to-face communication between the Chinese and New Zealand teams after the epidemic. The two parties plan to further strengthen cooperation in joint applications for scientific research projects, teacher exchanges and cooperation, and the training of high-level talents such as masters and doctoral students.

blocks.text_en: Further reading

blocks.text_zh: 新加坡科技研究局（ A gency for S cience, T echnology and R esearch；简写为 A*STAR ）， 是新加坡贸易和工业部下属的自治研究机构，其前身是成立于1991年的新加坡科学技术局。A*STAR成立的目标是促进新加坡科研和人才的整合，以协助新加坡向知识型经济体转型和迈进。其下属研究院分两个分支：生物医药研究和科学工程研究，各自统领若干下属研究所，开展相关方面的科学研究。还直辖交叉学科整合理事会、研究生学院、速创科技私人有限公司，以及企业公共事务服务部门，以达到各个研究所的资源共享。A*STAR是新加坡研究团体中重要的催化剂、推动者和召集者。通过开放式创新，A*STAR与公共和私营部门的合作伙伴进行合作，并利用科学技术使经济和社会受益。 生物信息学研究所 (Bioinformatics Institute, BII) 隶属A*STAR生物医药研究理事会，于 2001 年 7 月成立。BII位于新加坡的Biopolis街道，是A*STAR的计算生物学研究机构，同时也是国家生物信息学资源中心。BII旨在通过开发人工智能/机器学习分析方法来理解生物医学现象背后的生物分子机制。BII广泛地分析生物学和临床数据，包括组学数据（生物分子序列、表达谱、表观遗传学数据）、大分子的 3D 结构。BII的应用研究涉及传染病、计算病理、天然产物研究、精准医学、癌症研究和药物发现。
blocks.text_en: The Agency for Science, Technology and Research (abbreviated as A*STAR) is an autonomous research agency under the Ministry of Trade and Industry of Singapore. Its predecessor was the Science and Technology Agency of Singapore established in 1991. The goal of A*STAR is to promote the integration of scientific research and talent in Singapore to assist Singapore in its transformation and advancement into a knowledge-based economy. Its affiliated research institutes are divided into two branches: biomedical research and scientific engineering research, each of which leads a number of affiliated research institutes to carry out scientific research in related fields. It also directly governs the Interdisciplinary Integration Council, the Graduate School, Sutron Technology Pte Ltd, and the Corporate Public Affairs Service Department to achieve resource sharing among various institutes. A*STAR is an important catalyst, promoter and convener of the Singapore research community. Through open innovation, A*STAR collaborates with public and private sector partners and uses science and technology to benefit the economy and society. The Bioinformatics Institute (BII) is affiliated to the A*STAR Biomedical Research Council and was established in July 2001. Located in Biopolis Street, Singapore, BII is A*STAR's computational biology research institution and the National Bioinformatics Resource Center. BII aims to understand the biomolecular mechanisms behind biomedical phenomena by developing artificial intelligence/machine learning analysis methods. BII extensively analyzes biological and clinical data, including omics data (biomolecule sequences, expression profiles, epigenetic data), and 3D structures of macromolecules. BII's applied research involves infectious diseases, computational pathology, natural product research, precision medicine, cancer research and drug discovery.

title_zh: 特邀新加坡南洋理工大学刘琳波教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 3月3日下午，南京信息工程大学-中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡南洋理工大学刘琳波教授来校作学术报告，报告题目为“微米分辨率OCT技术及应用”。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，会议采用线下+线上（腾讯会议和蔻享学术）结合的方式，参会的教师、学生共40余人。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of March 3, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Professor Liu Linbo from Nanyang Technological University in Singapore to give an academic report. The report was titled "Micrometer Resolution OCT Technology and Application". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. The meeting was a combination of offline + online (Tencent Conference and Koxiang Academic). There were more than 40 teachers and students participating in the meeting.

blocks.text_zh: 刘琳波教授的报告主要分为以下三个方面：（1）光学相干层析成像（Optical Coherence Tomography, OCT）的简介和应用场景；（2）现有OCT技术应用的瓶颈以及微米分辨率OCT（Micro-OCT）的创新点；（3）团队相关实验工作。
blocks.text_en: Professor Liu Linbo’s report is mainly divided into the following three aspects: (1) Introduction and application scenarios of Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT); (2) Bottlenecks in the application of existing OCT technology and innovations in micron resolution OCT (Micro-OCT); (3) Team-related experimental work.

blocks.text_zh: 首先，刘教授介绍了OCT检查的优势，即它不同于有创的病理检查，它是一种无损、无辐射、非接触的断层成像技术，更易于被患者所接受，并且OCT能够提供微米级的空间分辨率和毫米级的穿透深度，非常适合人体粘膜层的高速、大范围成像，所以广泛应用于粘膜疾病的临床诊断。接下来，刘教授分析了现有OCT技术应用的瓶颈，其中之一是其有限的空间分辨率（5-10微米），无法清晰分辨大部分人体细胞和亚细胞结构（1-2微米），而刘教授团队所研究的Micro-OCT是一种1微米级分辨率的OCT技术，这种技术通过采用干涉光谱拼接等方法能够达到1微米级的轴向分辨率，同时通过多孔径合成和数字重聚焦技术，提高了横向分辨率和扩展焦深。
blocks.text_en: First of all, Professor Liu introduced the advantages of OCT examination, that is, it is different from invasive pathological examination. It is a non-destructive, non-radiation, non-contact tomographic imaging technology, which is more easily accepted by patients. Moreover, OCT can provide micron-level spatial resolution and millimeter-level penetration depth, which is very suitable for high-speed and large-scale imaging of human mucosal layers, so it is widely used in the clinical diagnosis of mucosal diseases. Next, Professor Liu analyzed the bottlenecks in the application of existing OCT technology. One of them is its limited spatial resolution (5-10 microns), which cannot clearly distinguish most human cells and subcellular structures (1-2 microns). The Micro-OCT studied by Professor Liu's team is an OCT technology with a resolution of 1 micron. This technology can achieve axial resolution of 1 micron by using methods such as interference spectrum splicing. At the same time, it improves lateral resolution and extended depth of focus through multi-aperture synthesis and digital refocusing technology.

blocks.text_zh: 报告中，刘教授介绍了他们在南洋理工大学团队已经基于Micro-OCT技术进行了一系列动物和人体实验以验证这个先进的成像技术，包括针对动物子宫颈上皮和膀胱动脉外膜，以及针对人体动脉的成像等。这些实验成功证明Micro-OCT能够清晰分辨多种上皮组织的亚细胞结构。同时，得益于分辨率的提高，Micro-OCT可以检测到气管中的纤毛并捕捉到它的运动形态，这为开展黏膜清除机制的相关研究提供技术支持。不仅如此，这些实验实验还进一步表明了Micro-OCT能够清晰分辨正常、低度上皮内瘤变和高度上皮内瘤变的细胞学特征，这对早期癌症的筛查和诊断领域具有潜在的应用价值。
blocks.text_en: In the report, Professor Liu introduced that their team at Nanyang Technological University has conducted a series of animal and human experiments based on Micro-OCT technology to verify this advanced imaging technology, including imaging of animal cervical epithelium and bladder artery adventitia, as well as imaging of human arteries. These experiments successfully demonstrated that Micro-OCT can clearly distinguish the subcellular structure of various epithelial tissues. At the same time, thanks to the improved resolution, Micro-OCT can detect cilia in the trachea and capture their movement patterns, which provides technical support for research on mucosal clearance mechanisms. Not only that, these experimental experiments further demonstrated that Micro-OCT can clearly distinguish the cytological characteristics of normal, low-grade intraepithelial neoplasia and high-grade intraepithelial neoplasia, which has potential application value in the field of early cancer screening and diagnosis.

blocks.text_zh: 报告的最后，刘教授向我们讲述当前Micro-OCT仍然面临的三大技术瓶颈：1）高横向分辨率与成像景深的限制问题；2）光学元件和成像组织引起的相差畸变对图像质量的影响；3）成像穿透深度不足的问题。为了降低上述情况对图像的影响，刘教授团队分别开展了相应的系统优化研究，旨在进一步推动Micro-OCT在实际临床上的应用。同时，随着人工智能技术的发展，刘教授也期待在以后的研究中能够结合机器学习技术，帮忙提高成像系统的性能。
blocks.text_en: At the end of the report, Professor Liu told us about the three major technical bottlenecks that Micro-OCT still faces: 1) the limitation of high lateral resolution and imaging depth of field; 2) the impact of phase distortion caused by optical components and imaging tissue on image quality; 3) the problem of insufficient imaging penetration depth. In order to reduce the impact of the above situations on images, Professor Liu's team carried out corresponding system optimization research, aiming to further promote the application of Micro-OCT in actual clinical applications. At the same time, with the development of artificial intelligence technology, Professor Liu also looks forward to combining machine learning technology in future research to help improve the performance of imaging systems.

blocks.text_zh: 报告期间学术氛围浓厚，东南大学附属中大医院介入与血管外科张毅主任以及中国医学科学院皮肤病医院病理科姜祎群主任就感兴趣的问题通过线上与刘教授进行了深入的讨论和交流。线下参会的师生也踊跃提问，刘教授也针对问题一一做出了细致的回答。同时对Mico-OCT成像技术未来的发展方向，以及在临床皮肤疾病的检测、消化系统疾病的早癌筛查，以及眼科领域的潜在应用等相关合作进行了深刻的探讨。
blocks.text_en: The academic atmosphere was strong during the report. Zhang Yi, director of the Interventional and Vascular Surgery Department of Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, and Jiang Yiqun, director of the Pathology Department of the Dermatology Hospital of the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, had in-depth discussions and exchanges with Professor Liu online on issues of interest. Teachers and students participating in the offline meeting also actively asked questions, and Professor Liu also gave detailed answers to the questions one by one. At the same time, there was an in-depth discussion on the future development direction of Mico-OCT imaging technology, as well as related cooperation in the detection of clinical skin diseases, early cancer screening of digestive system diseases, and potential applications in the field of ophthalmology.

blocks.text_zh: 刘琳波教授简介：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Professor Liu Linbo:

blocks.text_zh: 刘琳波博士系新加坡南洋理工大学电气及电子工程学院、化工与生物医学工程学院副教授。新加坡国立大学生物工程博士。2011年获哈佛医学院麻省总医院医学发现博士后奖。长期从事高分辨率光学相干层析成像技术研究，是Micro-OCT技术的主要发明人。当前主要研究方向为用于早期癌症诊断的亚细胞分辨率OCT技术。在Nature Medicine、Optica等杂志发表SCI论文70余篇，申报国内外发明专利11项，其中6项获得授权，2项签署使用许可协议。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Liu Linbo is an associate professor at the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering and the School of Chemical Engineering and Biomedical Engineering at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. PhD in Bioengineering from the National University of Singapore. In 2011, he received the Medical Discovery Postdoctoral Award from Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital. He has long been engaged in research on high-resolution optical coherence tomography technology and is the main inventor of Micro-OCT technology. The current main research direction is subcellular resolution OCT technology for early cancer diagnosis. He has published more than 70 SCI papers in journals such as Nature Medicine and Optica, and applied for 11 domestic and foreign invention patents, of which 6 were authorized and 2 signed license agreements.

title_zh: 研究院与鼓楼医院病理科举行病理人工智能学术沙龙活动

blocks.text_zh: 2023 年新年伊始，智慧医疗研究院与南京鼓楼医院病理科联合举办了新年病理人工智能学术沙龙活动。智慧医疗研究院和鼓楼医院病理科开展了多年的科研合作，目前在肝内胆管癌患者的生存预测等方面已经合作发表了相关论文并联合申请了科研项目多项。本次学术沙龙旨在聚焦双方感兴趣的领域，进一步加强两个单位医工专家的深入合作和交流。
blocks.text_en: At the beginning of the new year in 2023, the Smart Medical Research Institute and the Pathology Department of Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital jointly organized the New Year Pathology Artificial Intelligence Academic Salon. The Smart Medical Research Institute and the Pathology Department of Gulou Hospital have carried out scientific research cooperation for many years. Currently, they have jointly published relevant papers and jointly applied for a number of scientific research projects on the survival prediction of patients with intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. This academic salon aims to focus on areas of interest to both parties and further strengthen in-depth cooperation and exchanges between medical and engineering experts from the two units.

blocks.text_zh: 本次学术沙龙由鼓楼医院病理科陈骏主任组织。与会人员包括鼓楼医院病理科樊祥山主任、孙琦主任及徐月梅医生，智慧医疗研究院相关老师和研究生等十余人。会议由研究院执行院长徐军老师致开幕词。会上，双方专家就正在进行和未来计划开展的科研合作做了相关的专题汇报和深入讨论。鼓楼医院陈骏主任做了《原发性肝癌免疫微环境病理学研究进展》的报告；孙琦主任做了《 AI 辅助病理诊断临床需求》的介绍。鼓楼医院徐月梅医生和智慧医疗研究院研究生张靖恺联合做了《深度学习模型辅助评估 IgA 肾病牛津分型初步探索》的汇报。智慧医疗研究院焦一平老师、宣锴老师、罗月梅老师、王向学老师分别做了《基于语义分割方法的肿瘤微环境解析》、《前列腺影像和病理大切片的融合与分析》、《眼科和消化道微米分辨率光学相干成像 (µOCT) 与分析》、《计算病理在癌症预后及治疗中应用》的汇报。智慧医疗研究院李瑾老师主持了相关报告。医工专家之间就报告的内容进行了整个下午的“头脑风暴”，双方专家 各抒己见 直至错过了晚餐时间。讨论的内容不仅涉及病理 AI 应用的临床前景与接下来双方进一步开展深入合作的研究规划，还涉及病理图像分析、先进光学成像系统、基因组数据与多组学数据联合分析等前沿内容。
blocks.text_en: This academic salon was organized by Chen Jun, Director of the Pathology Department of Gulou Hospital. Participants included Director Fan Xiangshan, Director Sun Qi and Dr. Xu Yuemei of the Pathology Department of Gulou Hospital, as well as more than ten people including relevant teachers and graduate students of the Smart Medical Research Institute. The meeting was opened by Mr. Xu Jun, Executive Dean of the Institute. At the meeting, experts from both sides made relevant special reports and in-depth discussions on ongoing and future planned scientific research cooperation. Director Chen Jun of Gulou Hospital gave a report on "Research Progress in Immune Microenvironment Pathology of Primary Liver Cancer"; Director Sun Qi gave an introduction on "Clinical Needs for AI-Assisted Pathological Diagnosis". Dr. Xu Yuemei of Gulou Hospital and Zhang Jingkai, a graduate student of the Smart Medical Research Institute, jointly gave a report on "Preliminary Exploration of Deep Learning Model-Assisted Assessment of Oxford Classification of IgA Nephropathy". Teachers Jiao Yiping, Xuan Kai, Luo Yuemei, and Wang Xiangxue from the Smart Medical Research Institute respectively gave reports on "Tumor Microenvironment Analysis Based on Semantic Segmentation Methods", "Fusion and Analysis of Prostate Images and Pathological Large Slices", "Ophthalmology and Digestive Tract Micron Resolution Optical Coherence Imaging (µOCT) and Analysis", and "Application of Computational Pathology in Cancer Prognosis and Treatment". Teacher Li Jin from the Smart Medical Research Institute presided over the relevant report. Medical and engineering experts held a whole afternoon of "brainstorming" on the content of the report. Experts from both sides expressed their opinions until they missed dinner time. The discussion covered not only the clinical prospects of pathological AI applications and the research plans for further in-depth cooperation between the two parties, but also cutting-edge content such as pathological image analysis, advanced optical imaging systems, joint analysis of genomic data and multi-omics data.

blocks.text_zh: 最后，鼓楼医院病理科樊祥山主任对会议作了总结，并对双方医工交叉的合作前景做了展望。会议对 研究院与鼓楼医院病理科的近期开展的合作研究进行了部署和规划。本次会议 的成功举行进一步加深了智慧医疗研究院与南京鼓楼医院病理科的相互了解与合作。
blocks.text_en: Finally, Fan Xiangshan, director of the Pathology Department of Gulou Hospital, summarized the meeting and looked forward to the prospects of cooperation between the two sides' medical industry. The meeting deployed and planned the recent collaborative research between the institute and the Pathology Department of Gulou Hospital. The successful holding of this meeting further deepened the mutual understanding and cooperation between the Smart Medical Research Institute and the Pathology Department of Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital.

title_zh: MICS计算病理专题暨第二届计算病理研讨会成功举办

blocks.text_zh: 2023 年 1 月 14 日上午， MICS 计算病理专题暨第二届计算病理研讨会通过腾讯会议在线举行。会议通过圆桌会议与特邀报告的形式讨论了我计算病理学的未来发展方向与最新技术进展。本次会议特别荣幸地邀请到了中华医学会病理学分会主任委员梁智勇教授，候任主委刘东戈教授，前任主委步宏教授，以及梁莉教授、宋志刚教授等病理学领域资深专家作致辞和圆桌讨论。本次会议得到了中华医学会病理学分会前后三任主委的指导，体现了中华医学会病理学分会对我国计算病理领域发展的高度重视。圆桌会议讨论的议题主要包括：病理专病数据库的建设、数字 病理与计算病理行业标准与专家共识的推进、计算病理与数字病理的应用与落地等。 这些议题对我国计算病理领域的未来发展均具有重要的引领作用。
blocks.text_en: On the morning of January 14, 2023, the MICS Computational Pathology Special Topic and the Second Computational Pathology Symposium were held online through Tencent Conference. The meeting discussed the future development direction and latest technological progress of computational pathology in the form of roundtable discussions and invited reports. This meeting was particularly honored to invite Professor Liang Zhiyong, chairman of the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association, Professor Liu Dongge, the incoming chairman, Professor Bu Hong, the former chairman, as well as senior experts in the field of pathology such as Professor Liang Li and Professor Song Zhigang to give speeches and roundtable discussions. This meeting received the guidance of the three previous chairmen of the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association, which reflects the great importance that the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association attaches to the development of the field of computational pathology in my country. Topics discussed at the roundtable mainly include: the construction of pathology-specific disease databases, the advancement of digital pathology and computational pathology industry standards and expert consensus, and the application and implementation of computational pathology and digital pathology, etc. These topics have an important leading role in the future development of computational pathology in my country.

blocks.alt_zh: MICS计算病理专题暨第二届计算病理研讨会成功举办

blocks.text_zh: 中华医学会病理学分会主任委员梁智勇教授致辞
blocks.text_en: Professor Liang Zhiyong, Chairman of the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association, delivered a speech

blocks.text_zh: 中华医学会病理学分会主任委员，北京协和医院病理科主任梁智勇教授在致辞中说，病理学的发展得益于新的技术的发展和应用。计算病理正是医工交叉合作产生的，是病理学的一个新的分支，也是我们病理学发展新的发展方向。如何把人工智能等技术更好地应用到我们病理工作中，也是我们病理人一直在努力和探讨的方向，因此非常期望得到相关交叉学科领域特别是工科领域的支持。期待本次会议能够促进工科专家与病理学专家更多的合作与交流，共同推动国内计算病理领域的发展，真正在国际上相关领域的引领发展。徐军教授作为研讨会主席及第四届医学图像计算青年研讨会 (MICS) 主席，代表 MICS 和南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院感谢梁智勇教授、刘东戈教授、步宏教授、梁莉教授、宋志刚教授、余维淼教授、许燕教授、廖俊教授、王连生教授、各位 MICS 委员、各位病理医生、各位专家、老师和同学参加本次会议，并祝各位专家春节快乐，阖家幸福。向奋战在抗疫一线的各位病理医生和医务人员致以崇高的敬意和节日的问候！
blocks.text_en: Professor Liang Zhiyong, chairman of the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association and director of the Pathology Department of Peking Union Medical College Hospital, said in his speech that the development of pathology benefits from the development and application of new technologies. Computational pathology is the result of cross-collaboration between doctors and engineers. It is a new branch of pathology and a new direction for the development of our pathology. How to better apply technologies such as artificial intelligence to our pathology work is also a direction that we pathologists have been working hard and exploring. Therefore, we very much look forward to receiving support from related interdisciplinary fields, especially the engineering field. It is expected that this conference will promote more cooperation and exchanges between engineering experts and pathology experts, jointly promote the development of domestic computational pathology, and truly lead the development of related fields internationally. Professor Xu Jun, as the chairman of the seminar and the chairman of the 4th Medical Image Computing Youth Symposium (MICS), on behalf of MICS and Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute, thanked Professor Liang Zhiyong, Professor Liu Dongge, Professor Bu Hong, Professor Liang Li, Professor Song Zhigang, Professor Yu Weimiao, Professor Xu Yan, Professor Liao Jun, Professor Wang Liansheng, and all MICS Committee members, pathologists, experts, teachers and classmates attended this meeting and wished all experts a happy Spring Festival and happiness to their families. I would like to express my highest respect and holiday greetings to all pathologists and medical staff who are fighting on the front line of the epidemic!

blocks.alt_zh: MICS计算病理专题暨第二届计算病理研讨会成功举办

blocks.text_zh: 研讨会海报与内容日程安排
blocks.text_en: Seminar poster and content schedule

blocks.text_zh: 在会上，徐军教授向与会嘉宾和专家介绍了 MICS 和本次会议的背景。他说，计算病理是数字化病理和以机器学习、数字图像处理为代表的人工智能技术高度融合的领域。随着病理切片数字化被临床广泛采用以及人工智能技术向病理领域的广泛渗透，计算病理将成为传统病理领域的变革性技术。在计算病理领域，我国和西方发达国家几乎差不多同时起步，因此对于计算病理领域的重视和发展对于我国在这个领域占领全球科技制高点，解决“卡脖子”技术难题非常关键。由于该领域涉及到数字化病理和人工智能领域，是前沿的医工交叉领域，因此需要我国病理学专家和工学专家共同努力，才能有效地推动其发展。同时这个领域具有广阔的发展空间和前景，以及重要的临床应用价值。数字病理自 2017 年之后才开始在全世界范围内开始逐步被临床大规模接纳和采用，病理科的逐步数字化是发展的趋势和方向。我国在中华医学会病理学分会前后三任主委：步宏教授、梁智勇教授、刘东戈教授的带领和推动之下，数字病理和计算病理领域已经取得了非常大的进步，但仍然面临很多挑战性问题有待解决。朝着这个目标，本次会议聚焦于计算病理和数字病理领域最新的前沿研究进展，目前面临的挑战，以及未来发展的方向等圆桌会议和特邀学术报告。期望本次会议能够引领我国计算病理领域接下来的发展方向。
blocks.text_en: At the meeting, Professor Xu Jun introduced the background of MICS and this meeting to the guests and experts. He said that computational pathology is a field that is highly integrated with digital pathology and artificial intelligence technology represented by machine learning and digital image processing. As the digitization of pathological slides is widely adopted in clinical practice and artificial intelligence technology widely penetrates into the field of pathology, computational pathology will become a transformative technology in the field of traditional pathology. In the field of computational pathology, my country and Western developed countries started almost at the same time. Therefore, attaching importance to and developing the field of computational pathology is very critical for my country to occupy the commanding heights of global science and technology in this field and solve "stuck neck" technical problems. Since this field involves the fields of digital pathology and artificial intelligence and is a cutting-edge medical-engineering intersection, it requires the joint efforts of my country's pathology experts and engineering experts to effectively promote its development. At the same time, this field has broad development space and prospects, as well as important clinical application value. Only since 2017 has digital pathology begun to be gradually accepted and adopted clinically on a large scale around the world. The gradual digitization of pathology departments is the development trend and direction. Under the leadership and promotion of the three previous chairmen of the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association: Professor Bu Hong, Professor Liang Zhiyong, and Professor Liu Dongge, my country has made great progress in the field of digital pathology and computational pathology, but it still faces many challenging problems that need to be solved. Toward this goal, this conference focuses on the latest cutting-edge research progress in the field of computational pathology and digital pathology, current challenges, and future development directions, etc. Roundtable discussions and invited academic reports. It is hoped that this conference can lead the next development direction of the field of computational pathology in my country.

blocks.alt_zh: MICS计算病理专题暨第二届计算病理研讨会成功举办

blocks.text_zh: 医工专家圆桌会议议题的热烈讨论
blocks.text_en: Lively discussion on topics at roundtable meeting of medical and engineering experts

blocks.text_zh: 在圆桌会议环节，中华医学会病理学分会前后三任主委及各位病理和工学专家对病理数据库的构建、未来计算病理或者病理 AI 的应用场景、切片数字化标准问题、病理 AI 的标注问题和面临的挑战等做了很多引领性的讨论，这对于指导接下来在我国计算病理领域的研究和落地应用具有重要的指导意义。特邀学术报告亦是干货满满，由病理学专家和工学专家分别介绍了细胞病理、胃肠肿瘤与炎性病变、前列腺癌等方面计算机辅助诊断，以及基于无监督与弱监督学习的计算病理方法、多实例甚至跨模态异构数据的融合方法，同时涉及了 Transformer 、知识蒸馏、异构 Graph 等方法在计算病理领域的新颖应用。
blocks.text_en: During the roundtable session, the three previous chairmen of the Pathology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association and various pathology and engineering experts conducted many leading discussions on the construction of pathology databases, future application scenarios of computational pathology or pathology AI, issues of slice digitization standards, pathological AI labeling issues and challenges, etc. This has important guiding significance for guiding subsequent research and implementation in the field of computational pathology in my country. The invited academic lectures were also full of useful information. Pathology experts and engineering experts introduced computer-aided diagnosis of cytopathology, gastrointestinal tumors and inflammatory lesions, prostate cancer, etc., as well as computational pathology methods based on unsupervised and weakly supervised learning, multi-instance and even cross-modal heterogeneous data fusion methods, and also involved novel applications of Transformer, knowledge distillation, heterogeneous Graph and other methods in the field of computational pathology.

blocks.alt_zh: MICS计算病理专题暨第二届计算病理研讨会成功举办

blocks.text_zh: 精彩纷呈的特邀报告
blocks.text_en: Exciting special guest reports

blocks.text_zh: 南方医科大学病理科主任梁莉教授介绍了人工智能细胞病理辅助诊疗的应用和实践。新加坡科技局余维淼教授对人工智能辅助病理诊断的发展现状、挑战和瓶颈等进行了详细的分析和讨论，报告同时对计算病理和数字病理行业发展与生态环境，如何推动人工智能病理诊断未来的快速发展等方面做了详尽的分析和讨论。解放军总医院病理科宋志刚教授对病理切片的特点及人工智能病理辅助诊断在胃肠黏膜的应用和实践做了很深入的讨论。北京航空航天大学许燕教授针对病理图像中实际存在的标记少等无监督和弱监督学习问题进行了很好的探索，介绍了基于无监督和弱监督学习的前沿研究成果。中国药科大学廖俊针对病理图像的强监督学习模型以及最新的弱监督学习模型做了详细介绍。厦门大学王连生教授对病理图像处理、多模态数据融合等工作做了重要分享。本次会议的参会嘉宾均为我国病理学和计算病理领域资深专家，与会专家来自病理学和工学等多个学科，会议具有鲜明的医工交叉特色。本次会议由医学图像计算青年研讨会（ MICS ）和南京信息工程—中大医院智慧医疗研究院主办。会议通过腾讯会议、 Bilibili 、寇享学术同步直播，在线参会医工专家上千人次。
blocks.text_en: Professor Liang Li, Director of the Pathology Department of Southern Medical University, introduced the application and practice of artificial intelligence cytopathology-assisted diagnosis and treatment. Professor Yu Weimiao from the Singapore Institute of Technology conducted a detailed analysis and discussion on the development status, challenges and bottlenecks of artificial intelligence-assisted pathological diagnosis. The report also made a detailed analysis and discussion on the development and ecological environment of computational pathology and digital pathology industries, and how to promote the rapid development of artificial intelligence-assisted pathological diagnosis in the future. Professor Song Zhigang from the Department of Pathology of the People's Liberation Army General Hospital gave an in-depth discussion on the characteristics of pathological slices and the application and practice of artificial intelligence pathological-assisted diagnosis in gastrointestinal mucosa. Professor Xu Yan from Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics conducted a good exploration of unsupervised and weakly supervised learning problems such as the lack of actual labels in pathological images, and introduced cutting-edge research results based on unsupervised and weakly supervised learning. Liao Jun of China Pharmaceutical University gave a detailed introduction to the strong supervised learning model and the latest weakly supervised learning model for pathological images. Professor Wang Liansheng of Xiamen University made important sharing on pathological image processing, multi-modal data fusion and other work. The guests participating in this conference are all senior experts in the field of pathology and computational pathology in my country. The participating experts come from pathology, engineering and other disciplines. The conference has a distinctive feature of medical-engineering intersection. This conference is hosted by the Medical Image Computing Youth Symposium (MICS) and Nanjing Information Engineering-Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute. The meeting was simultaneously broadcast live through Tencent Conference, Bilibili, and Kouxiang Academic, with thousands of medical and engineering experts participating online.

blocks.text_zh: 据悉，计算病理研讨会由智慧医疗研究院徐军教授发起，在 2021 年 11 月举办了第一届会议，邀请了 海内外计算病理领域的学者做前沿学术报告 。本次会议是智慧医疗研究院组织的第二届计算病理研讨会。 2022 年由于疫情影响推迟了会议举办时间。计算病理研讨会拟每年举办一次，邀请国内外计算病理领域有影响力的专家做学术报告和讨论，致力于促进工学专家和病理学专家相互间的了解、交流和合作，讨论和交流计算病理领域最新的前沿技术。同时促进我国计算病理领域的国际合作与交流，推动我国计算病理和数字病理领域的发展。
blocks.text_en: It is reported that the computational pathology seminar was initiated by Professor Xu Jun of the Smart Medical Research Institute. The first conference was held in November 2021, and scholars in the field of computational pathology at home and abroad were invited to give cutting-edge academic reports. This conference is the second computational pathology seminar organized by the Smart Medical Research Institute. The conference will be postponed in 2022 due to the impact of the epidemic. The Computational Pathology Symposium is planned to be held annually. Influential experts in the field of computational pathology at home and abroad are invited to give academic reports and discussions. It is committed to promoting mutual understanding, exchange and cooperation between engineering experts and pathology experts, and discussing and exchanging the latest cutting-edge technologies in the field of computational pathology. At the same time, it will promote international cooperation and exchanges in the field of computational pathology in my country and promote the development of computational pathology and digital pathology in my country.

title_zh: 智慧医疗社团本科生与教师开展师生座谈交流活动

blocks.text_zh: 为了更好地帮助本科生规划暑期的学习，引导对科研感兴趣的本科生掌握科研的方法并为今后从事科研工作打下基础， 6 月 30 日下午智慧医疗研究院教师与智慧医疗社团同学们在信息科技大楼举行了一场座谈会。活动中，副院长徐军首先对本科生参与科研的可能性做了详细分析，他对有志于从事科学研究的本科生提出了建议。他指出从事科学研究不一定适合于所有人，因为它需要付出大量的时间和精力以及需要具备持之以恒努力的决心。他鼓励智慧医疗社团同学们永远保持好奇心和求知欲，不断努力学习新知识；学会提出问题，思考问题，解决问题；学会与他人合作，与他人分享自己的想法和成果；勇于尝试新的方法和思路；坚持不懈，不怕失败，不断尝试。他鼓励各位对科研感兴趣的智慧医疗同学们能够在暑假期间到智慧医疗研究院接受科研的训练，通过科研训练可以培养各位本科生严谨的科学精神；提高创新意识和创新能力，提高科学素养和科学思维能力；培养实践能力和团队合作精神。
blocks.text_en: In order to better help undergraduates plan their summer studies, guide undergraduates who are interested in scientific research to master scientific research methods and lay the foundation for future scientific research work, on the afternoon of June 30, teachers from the Smart Medical Research Institute and students from the Smart Medical Club held a symposium in the Information Technology Building. During the event, Vice Dean Xu Jun first made a detailed analysis of the possibility of undergraduates participating in scientific research, and he made suggestions for undergraduates who are interested in engaging in scientific research. He pointed out that engaging in scientific research may not be suitable for everyone because it requires a lot of time and energy and the determination to persevere. He encouraged the students of the Smart Medical Club to always maintain curiosity and thirst for knowledge, and constantly strive to learn new knowledge; learn to ask questions, think about problems, and solve problems; learn to cooperate with others and share their ideas and results with others; be brave enough to try new methods and ideas; persevere, not be afraid of failure, and keep trying. He encouraged all smart medical students who are interested in scientific research to receive scientific research training at the Smart Medical Research Institute during the summer vacation. Through scientific research training, they can cultivate the rigorous scientific spirit of undergraduates; improve their innovation awareness and ability, scientific literacy and scientific thinking ability; and cultivate practical ability and teamwork spirit.

blocks.text_zh: 会上智慧医疗研究院的各位老师分别介绍了自己的研究方向和正在进行的课题，激发了智慧医疗社团成员的学术热情。智慧医疗社团成员的同学们积极参与讨论，同学们对参与科学研究充满期待，纷纷表达了进一步参与研究的意愿，非常期望能够通过科研实践把自己在书本上学到的知识应用于实践，并期望通过智慧医疗研究院这个平台进一步训练自己的解决实际问题的能力。同学们还就自己感兴趣的研究方向与老师们进行了深入讨论。
blocks.text_en: At the meeting, teachers from the Smart Medical Research Institute introduced their research directions and ongoing topics, stimulating the academic enthusiasm of members of the smart medical community. Students who were members of the Smart Medical Society actively participated in the discussion. The students were full of expectations for participating in scientific research and expressed their willingness to further participate in research. They very much expected to apply the knowledge they learned in books to practice through scientific research practice, and expected to further train their ability to solve practical problems through the platform of the Smart Medical Research Institute. The students also had in-depth discussions with teachers on the research directions they were interested in.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院的老师们在座谈会上分享了他们的前沿研究成果和思路，包括人工智能与大数据技术在病理图像、放射影像、神经影像、医学成像、超微 uOCT 成像、电子病历和多组学等医疗领域的应用。各位老师的研究方向多样且深入，智慧医疗社团的同学们对老师们介绍的前沿研究领域表现出浓厚的兴趣，积极提问并展开了热烈的讨论。同学们纷纷表示，通过座谈会，他们更加了解了智慧医疗领域的前沿动态，也对未来深入参与研究充满了信心。
blocks.text_en: Teachers from the Smart Medical Research Institute shared their cutting-edge research results and ideas at the symposium, including the application of artificial intelligence and big data technology in medical fields such as pathological images, radiological images, neuroimaging, medical imaging, ultra-micro uOCT imaging, electronic medical records and multi-omics. The research directions of the teachers are diverse and in-depth. The students in the smart medical club showed a strong interest in the cutting-edge research fields introduced by the teachers, actively asked questions and had lively discussions. The students all said that through the symposium, they had a better understanding of the cutting-edge trends in the field of smart medical care and were full of confidence in participating in in-depth research in the future.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院将继续推动智慧医疗社团本科生与专业导师之间的交流活动，为社团同学们提供更多与专业导师学习的机会，进一步激发同学们的学术热情，培养他们的科研能力和创新精神。我们相信，在智慧医疗领域的探索中，这群年轻的研究者们将会迸发出无限的智慧和潜能。
blocks.text_en: The Smart Medical Research Institute will continue to promote exchange activities between smart medical club undergraduates and professional tutors, provide club students with more opportunities to learn from professional tutors, further stimulate students' academic enthusiasm, and cultivate their scientific research capabilities and innovative spirit. We believe that in the exploration of the field of smart medical care, this group of young researchers will burst out with unlimited wisdom and potential.

blocks.text_zh: 人工智能学院 （未来技术学院） 树立教书育人工作的中心地位，把本科生的培养放在最根本的位置 。努力培养本科生的创新精神，从而更好地适应未来社会和职业发展的需求。 人工智能学院积极落实立德树人根本任务，高度重视人才培养工作，在凝练和建设学院三大研究院的基础上组建了元宇宙、智慧气象和智慧医疗三大学生社团，致力于培养学生创新创业思维，提高学生创新创业能力。
blocks.text_en: The School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) establishes the central position of teaching and educating people, and puts the cultivation of undergraduates in the most fundamental position. Strive to cultivate the innovative spirit of undergraduates to better adapt to the needs of future social and professional development. The School of Artificial Intelligence actively implements the fundamental task of cultivating people with moral integrity and attaches great importance to talent cultivation. Based on the condensation and construction of the three major research institutes of the school, it has established three student societies: Yuanshi, Smart Meteorology, and Smart Medical. It is committed to cultivating students' innovative and entrepreneurial thinking and improving students' innovative and entrepreneurial abilities.

title_zh: 特邀新加坡科技研究局吴敏研究员来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 6 月 5 日下午，南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡科技研究局（ A*STAR ）吴敏研究员来校作学术报告，报告题目为 “Label-efficient Time Series Representation Learning” 。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，本次会议采用线下 + 线上（腾讯会议和蔻享学术）结合的方式，参会的教师、学生共 100 余人，其中，蔻享学术直播 2026 人次。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of June 5, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Researcher Wu Min from the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) of Singapore to come to the school to give an academic report titled "Label-efficient Time Series Representation Learning". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. This meeting adopted a combination of offline + online (Tencent Conference and Koxiang Academic). There were more than 100 teachers and students participating in the meeting, including 2,026 live broadcasts of Koxiang Academic.

blocks.text_zh: 吴敏研究员的报告主要介绍了标签高效时间序列数据分析方面的一些成果： 1 ）自监督表征学习；（ 2 ）时序数据领域自适应；以及（ 3 ）相关的应用（包括睡眠检测和计算生物学）。吴博士首先介绍了一套时序数据无监督表征学习的框架，主要包括时间对比学习和上下文对比学习模块，能够有效的从无监督时序信号中学习有效表征，同时延伸出基于类别信息的半监督表征学习框架。然后，吴博士介绍了基于传感器对齐的时间序列域适应方法，该方法设计基于图网络的时空对齐方法，取得了很好的领域自适应效果。吴博士还介绍了其团队研发的时间序列领域自适应基准评估套件 ADATIME ，该套件提供了数据预处理、算法、评估和测试的完整流程。最后，吴博士介绍了一些应用方面的成果，包括基于自监督的睡眠监测算法和图网络在计算生物学的研究成果。
blocks.text_en: Researcher Wu Min’s report mainly introduced some achievements in label-efficient time series data analysis: 1) self-supervised representation learning; (2) time series data domain adaptation; and (3) related applications (including sleep detection and computational biology). Dr. Wu first introduced a set of unsupervised representation learning framework for time series data, which mainly includes temporal contrast learning and context contrast learning modules, which can effectively learn effective representations from unsupervised time series signals and extend the semi-supervised representation learning framework based on category information. Then, Dr. Wu introduced the time series domain adaptation method based on sensor alignment, which designed a spatio-temporal alignment method based on graph networks and achieved good domain adaptation effects. Dr. Wu also introduced the time series domain adaptive benchmark evaluation suite ADATIME developed by his team, which provides a complete process of data preprocessing, algorithm, evaluation and testing. Finally, Dr. Wu introduced some application results, including self-supervised sleep monitoring algorithms and graph network research results in computational biology.

blocks.text_zh: 报告期间学术氛围浓厚，在互动环节，与会师生积极踊跃提问，就时序数据在医疗数据处理中的应用、时序预测任务领域自适应的进展、图网络在单细胞分析的前景、自监督算法优化等问题与吴博士进行了广泛而深入的交流，会场学术气氛浓厚。
blocks.text_en: The academic atmosphere was strong during the report period. During the interactive session, participating teachers and students actively asked questions and had extensive and in-depth exchanges with Dr. Wu on the application of time series data in medical data processing, the progress of self-adaptation in the field of time series prediction tasks, the prospects of graph networks in single cell analysis, and optimization of self-supervised algorithms. The academic atmosphere at the venue was strong.

Research areas include machine learning and data mining of time series data and graph data. degree in computer science from Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, in 2011 and the bachelor’s degree in computer science from the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) in 2006, respectively. title_zh: 智慧医疗研究院教师在Nature合作系列期刊上发表论文

blocks.text_zh: 近日，南京信息工程大学—中大医院智慧医疗研究院徐军教授团队成员李瑾博士和王向学博士，分别在 Nature 合作系列权威期刊《 npj Digital Medicine 》（中科院一区， Top 期刊，影响因子 IF=15.357 ）和《 npj Precision Oncology 》 ( 影响因子 IF=10.092 ）发表两篇论文。
blocks.text_en: Recently, Dr. Li Jin and Dr. Wang Xiangxue, members of Professor Xu Jun's team at Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute, published two papers respectively in the authoritative journal "npj Digital Medicine" (District 1, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Top Journal, impact factor IF=15.357) and "npj Precision Oncology" (impact factor IF=10.092) in the Nature collaboration series.

blocks.text_zh: 论文一
blocks.text_en: Paper 1
