blocks.text_en: For a research paper titled “Generating synthetic mixed-type longitudinal electronic health records for artificial intelligent applications”, Professor Li Jin from our institute is the first author. Paper link: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00834-7

blocks.text_zh: 论文二
blocks.text_en: Paper 2

blocks.text_zh: 题为 “CT radiomic signature predicts survival and chemotherapy benefit in stage I and II HPV-associated oropharyngeal carcinoma” 的研究论文，我院王向学老师为参与作者，合作单位为美国凯斯西储大学、埃默里大学、佐治亚理工大学和范德堡大学医学院。论文链接：https://www.nature.com/articles/s41698-023-00404-w
blocks.text_en: In the research paper titled "CT radiomic signature predicts survival and chemotherapy benefit in stage I and II HPV-associated oropharyngeal carcinoma", Professor Wang Xiangxue from our hospital is a participating author, and the cooperating units are Case Western Reserve University, Emory University, Georgia Tech University and Vanderbilt University School of Medicine. Paper link: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41698-023-00404-w

blocks.text_zh: 文章内容简介
blocks.text_en: Introduction to the article

blocks.text_zh: 论文一
blocks.text_en: Paper 1

blocks.text_zh: 研究背景：以电子病历（ EHR ）为代表的患者健康数据是一种在医疗领域广泛存在的数据类型，其蕴含的巨大价值推动了近年来计算健康信息学研究的突破性进展。然而，对患者数据的隐私保护需求限制了医疗机构的数据共享，导致研究人员难以获取临床数据的访问权限。生成数据（ Synthetic data ）是一种有效的替代方案，高质量的生成数据能够保留原始数据分布中的特征信息，并可用于下游临床数据挖掘任务。然而，当前面向电子病历的数据生成模型存在局限性，现有方法往往只针对单一数据类型，无法建模高维、复杂临床数据间的相关性。
blocks.text_en: Research background: Patient health data represented by electronic medical records (EHR) is a data type that is widely used in the medical field. Its huge value has promoted breakthroughs in computational health informatics research in recent years. However, the need for privacy protection of patient data limits data sharing among medical institutions, making it difficult for researchers to gain access to clinical data. Generated data (Synthetic data) is an effective alternative. High-quality generated data can retain the characteristic information in the original data distribution and can be used for downstream clinical data mining tasks. However, current data generation models for electronic medical records have limitations. Existing methods often only target a single data type and cannot model the correlation between high-dimensional and complex clinical data.

blocks.text_zh: 研究方法：为解决上述问题，本研究基于生成对抗网络（ GAN ）提出了一种能够同时生成连续型和离散型时序电子病历的数据生成模型，该模型在生成具有异质性、高维度患者时序特征的同时，能够捕捉特征间的潜在关联信息。该模型首先基于多重损失约束下（变分下界、对比学习损失等）的对偶变分自编码器，将存在于不同特征类型变量域的数据，映射至具有统一高阶特征表示的潜空间中；进而，通过耦合循环生成器捕获连续型和离散型时序数据之间的动态关联。
blocks.text_en: Research method: In order to solve the above problems, this study proposes a data generation model based on Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) that can generate continuous and discrete time-series electronic medical records at the same time. This model can generate heterogeneous and high-dimensional patient time-series features while capturing potential correlation information between features. The model is first based on a dual variational autoencoder under multiple loss constraints (variational lower bound, contrastive learning loss, etc.) to map data existing in variable domains of different feature types into a latent space with a unified high-order feature representation; then, the dynamic correlation between continuous and discrete time series data is captured through a coupled loop generator.

blocks.text_zh: 研究结果：本研究验证了所提出的数据生成模型在三个重症监护数据库上的效果（ MIMIC-III ， eICU ， HiRID ）。研究结果表明，本研究所提出的时序电子病历数据生成方法在生成数据的真实性、相关性、可用性及隐私性等方面均取得了良好表现。
blocks.text_en: Research results: This study verified the effectiveness of the proposed data generation model on three critical care databases (MIMIC-III, eICU, HiRID). The research results show that the time-series electronic medical record data generation method proposed in this study has achieved good performance in terms of authenticity, relevance, usability and privacy of the generated data.

blocks.text_zh: 结论与展望：针对临床电子病历数据收集过程中出现的成本高、周期长等困难，本研究提出的数据生成模型通过提供具有高质量、多类型的生成时序电子数据，帮助研究人员在满足患者数据隐私保护的前提下，更高效地开发医学人工智能模型。未来的研究可进一步拓展数据生成方法适用范围，以适应临床实践中所出现的多种数据模态的需求，从而提升医学人工智能在临床实践中的应用价值。
blocks.text_en: Conclusion and Outlook: In view of the difficulties such as high cost and long cycle in the clinical electronic medical record data collection process, the data generation model proposed in this study helps researchers develop medical artificial intelligence models more efficiently by providing high-quality, multi-type generated time-series electronic data while meeting the premise of protecting patient data privacy. Future research can further expand the scope of application of data generation methods to adapt to the needs of multiple data modalities emerging in clinical practice, thereby enhancing the application value of medical artificial intelligence in clinical practice.

blocks.text_zh: 作者介绍
blocks.text_en: Author introduction

blocks.text_zh: 李瑾，女，浙江大学生物医学工程专业博士，博士期间赴英国牛津大学 IBME 研究院联合培养。 2022 年 9 月起就职于南京信息工程大学。主要研究方向为电子病历数据的二次利用、临床智能辅助决策系统开发等。以第一作者身份在 npj Digital Medicine 、 Artificial Intelligence in Medicine 等领域内 Top 期刊上发表论文多篇。参与完成国家自然科学基金、国家重点研发计划、英国国家卫生研究院 NIHR 等科研课题数项。谷歌学术主页：https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=DiFoVRIAAAAJ&hl=zh-CN&oi=sra； ResearchGate 主页：https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Li-Jin-38
blocks.text_en: Li Jin, female, holds a PhD in Biomedical Engineering from Zhejiang University. During her PhD, she went to the IBME Institute of Oxford University in the UK for joint training. Will work at Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology from September 2022. The main research directions include the secondary utilization of electronic medical record data and the development of clinical intelligent auxiliary decision-making systems. As the first author, he has published many papers in top journals in the fields of npj Digital Medicine, Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and other fields. Participated in the completion of several scientific research projects such as the National Natural Science Foundation of China, the National Key Research and Development Program, and the British National Institute of Health NIHR. Google Scholar homepage: https://scholar.google.com.hk/citations?user=DiFoVRIAAAAJ&hl=zh-CN&oi=sra; ResearchGate homepage: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Li-Jin-38

blocks.text_zh: 论文二
blocks.text_en: Paper 2

blocks.text_zh: 研究背景：过去几十年中，人乳头瘤病毒（ HPV ）相关口咽癌（ OPSCC ）的发病率显著增加。患有 HPV 相关 OPSCC 的患者表现出比患有独立于 HPV 的 OPSCC 的患者更好的化疗放疗治疗反应和预后，后者的肿瘤更常与酒精和烟草使用有关。先前的研究表明，与单独放疗相比，同时使用化疗和放疗作为最终治疗方案可以降低高风险口咽癌的局部和区域性复发率。然而，化疗的加入可能会导致治疗相关毒性增加，这对于低风险 HPV 相关口咽癌患者是一个特别关注的问题。放射组学旨在识别与肿瘤表型和预后相关的微小基于图像的属性，不仅有助于在放射图像识别疾病的存在，而且有助于识别与疾病结果和治疗反应相关的特征。然而，至今还没有一种方法可用于评估这些方法在 HPV 相关 OPSCC 患者的化疗效益预测方面的实用性。
blocks.text_en: Background: The incidence of human papillomavirus (HPV)-related oropharyngeal cancer (OPSCC) has increased significantly over the past few decades. Patients with HPV-associated OPSCC show better response to chemoradiotherapy treatment and prognosis than patients with HPV-independent OPSCC, whose tumors are more commonly associated with alcohol and tobacco use. Previous research has shown that using concurrent chemotherapy and radiation therapy as a final treatment option reduces local and regional recurrence rates in high-risk oropharyngeal cancer compared with radiation therapy alone. However, the addition of chemotherapy may result in increased treatment-related toxicity, which is a particular concern for patients with low-risk HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer. Radiomics aims to identify minute image-based attributes related to tumor phenotype and prognosis, helping not only to identify the presence of disease in radiological images but also to identify features associated with disease outcome and treatment response. However, to date no method has been available to assess the utility of these methods in predicting chemotherapy benefit in patients with HPV-related OPSCC.

blocks.text_zh: 研究方法：为解决上述问题，本研究开发了一种预后和预测影像组学图像标记（ pRiS ）， pRiS 采用了治疗前 CT 扫描中原发性咽喉肿瘤内外的定量纹理特征，以预测生存和化疗效益。使用来自 4 个中心总计 491 名患者，分别接受放射治疗 + 化疗或仅放射治疗，我们的目标是调查 pRiS （ a ）是否对 AJCC I 期和 II 期 HPV 相关 OPSCC 患者的生存具有预测价值，以及（ b ）是否与化疗效益相关。 pRiS 在特征提取之前将所有 CT 图像重新采样为等向性体素大小为 1mm ，进而提取灰度级强度特征、灰度共生矩阵（ GLCM ）、 Haralick 特征、 Laws 能量、基于 Gabor 小波的特征和强度梯度方向特征（ CoLlAGe ）。为了研究 pRiS 是否为个性化预测 OS 和 DFS 增加了增量预后价值，本文通过将 pRiS 与预后临床因素相结合构建了一个综合放射性标志物计分表（ Mrad+c ），并将其与临床计分表（ Mc ）进行比较。
blocks.text_en: Research Methods: To address the above issues, this study developed a prognostic and predictive radiomics image signature (pRiS), which utilizes quantitative textural features of the inside and outside of primary throat tumors in pre-treatment CT scans to predict survival and chemotherapy benefit. Using a total of 491 patients from 4 centers who received radiotherapy + chemotherapy or radiotherapy alone, we aimed to investigate whether pRiS (a) has predictive value for survival in patients with AJCC stage I and II HPV-related OPSCC and (b) is associated with chemotherapy benefit. pRiS resamples all CT images to isotropic voxel size of 1mm before feature extraction, and then extracts gray-level intensity features, gray-level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM), Haralick features, Laws energy, Gabor wavelet-based features and intensity gradient direction features (CoLlAGe). To investigate whether pRiS adds incremental prognostic value for personalized prediction of OS and DFS, we constructed a comprehensive radiomarker score (Mrad+c) by combining pRiS with prognostic clinical factors and compared it with a clinical score (Mc).

blocks.text_zh: 研究结果：本研究发现化疗与放疗联合治疗对于高 pRiS 患者的总生存期有所改善，而对于低 pRiS 患者，化疗并没有改善总生存期，这表明这些患者没有从化疗中获得额外的益处，可以考虑减弱治疗。所提出的放射图像特征标记对于 I 和 II 期 HPV 相关口咽癌患者的患者生存和化疗效益具有预测作用。
blocks.text_en: Findings: This study found that combination therapy with chemotherapy and radiotherapy improved overall survival in patients with high pRiS, whereas chemotherapy did not improve overall survival in patients with low pRiS, suggesting that these patients receive no additional benefit from chemotherapy and may consider attenuating treatment. The proposed radiographic signature signature is predictive of patient survival and chemotherapy benefit in patients with stage I and II HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer.

blocks.text_zh: 结论与展望：本研究的创新之处在于： (a) pRiS 不仅被证明对 OPSCC 患者的预后具有预测作用，而且对化疗的附加益处也具有预测作用； (b) 相比于分析不同 HNSCC 亚型的患者， pRiS 专门研究了 AJCC 第 8 版 I 和 II 期 HPV 相关 OPSCC 患者中化疗的作用。本研究的发现可以指导未来的研究设计更强大的预测性生物标志物，以实现 HPV 相关 OPSCC 的精准治疗。
blocks.text_en: Conclusions and Outlook: The novelties of this study are: (a) pRiS was shown to be predictive not only of prognosis in OPSCC patients but also of the additive benefit of chemotherapy; (b) compared to analyzing patients with different HNSCC subtypes, pRiS specifically investigated the role of chemotherapy in patients with AJCC 8th edition I and II HPV-related OPSCC. The findings of this study can guide future studies to design more powerful predictive biomarkers to enable precision treatment of HPV-related OPSCC.

title_zh: 智慧医疗研究院研究生周正豪和中大医院夏天一博士合作的论文被医学影像领域顶级期刊Radiology录用

blocks.text_zh: 研究背景
blocks.text_en: Research background

blocks.text_zh: 随着影像诊断技术的革新、外科手术的进步、靶向及免疫药物的使用等，肝细胞肝癌（Hepatocellular Carcinoma, HCC）患者的整体生存期有了较大的改善，但5年生存期仍较低，其原因之一是患者就诊时就已出现微血管侵犯（Microvessle Invation, MVI）。MVI是指肿瘤对微血管的侵犯，在显微镜下表现为在内皮细胞衬覆的血管腔内见到癌细胞巢团，常见于癌旁肝组织内的门静脉小分支和肝静脉分支，如图 1所示。MVI的发生率在15%~57.1%之间，它的出现提示了HCC的生物学行为更具侵袭性，因此是影响肝癌预后的重要因素，也是治疗方案制定的重要参考依据。近年来，大量的研究试图采用CT、MRI等影像方法结合临床及实验室指标对MVI进行术前预测，这有助于指导肝癌患者治疗决策。
blocks.text_en: With the innovation of imaging diagnosis technology, advances in surgical procedures, and the use of targeted and immunological drugs, the overall survival of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has greatly improved, but the 5-year survival is still low. One of the reasons is that patients already have microvascular invasion (MVI) when they are diagnosed. MVI refers to the invasion of microvessels by tumors. Under the microscope, nests of cancer cells are seen in the vascular lumen lined with endothelial cells. They are commonly found in small portal vein branches and hepatic vein branches in the adjacent liver tissue, as shown in Figure 1. The incidence rate of MVI is between 15% and 57.1%. Its occurrence indicates that the biological behavior of HCC is more aggressive. Therefore, it is an important factor affecting the prognosis of liver cancer and an important reference for the formulation of treatment plans. In recent years, a large number of studies have attempted to use CT, MRI and other imaging methods combined with clinical and laboratory indicators to predict MVI preoperatively, which can help guide treatment decisions for patients with liver cancer.

blocks.alt_zh: 智慧医疗研究院研究生周正豪和中大医院夏天一博士合作的论文被医学影像领域顶级期刊Radiology录用

blocks.text_zh: 图 1 肝细胞癌的微血管侵犯过程表现
blocks.text_en: Figure 1 Manifestations of microvascular invasion process in hepatocellular carcinoma

blocks.text_zh: 南京信息工程大学-中大医院智慧医疗研究院自2021年成立以来便一直致力于通过医学影像和病理切片等医学数据对癌症进行病灶区域分割、病种预测以及生存预后等研究。近期，该团队基于术前配准后四期CT影像，提出一个新颖的、通过构建影像组学模型预测MVI情况的方法，并揭示了MVI潜在的生物学机制。此外，该方法也可以灵活的运用于其他配准后的多模态数据的研究。该研究成果(Predicting Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma using CT-based Radiomics Model)已在线出版于Radiology(IF = 29.15)。
blocks.text_en: Since its establishment in 2021, the Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology-Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute has been committed to research on cancer lesion area segmentation, disease type prediction, and survival prognosis through medical data such as medical images and pathological slices. Recently, the team proposed a novel method to predict MVI by building a radiomics model based on four-phase CT images after preoperative registration, and revealed the potential biological mechanism of MVI. In addition, this method can also be flexibly applied to the study of other registered multi-modal data. The research results (Predicting Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma using CT-based Radiomics Model) have been published online in Radiology (IF = 29.15).

blocks.text_zh: 1. 简介
blocks.text_en: 1. Introduction

blocks.text_zh: 先前的研究表明，各种临床和放射学特征——如血清甲胎蛋白（Alpha-fetoprotein）、肿瘤大小和静脉侵犯的双特征预测因子（TTPVI）——是MVI的独立预测因子。影像学检查，尤其是CT检查，对于HCC的常规诊断和评估至关重要。放射组学是一种新兴的成像分析形式，可用于以高通量的方式获取有用的信息，其有潜力将数字医学图像转化为无数揭示病理生理学的定量特征。最近，有报道称放射组学模型可以基于CT图像准确预测MVI。到目前为止，MVI的术前预测还是具有挑战性，因为MVI是一种组织病理学发现，只能通过术后手术标本进行诊断。
blocks.text_en: Previous studies have shown that various clinical and radiological characteristics—such as serum alpha-fetoprotein, tumor size, and two-trait predictor of venous invasion (TTPVI)—are independent predictors of MVI. Imaging examinations, especially CT examinations, are crucial for the routine diagnosis and evaluation of HCC. Radiomics is an emerging form of imaging analysis that can be used to obtain useful information in a high-throughput manner, which has the potential to transform digital medical images into countless quantitative features that reveal pathophysiology. Recently, it has been reported that a radiomics model can accurately predict MVI based on CT images. Until now, preoperative prediction of MVI has been challenging because MVI is a histopathological finding that can only be diagnosed from postoperative surgical specimens.

blocks.text_zh: 为了缓解上述挑战，本研究首先建立和测试了一个基于肝细胞癌患者多期CT放射组学特征预测微血管侵袭(MVI)的模型。然后，开展一项初步研究，最终确定了MVI相关的差异表达基因。该研究的主要贡献总结如下：
blocks.text_en: To alleviate the above challenges, this study first established and tested a model to predict microvascular invasion (MVI) based on multi-phase CT radiomics features in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma. Then, a preliminary study was conducted to finally identify MVI-related differentially expressed genes. The main contributions of this study are summarized as follows:

blocks.text_zh: • 开发了一个新的影像组学方法，通过图像配准、减影的方法构建了Delta影像组学特征，成功将CT图像增强的变化量化并加入了模型，发现模型的性能提高，并且模型能够对患者预后分层。
blocks.text_en: • Developed a new radiomics method, constructed Delta radiomics features through image registration and subtraction methods, successfully quantified the changes in CT image enhancement and added them to the model. It was found that the performance of the model was improved, and the model was able to stratify patient prognosis.

blocks.text_zh: • 在转录组水平，发现在MVI阳性组中，MVI相关差异表达基因（由图像特征得出）参与了更多的葡萄糖代谢，而肿瘤内的免疫细胞浸润则减少。
blocks.text_en: • At the transcriptome level, it was found that in the MVI-positive group, MVI-related differentially expressed genes (derived from image features) were involved in more glucose metabolism, while immune cell infiltration within the tumor was reduced.

blocks.text_zh: 2. 方法
blocks.text_en: 2. Method

blocks.text_zh: 图2是本研究影像组学研究流程，大体可以概括为以下五点：
blocks.text_en: Figure 2 shows the radiomics research process of this study, which can be roughly summarized into the following five points:

blocks.text_zh: l 通过深度学习算法和Elastix对肝脏区域进行配准（以门静脉期为固定图像）。
blocks.text_en: l Liver area registration is performed using deep learning algorithms and Elastix (using the portal venous phase as a fixed image).

blocks.text_zh: l 在配准图中手动勾画3D肿瘤感兴趣区（VOI），并通过算法向外扩展5mm作为瘤周区域（擦除非肝脏实质组织）；通过配准图像生成减影图像。
blocks.text_en: l Manually outline the 3D tumor region of interest (VOI) in the registration map, and extend it 5 mm outward through the algorithm as the peritumoral area (erasing non-liver parenchymal tissue); generate a subtraction image through the registration image.

blocks.text_zh: l 提取影像组学特征，对不同期相的组学特征做差值，生成Delta1影像组学特征；对减影图像提取特征定义为Delta2影像组学特征。
blocks.text_en: l Extract radiomics features, make a difference between the radiomics features of different phases, and generate Delta1 radiomics features; extract features from subtraction images and define them as Delta2 radiomics features.

blocks.text_zh: l 采取的建模策略是采用ICC评估特征稳定性、mRMR和LASSO来对特征进行降维，最后主要用Logistic回归来构建模型。
blocks.text_en: l The modeling strategy adopted is to use ICC to evaluate feature stability, mRMR and LASSO to reduce feature dimensionality, and finally mainly use logistic regression to build the model.

blocks.text_zh: l 在队列1-3中建立和测试影像组学模型和混合模型，在队列4中验证模型对于预后的分层能力，在队列5中探索MVI的潜在生物学机制。
blocks.text_en: l Establish and test radiomics models and hybrid models in cohorts 1-3, verify the prognostic stratification ability of the model in cohort 4, and explore the potential biological mechanisms of MVI in cohort 5.

blocks.text_zh: 3. 实验及结果
blocks.text_en: 3. Experiments and results

blocks.text_zh: 本研究从四家医疗中心和TCIA数据库，回顾性纳入了773例经手术病理确诊为HCC患者的术前影像及临床资料。将中心1按7：3划分为训练队列（n=334）和内部测试队列（n=142），中心2-3合并为外部测试队列（n=141），中心4为预后队列（n=121），中心5为TCIA队列（n=35）。MVI通过手术病理证实，中心1-3有MVI标签，中心4-5无MVI标签，中心4有早期无复发生存期和总生存期数据，中心5有RNA测序数据。表1描述了数据集及其影像特征的样本分布。
blocks.text_en: This study retrospectively included the preoperative imaging and clinical data of 773 patients with HCC diagnosed by surgical pathology from four medical centers and the TCIA database. Center 1 was divided into a training cohort (n=334) and an internal testing cohort (n=142) on a 7:3 basis, centers 2-3 were combined into an external testing cohort (n=141), center 4 was a prognostic cohort (n=121), and center 5 was a TCIA cohort (n=35). MVI was confirmed by surgical pathology, centers 1-3 had MVI tags, centers 4-5 did not have MVI tags, center 4 had early recurrence-free survival and overall survival data, and center 5 had RNA sequencing data. Table 1 describes the sample distribution of the dataset and its image features.

blocks.text_zh: 在预后队列中，根据影像组学模型（最优）和混合模型得到的患者MVI预测得分，都能对肝癌患者的早期复发生存期（2年内的复发）以及总生存期进行风险分层，如图3。其中，(A, B) 1年和2年无复发生存期和(C, D) 1年、3年和5年总生存期采用放射组学模型衍生评分和混合模型衍生评分进行评估。低模型分数用红线表示，高模型分数用黄线表示。
blocks.text_en: In the prognostic cohort, the patient MVI prediction scores obtained by the radiomics model (optimal) and the mixed model can both risk stratify the early recurrence survival (recurrence within 2 years) and overall survival of liver cancer patients, as shown in Figure 3. Among them, (A, B) 1-year and 2-year recurrence-free survival and (C, D) 1-year, 3-year and 5-year overall survival were evaluated using radiomics model-derived scores and mixed model-derived scores. Low model scores are represented by red lines, high model scores are represented by yellow lines.

blocks.text_zh: 图 3 生存曲线
blocks.text_en: Figure 3 Survival curve

blocks.text_zh: 图4展示了在TCIA队列中，根据MVI相关的影像学特征，我们筛选出相关的MVI差异基因。对这些MVI相关差异基因做富集分析，发现糖代谢等相关通路在MVI高风险组富集，尤其是糖酵解和戊糖磷酸化途径。此外，根据MVI相关的影像学特征分组探索免疫细胞在各个分组中的表达水平，探讨免疫浸润和MVI的相关性，发现在多种免疫细胞中，MVI高危组的免疫浸润水平要低于MVI低危组，尤其是CD8+ T细胞。
blocks.text_en: Figure 4 shows that in the TCIA cohort, based on MVI-related imaging features, we screened out related MVI differential genes. Enrichment analysis of these MVI-related differential genes revealed that sugar metabolism and other related pathways were enriched in the MVI high-risk group, especially the glycolysis and pentose phosphorylation pathways. In addition, the expression levels of immune cells in each group were explored according to the imaging characteristics related to MVI, and the correlation between immune infiltration and MVI was explored. It was found that among various immune cells, the level of immune infiltration in the MVI high-risk group was lower than that in the MVI low-risk group, especially CD8+ T cells.

blocks.text_zh: 图 4 相关基因的筛选
blocks.text_en: Figure 4 Screening of related genes

blocks.text_zh: 通过图5可以看出混合模型成功地预测了两例患者的MVI状态。（a-b）57岁男性患者，MVI阴性，CT显示一9.5厘米的肿瘤，无TTPVI(黑白箭头)，瘤周增强，有明确的假包膜(红色箭头)。免疫组化显示瘤内有丰富的CD8+ T细胞浸润。术后患者至目前无复发，已存活82.3个月。（c-d）35岁男性患者，MVI阳性，CT显示一10.9厘米肿瘤。肿瘤表现为瘤周强化（黄色箭头），TTPVI和界限不清的假包膜。免疫组化显示肿瘤内部CD8+ T细胞稀少。该患者术后3.4个月复发，13.5个月死亡。
blocks.text_en: It can be seen from Figure 5 that the hybrid model successfully predicted the MVI status of the two patients. (a-b) 57-year-old male patient with negative MVI. CT shows a 9.5-cm tumor without TTPVI (black and white arrow), peritumoral enhancement, and clear pseudocapsule (red arrow). Immunohistochemistry showed abundant CD8+ T cell infiltration in the tumor. The patient has no recurrence after surgery and has been alive for 82.3 months. (c-d) 35-year-old male patient with positive MVI and CT scan showing a 10.9-cm tumor. The tumor shows peritumoral enhancement (yellow arrow), TTPVI, and an ill-defined pseudocapsule. Immunohistochemistry showed that CD8+ T cells were sparse within the tumor. The patient relapsed 3.4 months after surgery and died 13.5 months later.

blocks.text_zh: 图 5 两例HCC患者的CT影像及CD8+T细胞免疫组化
blocks.text_en: Figure 5 CT images and CD8+ T cell immunohistochemistry of two HCC patients

blocks.text_zh: 总结
blocks.text_en: Summary

blocks.text_zh: 为了缓解预测HCC患者的MVI情况的困难和挑战，本研究结合CT放射学和放射组学特征构建的Hybrid模型能够成功预测肝细胞癌患者的微血管浸润(MVI)状态。我们还发现MVI相关差异表达基因通常参与葡萄糖代谢。需要进一步的研究来确保我们的模型的可泛化性，并测试我们的转录组测序结果在细胞或动物实验中的生物学相关性。
blocks.text_en: In order to alleviate the difficulties and challenges in predicting the MVI status of HCC patients, this study constructed a Hybrid model that combined CT radiology and radiomics features to successfully predict the microvascular invasion (MVI) status of hepatocellular carcinoma patients. We also found that MVI-related differentially expressed genes are usually involved in glucose metabolism. Further studies are needed to ensure the generalizability of our model and to test the biological relevance of our transcriptome sequencing results in cell or animal experiments.

blocks.text_zh: 随着先进的医学图像分析工具发展，我们可以更容易地从影像和组织病理学切片中提取疾病的多尺度图像生物标志物，例如毫米级和微米级图像表型。这些多尺度图像生物标志物可以帮助医生从影像学和组织学图像中更准确地检测和诊断疾病，并尝试预测复发风险、疾病侵袭性、患者生存率以及患者对治疗的反应。智慧医疗研究院长期以来致力于探索先进的机器学习驱动的影像学和组织学图像分析方法，通过对影像图像和数字化组织样本的“图像生物标记物”的提取和分析，以辅助医生改善疾病的预防、诊断和预后以及更好地评估患者对治疗的响应。
blocks.text_en: With the development of advanced medical image analysis tools, we can more easily extract multi-scale image biomarkers of disease, such as millimeter- and micron-scale image phenotypes, from imaging and histopathology sections. These multiscale image biomarkers can help doctors more accurately detect and diagnose disease from imaging and histology images, and try to predict recurrence risk, disease aggressiveness, patient survival, and patient response to treatment. The Smart Medical Research Institute has long been committed to exploring advanced machine learning-driven imaging and histological image analysis methods, through the extraction and analysis of "image biomarkers" from imaging images and digital tissue samples, to assist doctors in improving disease prevention, diagnosis and prognosis and better evaluating patients' response to treatment.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院的研究队伍来自医学和工程学等不同学科的专家和学生团队，他们利用各自专业的知识，共同解决医疗领域的难题。医工交叉队伍的优势在于能够整合多方面的资源和视角，创新医疗技术和方法，提高医疗质量和效率，促进医疗事业的发展。本论文是南京信息工程大学徐军教授所领导的工学团队以及中大医院居胜红教授所领导的医学团队长期合作，共同努力致力于医学与工程技术等学科相结合，解决生命健康领域重大问题的一项研究成果。研究院通过医工交叉研究，促进医学和生命科学的基础研究和应用研究，从而提高医生对疾病的诊断和治疗水平和效率，为人类健康和福祉做出贡献。同时，通过医工交叉研究也可以激发理工科学家和医学科学家之间的合作和交流，拓展各自的知识视野和思维方式，培养具有跨学科能力和创新精神的人才，为科技进步和社会发展提供动力。
blocks.text_en: The research team of the Smart Medical Research Institute is a team of experts and students from different disciplines such as medicine and engineering. They use their professional knowledge to jointly solve problems in the medical field. The advantage of the medical-engineering interdisciplinary team is that it can integrate multiple resources and perspectives, innovate medical technologies and methods, improve medical quality and efficiency, and promote the development of the medical industry. This paper is the result of a long-term collaboration between the engineering team led by Professor Xu Jun from Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology and the medical team led by Professor Ju Shenghong from Zhongda Hospital. They work together to combine medicine, engineering technology and other disciplines to solve major problems in the field of life and health. The institute promotes basic and applied research in medicine and life sciences through interdisciplinary research between medicine and engineering, thereby improving the level and efficiency of doctors’ diagnosis and treatment of diseases and contributing to human health and well-being. At the same time, interdisciplinary research between medicine and engineering can also stimulate cooperation and exchanges between science and engineering scientists and medical scientists, expand their knowledge horizons and ways of thinking, cultivate talents with interdisciplinary abilities and innovative spirit, and provide impetus for scientific and technological progress and social development.

title_en: The paper jointly written by Zhou Zhenghao, a graduate student at the Smart Medical Research Institute, and Dr. Xia Yi from CUHK Hospital was accepted by Radiology, the top journal in the field of medical imaging.

title_zh: 省政协副主席、民进省委会主委马余强院士一行莅临智慧医疗研究院调研

blocks.text_zh: 4月12日下午，省政协副 主席、民进省委会主委、中科院院士马余强一行到南京信息工程大学-中大医院智慧医疗研究院进行调研指导，民进省委会专职副主委、一级巡视员朱毅民，民进省委会副主委、南京师范大学副校长袁林旺，省委统战部党派处、省教育厅研究生处相关负责人，省政协委员、苏州市政协相关负责人，民进省委会特聘研究员、调研处负责人参加调研。我校副校长刘博，校党委常委、党委统战部部长陈涛，学科建设处副处长来鹏陪同。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of April 12, Deputy Chairman of the Provincial Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference Chairman, Chairman of the Provincial Committee for the Advancement of Democracy and Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences Ma Yuqiang and his delegation went to Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology-Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute for research and guidance. Zhu Yimin, full-time deputy chairman of the Provincial Committee for the Democracy and first-level inspector, and Deputy Chairman of the Provincial Committee for the Democracy Yuan Linwang, Vice President of the Committee and Nanjing Normal University, relevant persons in charge of the Party Affairs Office of the United Front Work Department of the Provincial Party Committee, the Graduate Office of the Provincial Department of Education, members of the Provincial Political Consultative Conference, relevant persons in charge of the Suzhou CPPCC Committee, specially appointed researchers of the Provincial Committee for Democracy and persons in charge of the Research Office participated in the survey. Liu Bo, Vice President of our school, Chen Tao, Member of the Standing Committee of the School Party Committee and Director of the United Front Work Department of the Party Committee, and Lai Peng, Deputy Director of the Discipline Construction Department, accompanied him.

blocks.text_zh: 我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授详细介绍了智慧医疗研究院的建设背景、理念、目标和研究领域。他通过产业背景、地理位置、师资力量、发展机遇和态势等几方面介绍了智慧医疗研究院的发展前景，分析了目前存在的问题和难点，以及详细地介绍了研究院在医工交叉学科建设方面的研究工作和相关成果，并指出人工智能技术赋能医疗领域的重要意义和潜在的临床价值。紧接着，徐军带领考察团参观了智慧医疗研究院，并分享了多项研究院正在开展的最新研究成果，包括计算病理、医学影像智能分析、微米分辨率OCT成像、手术机器人、脑科学与神经影像、医学大数据分析以及全栈式AI多组学方案等。
blocks.text_en: Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, introduced in detail the construction background, concepts, goals and research fields of the Smart Medical Research Institute. He introduced the development prospects of the Smart Medical Research Institute through industrial background, geographical location, faculty, development opportunities and trends, analyzed the current problems and difficulties, and introduced in detail the research work and related results of the Institute in the construction of interdisciplinary medical and engineering fields, and pointed out the importance and potential clinical value of artificial intelligence technology in empowering the medical field. Immediately afterwards, Xu Jun led the delegation to visit the Smart Medical Research Institute and shared the latest research results being carried out by many institutes, including computational pathology, intelligent analysis of medical images, micron resolution OCT imaging, surgical robots, brain science and neuroimaging, medical big data analysis, and full-stack AI multi-omics solutions.

blocks.text_en: Xu Jun introduced the research institute’s interdisciplinary construction of industry, academia, and medicine, as well as its future development direction.

blocks.text_en: Xu Jun introduced the background, philosophy, goals and research areas of the Smart Medical Research Institute

blocks.text_zh: 在交流中，马余强一行肯定了智慧医疗研究院在医工交叉学科领域所取得的成绩，认为这是大力推进“健康中国”战略的重要举措。他强调，医工交叉学科建设是高等教育发展的重要领域，需要不断探索创新、加强学科交叉融合，培养复合型、创新型人才，为国家健康事业的发展做出更大的贡献。同时，也希望研究院进一步加强学科建设，拓展合作交流，积极开展科技创新，并形成自身发展的优势特色，为推进国家健康事业作出更多的贡献。
blocks.text_en: During the exchange, Ma Yuqiang and his delegation affirmed the achievements of the Smart Medical Research Institute in the interdisciplinary field of medicine and engineering, believing that this is an important measure to vigorously promote the "Healthy China" strategy. He emphasized that the interdisciplinary construction of medicine and engineering is an important area for the development of higher education. It is necessary to continuously explore and innovate, strengthen interdisciplinary integration, cultivate compound and innovative talents, and make greater contributions to the development of national health undertakings. At the same time, it is also hoped that the institute will further strengthen discipline construction, expand cooperation and exchanges, actively carry out scientific and technological innovation, and form its own advantages and characteristics for development, so as to make more contributions to promoting the national health cause.

title_zh: 芬兰坦佩雷大学Moncef Gabbouj院士莅临研究院指导

blocks.text_zh: 3月 24 日下午，欧洲科学院院士、芬兰科学院院士、芬兰坦佩雷大学 Moncef Gabbouj 教授莅临南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院指导。陪同 Gabbouj 教授来访的还有我校计算机学院于莉老师。智慧医疗研究院部分教师参加了本次学术交流活动，活动由我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of March 24, Professor Moncef Gabbouj, academician of the European Academy of Sciences, academician of the Academy of Finland, and University of Tampere, Finland, visited Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute for guidance. Professor Gabbouj was accompanied by Professor Yu Li from the School of Computer Science of our school. Some teachers from the Smart Medical Research Institute participated in this academic exchange event. The event was hosted by Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute.

blocks.text_zh: 徐军院长首先对 Moncef Gabbouj教授的来访表示热烈欢迎，接下来他 向 Gabbouj 教授介绍了智慧医疗研究院的研究理念、研究目标、医学专家团队与工科教师团队人员构成，以及具体的研究方向，包括计算病理、医学影像智能分析、脑科学与神经影像、电子病 历 数据挖掘、医学成像，跨模态、多组学数据融合与大数据分析的疾病全栈式多组学方案等。
blocks.text_en: Dean Xu Jun first extended a warm welcome to Professor Moncef Gabbouj. Next, he introduced to Professor Gabbouj the research philosophy, research goals, medical expert team and engineering teacher team composition of the Smart Medical Research Institute, as well as specific research directions, including computational pathology, intelligent analysis of medical imaging, brain science and neuroimaging, electronic medical record data mining, medical imaging, cross-modal, multi-omics data fusion and big data analysis of disease full-stack multi-omics solutions, etc.

blocks.text_zh: Gabbouj教授对研究院的研究工作进行指导
blocks.text_en: Professor Gabbouj guides the research work of the institute

blocks.text_zh: 随后， Gabbouj 教授与智慧医疗研究院教师一起探讨了如何将计算机视觉和人工智能等新兴技术应用到医疗领域中，以解决目前医疗行业中的诸多难题。 作为 计算机视觉领域的知名专家， Gabbouj 教授也介绍了他所领导的团队在智慧医疗领域的工作，并强调了人工智能在医疗领域的潜力和应用。 Gabbouj 教授在智慧医疗方面的研究主要涉及人工智能、机器学习和数据分析等方面，例如利用计算机视觉和机器学习技术来提高医疗图像的自动分析和诊断准确性，其研究成果已经应用于医学影像分析、患者监测特别是心电信号的分析以及疾病的诊断辅助等方面。他还特别指出，深度学习尽管已经被广泛应用于医学图像分析，但是深度学习固有的“黑箱”问题是限制其被临床广泛应用的瓶颈。他特别举例介绍他们团队曾经在构建深度学习辅助诊断模型时，做过一个有趣的实验。他们在模型的输入端巧妙地仅修改一个体素值就能够完全修改模型的诊断结果。由此可见，盲目建立深度学习诊断模型具有一定的风险，因此在这个方面需要非常谨慎，提升模型的可解释性至关重要。因此，他对智慧医疗研究院的正在进行的工科专家与临床医生进行深度合作的工作模式非常满意，并指出开展医工交叉合作的必要性。同时， 构建诊断模型时， 充分包括医学专家的领域知识非常重要，也是智慧医疗领域的重要发展方向。 Gabbouj 教授殷切期望智慧医疗研究院能够将这些先进的技术应用于实际的医疗场景中，从而辅助中国医生为患者提供更好的医疗服务，推动智慧医疗领域的发展。
blocks.text_en: Subsequently, Professor Gabbouj and teachers from the Smart Medical Research Institute discussed how to apply emerging technologies such as computer vision and artificial intelligence to the medical field to solve many problems in the current medical industry. As a well-known expert in the field of computer vision, Professor Gabbouj also introduced the work of his team in the field of smart medical care and emphasized the potential and application of artificial intelligence in the medical field. Professor Gabbouj’s research in smart healthcare mainly involves artificial intelligence, machine learning and data analysis. For example, computer vision and machine learning technologies are used to improve the automatic analysis and diagnostic accuracy of medical images. His research results have been applied to medical image analysis, patient monitoring, especially the analysis of electrocardiogram signals, and disease diagnosis assistance. He also specifically pointed out that although deep learning has been widely used in medical image analysis, the inherent "black box" problem of deep learning is a bottleneck that limits its widespread clinical application. He gave an example of an interesting experiment his team had done when building a deep learning-assisted diagnosis model. They cleverly modified just one voxel value at the model's input to completely modify the model's diagnostic results. It can be seen that there are certain risks in blindly building a deep learning diagnostic model, so we need to be very cautious in this aspect, and it is crucial to improve the interpretability of the model. Therefore, he is very satisfied with the ongoing in-depth cooperation between engineering experts and clinicians at the Smart Medical Research Institute, and pointed out the necessity of cross-collaboration between medicine and industry. At the same time, when building a diagnostic model, it is very important to fully include the domain knowledge of medical experts, which is also an important development direction in the smart medical field. Professor Gabbouj earnestly hopes that the Smart Medical Research Institute can apply these advanced technologies in actual medical scenarios, thereby assisting Chinese doctors in providing better medical services to patients and promoting the development of the smart medical field.

blocks.text_en: Teachers Li Jin, Luo Yuemei, Wan Zhuo, Zeng Xian, Gan Xiao, and Jiao Yiping from the Smart Medical Research Institute introduced their ongoing research work to Professor Gabbouj, which mainly includes electronic medical record data mining, clinical application of Micro-OCT optical imaging technology, multi-modal brain imaging, network science and biomedical complex systems, clinical big data-driven medical clinical intelligent auxiliary decision-making, pathological image analysis, etc. Professor Gabbouj was very interested in these works and provided in-depth discussions and guidance.

blocks.text_zh: Moncef Gabbouj 教授简介 ：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Professor Moncef Gabbouj:

blocks.text_zh: Moncef Gabbouj是芬兰坦佩雷大学计算机科学教授，担任欧洲科学院院士、芬兰科学院院士。他于 1985 年获得俄克拉荷马州立大学的学士学位，分别在 1986 年和 1989 年获得普渡大学电气工程的硕士和博士学位。 Gabbouj教授是欧洲计算机视觉领域的知名专家， 在计算机视觉、图像处理和模式识别等领域做出了杰出贡献。他 是欧洲科学院院士、芬兰科学院院士、IEEE会士， 欧洲科学院和芬兰科学与文学学院委员， 曾在多所知名大学担任教授职位，包括法国南锡大学、荷兰代尔夫特理工大学、瑞士苏黎世联邦理工学院等。他是 IEEE Fourier Award for Signal Processing 委员， IEEE CASS 的杰出讲者，曾担任 IEEE CAS TC on DSP 的主席， IEEE ISCAS 2019 、 ICIP 2020 、 ICIP 2024 和 ICME 2021 的共同主席，担任多个 IEEE 系列等国际期刊的副编辑和特邀编辑。 Gabbouj 教授是美国 NSF IUCRC 资助的视觉和决策信息中心（ CVDI ）芬兰站站长，并领导了芬兰经济事务和就业部资助的自主系统研究联盟（ RAAS ）的人工智能研究工作组。 Gabbouj 教授的研究领域主要集中在数字图像处理、模式识别和计算机视觉等方面，包括基于计算机视觉的心脏病诊断系统、基于深度学习的图像分割方法等，并在 IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence 、 IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems 、 IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering 等相关国际顶级学术期刊和会议上发表了众多高水平的论文。
blocks.text_en: Moncef Gabbouj is a professor of computer science at the University of Tampere, Finland, and a member of the European Academy of Sciences and the Academy of Finland. He received his bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 1985 and his master's and doctorate degrees in electrical engineering from Purdue University in 1986 and 1989, respectively. Professor Gabbouj is a well-known expert in the field of computer vision in Europe and has made outstanding contributions in the fields of computer vision, image processing and pattern recognition. He is an academician of the European Academy of Sciences, an academician of the Academy of Finland, a fellow of the IEEE, a member of the European Academy of Sciences and the Finnish Academy of Sciences and Letters. He has held professorships in many well-known universities, including the University of Nancy in France, the Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands, and the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology in Zurich. He is a committee member of the IEEE Fourier Award for Signal Processing, a distinguished speaker of IEEE CASS, served as the chairman of IEEE CAS TC on DSP, the co-chairman of IEEE ISCAS 2019, ICIP 2020, ICIP 2024 and ICME 2021, and served as an associate editor and guest editor of multiple IEEE series and other international journals. Professor Gabbouj is the Finland Station Director of the Center for Vision and Decision Information (CVDI) funded by the NSF IUCRC, USA, and leads the artificial intelligence research working group of the Research Alliance for Autonomous Systems (RAAS) funded by the Finnish Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment. Professor Gabbouj’s research fields mainly focus on digital image processing, pattern recognition and computer vision, including heart disease diagnosis systems based on computer vision, image segmentation methods based on deep learning, etc. He has published many high-level papers in relevant top international academic journals and conferences such as IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, and IEEE Transactions on Biomedical Engineering.

title_zh: 人工智能学院（未来技术学院）开展留学申请交流会

blocks.text_zh: 6月26日，人工智能学院（未来技术学院）在信息科技大楼A101-102举办留学申请交流会，邀请在美国几所著名大学就读的徐戈杨、庞羽琪、刘芥桤3位大三学生分别分享他们在美国大学学习信息学、统计学和数据科学等专业课程的经历经验。学院青年教师及30多位大三学生参加活动。会议由李瑾博士主持。
blocks.text_en: On June 26, the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) held a study abroad application exchange meeting in A101-102 of the Information Technology Building. Three junior students, Xu Geyang, Pang Yuqi, and Liu Jiehui, who studied at several well-known universities in the United States, were invited to share their experiences in studying professional courses such as informatics, statistics, and data science in American universities. Young teachers from the college and more than 30 junior students participated in the event. The meeting was chaired by Dr. Li Jin.

blocks.text_zh: 徐戈杨、庞羽琪、刘芥桤三位同学从学校特色、院系设置、课程设置、校内社团组织和课余生活等方面入手进行分享。来自美国华盛顿大学的徐戈杨同学详细介绍了她所在的信息学院(iSchool)的学业内容，和她所主攻的信息学专业方向生物医学与健康信息学(Biomedical & Health Informatics)的发展分支；来自美国弗吉尼亚大学的庞羽琪同学介绍了她正在学习的统计学专业课程设置等相关内容。来自美国加州大学圣地亚哥分校的刘芥桤同学主要围绕数据科学专业课程设计以及高阶课程安排进行了交流。通过交流，与会的同学对国外大学的学习和生活有了更加深刻的认识。
blocks.text_en: Three students, Xu Geyang, Pang Yuqi and Liu Jiehuo, shared their views on the characteristics of the school, departmental settings, curriculum, on-campus community organizations and extracurricular life. Xu Geyang from the University of Washington in the United States introduced in detail the academic content of her School of Information (iSchool) and the development branch of Biomedical & Health Informatics (Biomedical & Health Informatics), her main major in informatics; Pang Yuqi from the University of Virginia in the United States introduced the curriculum of the statistics major she is studying and other related content. Liu Jiehe, a student from the University of California, San Diego, mainly exchanged views on the design of data science professional courses and the arrangement of advanced courses. Through exchanges, the participating students gained a deeper understanding of study and life in foreign universities.

blocks.text_zh: 随后，大家前往南信大-中大医院智慧医疗研究院参观，首先，学院副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授对智慧医疗研究院相关情况和研究领域进行了详细介绍。他介绍了目前智慧医疗研究院主要聚焦的四个研究领域：病理人工智能辅助诊疗和预后，医学影像成像与分析，脑科学与神经影像以及多组学与医学大数据分析。接下来，具有海外留学经历的青年教师针对参会学生们关心的海外留学申请进行了指导。毕业于新加坡南洋理工大学的罗月梅博士着重为同学们介绍了南洋理工大学研究生申请注意事项以及科研工作开展方面的内容；毕业于美国宾夕法尼亚州立大学的甘晓博士，分享了申请美国硕博连读的经历和美国研究生学业的相关事项。李瑾博士在浙江大学攻读博士期间前往牛津大学进行联合培养，她为同学们介绍了牛津大学的情况以及她在牛津大学学习期间课余生活和当地的风土人情，让同学们受益匪浅。
blocks.text_en: Afterwards, everyone visited the Smart Medical Research Institute of Nanjing University of Science and Technology-CUHK Hospital. First, Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the college and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute, gave a detailed introduction to the relevant information and research fields of the Smart Medical Research Institute. He introduced the current four research areas that the Smart Medical Research Institute is focusing on: pathological artificial intelligence-assisted diagnosis, treatment and prognosis, medical imaging and analysis, brain science and neuroimaging, and multi-omics and medical big data analysis. Next, young teachers with overseas study experience provided guidance on overseas study applications that the participating students were concerned about. Dr. Luo Yuemei, who graduated from Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, focused on introducing to the students the matters needing attention in applying for postgraduate studies at Nanyang Technological University and the development of scientific research work; Dr. Gan Xiao, who graduated from Pennsylvania State University in the United States, shared his experience in applying for a master's and doctoral program in the United States and matters related to postgraduate studies in the United States. Dr. Li Jin went to Oxford University for joint training during her doctoral studies at Zhejiang University. She introduced the situation of Oxford University to the students, her extracurricular life during her studies at Oxford University, and the local customs, which benefited the students a lot.

blocks.text_zh: 通过此次交流，我院学生对国外大学的学习和生活有了更加深入的了解，对如何准备国外大学研究生申请有了更加具体和清晰的理解。最后，徐军教授带领学生参观和介绍了智慧医疗研究院中国介入与多学科肝癌联盟（CHANGE），中国肝脏与门静脉高压联盟(CHESS)以及手术与介入机器人等。
blocks.text_en: Through this exchange, students in our school have a deeper understanding of study and life in foreign universities, and a more specific and clear understanding of how to prepare for postgraduate applications to foreign universities. Finally, Professor Xu Jun led the students to visit and introduce the China Interventional and Multidisciplinary Liver Cancer Alliance (CHANGE) of the Smart Medical Research Institute, the China Liver and Portal Hypertension Alliance (CHESS), and surgical and interventional robots.

title_zh: 特邀新加坡科技局（A*STAR）余维淼教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 4月10日下午，南京信息工程大学-中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡科技局（A*STAR）余维淼教授来校作学术报告，报告题目为《从传统病理转变到AI驱动的数字病理诊断五个必要步骤》。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，会议采用线下+线上（腾讯会议和蔻享学术）结合的方式，腾讯会议线上、线下参会的教师、学生共60余人，寇享直播平台听众点击量约2000次。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of April 10, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Professor Yu Weimiao from the Singapore Science and Technology Agency (A*STAR) to the school to give an academic report. The report was titled "Five Necessary Steps from Traditional Pathology to AI-driven Digital Pathology Diagnosis". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (School of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. The meeting adopted a combination of offline + online (Tencent Conference and Kouxiang Academic). There were more than 60 teachers and students participating in the Tencent Conference online and offline, and the Kouxiang Live Broadcast Platform received about 2,000 clicks from the audience.

blocks.text_zh: 余维淼博士的报告主要围绕着基于人工智能的病理诊断如何成功部署临床这一问题展开。余博士的报告首先回顾基于人工智能的病理诊断这一领域的发展现状，分析当前该领域面临的困难、挑战和瓶颈，包括技术和非技术方面的考虑。针对这些瓶颈和挑战，讨论和总结出加速临床应用AI病理诊断模型开发所需的五个必要步骤，包括图像质量方案-标准、数据标定方案-标准、训练数据方案、模型训练与优化方案、验证实用与模型迭代方案。余博士详细介绍了他的团队分别在这五个方面做的大量扎实的研究工作，包括开发了多个在现有生态系统中缺失的关键解决方案如数字病理质量管理系统、云端结构化并行标定系统、病理诊断方案优化和验证方案，同时推动新加坡标准化数字病理标定数据库的建立等。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Yu Weimiao's report mainly focused on how to successfully deploy pathological diagnosis based on artificial intelligence in clinical practice. Dr. Yu's report first reviewed the current development status of the field of pathological diagnosis based on artificial intelligence, and analyzed the difficulties, challenges and bottlenecks currently faced in this field, including technical and non-technical considerations. In response to these bottlenecks and challenges, the five necessary steps required to accelerate the development of AI pathological diagnosis models for clinical application were discussed and summarized, including image quality plan-standard, data calibration plan-standard, training data plan, model training and optimization plan, verification practical and model iteration plan. Dr. Yu introduced in detail the substantial research work his team has done in these five areas, including the development of a number of key solutions missing in the existing ecosystem, such as digital pathology quality management systems, cloud-based structured parallel calibration systems, pathological diagnosis solution optimization and verification solutions, and promoting the establishment of Singapore's standardized digital pathology calibration database.

blocks.text_zh: 报告期间学术氛围浓厚，线下参会的师生踊跃提问，余博士针对提问一一做出了细致的回答，同时就病理图像质量控制、病理图像标准化建设等领域内相关问题与余博士进行了广泛而深入的互动与交流。
blocks.text_en: During the report period, the academic atmosphere was strong. Teachers and students participating in the offline meeting enthusiastically asked questions. Dr. Yu gave detailed answers to the questions one by one. At the same time, they had extensive and in-depth interactions and exchanges with Dr. Yu on related issues in the fields of pathological image quality control, pathological image standardization construction, etc.

blocks.text_zh: 余 维 淼 博 士 简 介 ：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Dr. Yu Weimiao:

blocks.alt_zh: 特邀新加坡科技局（A*STAR）余维淼教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 余 维 淼 博 士 于 2 0 0 7 年 获 得 新 加 坡 国 立 大 学 （ N U S ） 博 士 学 位 ， 主 修 图 像 处 理 和 机 器 视 觉 。 他 于 2 0 0 7 年 加 入 新 加 坡 科 技 研 究 局 （ A * S T A R ） ， 并 于 2 0 1 0 年 加 入 分 子 与 细 胞 生 物 学 研 究 所 （ I M C B ） 。 他 目 前 领 导 的 生 物 信 息 学 研 究 所 （ B I I ） 的 计 算 数 字 病 理 学 实 验 室 （ C D P L ） 和 I M C B 的 计 算 分 子 与 病 理 学 实 验 室 （ C M P L ） ， 旨 在 深 化 和 扩 展 与 临 床 和 工 业 合 作 伙 伴 的 研 发 。 他 的 研 究 兴 趣 是 计 算 生 物 医 学 图 像 分 析 和 生 物 医 学 图 像 中 的 定 量 图 像 信 息 学 。 余 博 士 的 研 究 成 果 发 表 在 国 际 顶 级 同 行 评 审 期 刊 上 ， 如 《 自 然 细 胞 生 物 学 》 、 《 自 然 通 讯 》 、 《 当 代 生 物 学 》 等 。 他 以 前 的 研 究 成 果 已 成 功 商 业 化 ， 并 对 诊 断 和 药 物 发 现 产 生 了 影 响 。 为 了 加 强 机 器 学 习 和 人 工 智 能 在 临 床 诊 断 / 预 后 中 的 应 用 ， 他 在 新 加 坡 成 立 了 一 家 名 为 A ! m a g i n o s t i c P t e . L t d 的 生 物 技 术 有 限 公 司 。 他 建 立 了 一 个 世 界 级 的 组 织 水 平 免 疫 诊 断 平 台 。 该 平 台 允 许 研 究 人 员 、 临 床 医 生 和 制 药 公 司 分 析 患 者 的 免 疫 特 征 ， 以 进 行 诊 断 、 预 后 和 药 物 反 应 研 究。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Yu Weimiao received his PhD from the National University of Singapore (NUS) in 2007, majoring in image processing and machine vision. He joined the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) in Singapore in 2007 and the Institute of Molecular and Cellular Biology (IMCB) in 2010. He currently leads the Computational Digital Pathology Laboratory (CDPL) of the Bioinformatics Institute (BII) and the Computational Molecular and Pathology Laboratory (CMPL) of IMCB, aiming to deepen and expand research and clinical research. Research and development of beds and industrial partners. His research interests are computational biomedical image analysis and quantitative image informatics in biomedical images. Dr. Yu’s research results have been published in top international peer-reviewed journals, such as Nature Cell Biology, Nature Communications, and Current Biology. His previous research results have been successfully commercialized and have impacted diagnostics and drug discovery. In order to strengthen the application of machine learning and artificial intelligence in clinical diagnosis/prognosis, he established a biotechnology company called A!maginostic Pte. Ltd. in Singapore. He established a world-class tissue-level immune diagnostic platform. The platform allows researchers, clinicians and pharmaceutical companies to analyze patients' immune signatures for diagnosis, prognosis and drug response studies.

blocks.text_zh: 智 慧 医 疗 研 究 院 介 绍
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Smart Medical Research Institute

blocks.text_zh: 南京信息工程大学-智慧医疗研究院由中国科学院院士滕皋军教授担任院长，徐军教授任执行院长。 研究院瞄准智慧医疗领域的新理念、新技术、新方法，旨在打造国内一流、国际知名的前沿与医工交叉研究平台。
blocks.text_en: Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology-Smart Medical Research Institute is headed by Professor Teng Gaojun, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, as the dean, and Professor Xu Jun as the executive dean. The institute aims at new concepts, new technologies, and new methods in the field of smart medical care, aiming to create a first-class domestic and internationally renowned cutting-edge and medical-engineering cross-research platform.

blocks.text_zh: 研 究 院 的 理 念 是 ： 源 于 临 床 ， 高 于 临 床 ， 赋 能 临 床 ， 回 归 临 床 。 首 先 ， 医 工 交 叉 的 研 究 团 队 研 究 的 问 题 来 源 于 临 床 ， 致 力 于 凝 炼 和 探 索 解 决 医 学 与 健 康 学 科 前 沿 领 域 的 重 大 科 学 问 题 。 通 过 发 表 有 影 响 力 的 学 术 论 文 ， 期 望 能 够 引 领 和 推 动 某 些 前 沿 领 域 的 发 展 。 其 次 ， 致 力 于 推 动 智 慧 医 疗 领 域 研 究 成 果 的 落 地 和 转 化 ， 使 得 研 究 成 果 真 正 服 务 于 临 床 ， 实 际 解 决 临 床 问 题 ， 让 患 者 获 益 。
blocks.text_en: The philosophy of the institute is: Originating from clinical practice, superior to clinical practice, empowering clinical practice, and returning to clinical practice. First of all, the problems studied by the research team at the intersection of medicine and engineering originate from clinical practice and are committed to condensing and exploring and solving major scientific issues in the cutting-edge fields of medicine and health disciplines. By publishing influential academic papers, we hope to lead and promote the development of certain cutting-edge fields. Secondly, we are committed to promoting the implementation and transformation of research results in the field of smart medical care, so that the research results can truly serve the clinic, actually solve clinical problems, and benefit patients.

blocks.text_zh: 研 究 院 以 医 工 学 科 交 叉 为 支 撑 ， 促 进 人 工 智 能 、 大 数 据 、 机 器 人 、 电 子 信 息 、 自 动 化 、 计 算 机 等 信 息 工 科 与 医 学 领 域 的 深 度 融 合 与 交 叉 ， 推 动 医 学 人 工 智 能 科 技 创 新 和 成 果 转 化 。 研 究 院 积 极 探 索 “ 科 研 与 教 学 有 机 结 合 、 创 新 与 应 用 相 互 促 进 、 高 校 与 医 院 协 同 发 展 ” 的 长 效 机 制 ， 通 过 校 院 之 间 平 台 建 设 、 科 研 合 作 、 成 果 转 化 等 密 切 协 作 ， 促 进 创 新 资 源 深 度 融 合 ， 加 快 新 工 科 和 新 医 科 发 展 ， 培 养 理 、 工 、 医 兼 具 的 复 合 型 、 创 新 型 人 才 。
blocks.text_en: The institute is supported by the intersection of medical and engineering disciplines, promoting the in-depth integration and intersection of artificial intelligence, big data, robots, electronic information, automation, computers and other information engineering and medical fields, and promoting Medical artificial intelligence technology innovation and achievement transformation. The research institute actively explores the long-term mechanism of "organic combination of scientific research and teaching, mutual promotion of innovation and application, and coordinated development of universities and hospitals", through the construction of platforms between schools and colleges, scientific research cooperation, and achievements. We should work closely together to achieve fruit transformation and other fields, promote the in-depth integration of innovative resources, accelerate the development of new engineering and new medical sciences, and cultivate compound and innovative talents with a combination of science, engineering, and medicine.

blocks.text_zh: 研 究 院 师 资 力 量 雄 厚 ， 包 括 滕 皋 军 院 士 在 内 的 资 深 医 学 专 家 2 0 余 名 ， 徐 军 教 授 等 工 学 专 家 1 3 名 。 依 托 南 京 信 息 工 程 大 学 人 工 智 能 学 院 ( 未 来 技 术 学 院 ) ， 研 究 院 的 工 学 专 家 平 均 年 龄 3 1 岁 ， 高 级 职 称 3 人 、 国 家 级 人 才 1 人 、 省 部 级 人 才 4 人 ， 1 0 0 % 具 有 海 外 留 学 经 历 ， 6 2 % 在 海 外 获 得 博 士 学 位 ， 9 0 % 以 上 在 中 国 、 美 国 、 英 国 等 Q S 排 名 前 2 0 0 位 的 顶 尖 高 校 获 得 博 士 学 位 ， 是 一 支 高 水 平 、 具 有 较 好 国 际 视 野 、 来 源 多 元 化 和 多 样 化 、 年 轻 且 富 有 朝 气 的 队 伍 。 研 究 院 面 向 全 球 长 期 诚 聘 海 内 外 高 层 次 人 才 ， 欢 迎 推 荐 优 秀 人 才 加 盟 我 们 ！
blocks.text_en: The institute has a strong faculty, including more than 20 senior medical experts including Academician Teng Gaojun, and 13 engineering experts such as Professor Xu Jun. Relying on the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) of Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, the average age of engineering experts in the institute is 31 years old, 3 have senior professional titles, 1 is a national-level talent, and 4 are provincial-level talents. , 100% have overseas study experience, 62% have obtained a doctorate degree overseas, and more than 90% have obtained a doctorate degree from the top 200 QS universities in China, the United States, the United Kingdom, etc., yes A team with high level, good international vision, diverse and diverse sources, young and energetic team. The institute is looking for long-term and long-term recruitment of high-level talents from all over the world. Welcome to recommend outstanding talents to join us!

blocks.text_zh: 南京信息工程大学—中大医院智慧医疗研究院具有良好的办公条件和设施。研究院新购置的硬件设备包括：徕卡高通量切片扫描仪GT450一台，高性能计算集群一套（包括管理服务器、2PB存储服务器、5个GPU节点、5个多核大内存计算节点）。
blocks.text_en: Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology-Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute has good office conditions and facilities. The newly purchased hardware equipment of the institute includes: a Leica high-throughput slide scanner GT450, and a high-performance computing cluster (including a management server, 2PB storage server, 5 GPU nodes, and 5 multi-core large memory computing nodes).

title_zh: 昆山市副市长纪芳一行莅临智慧医疗研究院调研

blocks.text_zh: 4 月 11 日上午，昆山市副市长纪芳率领市人才办等相关部门负责人一行到南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院进行调研指导，我校 化学与材料学院 党委书记杨春艳，校党委组织部副部长刘雨华陪同参观。
blocks.text_en: On the morning of April 11, Kunshan Vice Mayor Ji Fang led a delegation of heads of the Municipal Talent Office and other relevant departments to the Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute for research and guidance. Yang Chunyan, Secretary of the Party Committee of the School of Chemistry and Materials of our school, and Liu Yuhua, Deputy Director of the Organization Department of the School Party Committee, accompanied the visit.

blocks.text_zh: 我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授详细介绍了智慧医疗研究院的建设背景、理念、目标和研究领域。他通过产业背景、地理位置、师资力量、发展机遇和态势等几方面介绍了智慧医疗研究院广阔的发展前景，分析了人类在健康领域仍然面临的诸多重大挑战性问题，指出人工智能技术赋能医疗领域的重要意义和潜在的临床价值。徐军带领考察团参观了智慧医疗研究院，介绍了研究院的发展历程、技术特点以及正在进行的前沿研究领域，分享了多项研究院正在开展的最新研究成果，包括计算病理、医学影像智能分析、微米分辨率 OCT 成像、手术机器人、脑科学与神经影像以及医学大数据分析等。
blocks.text_en: Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, introduced in detail the construction background, concepts, goals and research fields of the Smart Medical Research Institute. He introduced the broad development prospects of the Smart Medical Research Institute through industrial background, geographical location, faculty, development opportunities and trends, analyzed the many major challenges that humans still face in the health field, and pointed out the importance and potential clinical value of artificial intelligence technology in empowering the medical field. Xu Jun led the delegation to visit the Smart Medical Research Institute, introducing the development history, technical characteristics and ongoing cutting-edge research areas of the institute, and shared a number of the latest research results being carried out by the institute, including computational pathology, intelligent analysis of medical images, micron resolution OCT imaging, surgical robots, brain science and neuroimaging, and medical big data analysis.

blocks.text_zh: 在交流中，纪芳一行对研究院在智慧医疗领域的取得的成果给予高度评价，期间，双方就依托自主创新引领产业技术创新和转化、研究成果在临床应用上的转化和落地，以及如何打造“生命健康岛”产业等话题进行了深入探讨。此次到访不仅加深了考察团对智慧医疗研究院的认识，也为昆山市政府相关部门深入了解先进的智慧医疗技术、促进医疗信息化进程提供了重要的参考和支持，推动了昆山市政府与智慧医疗研究院之间的交流与合作，为今后的合作发展奠定了坚实的基础。
blocks.text_en: During the exchange, Ji Fang and his party spoke highly of the institute's achievements in the field of smart medical care. During the period, the two parties had in-depth discussions on topics such as relying on independent innovation to lead industrial technology innovation and transformation, the transformation and implementation of research results in clinical applications, and how to create a "life and health island" industry. This visit not only deepened the delegation's understanding of the Smart Medical Research Institute, but also provided important reference and support for relevant departments of the Kunshan Municipal Government to have an in-depth understanding of advanced smart medical technology and promote the process of medical informatization. It promoted exchanges and cooperation between the Kunshan Municipal Government and the Smart Medical Research Institute, laying a solid foundation for future cooperative development.

blocks.text_zh: 为帮助学生深入了解科学研究前沿，引导同学们进一步明确在大学目标和努力方向， 3 月 16 日上午，人工智能学院（未来技术学院）组织智慧医疗社团部分成员以及各年级学生代表举赴南京信息工程大学智慧医疗研究院江北新区汇创园基地，开展参观访问和师生面对面交流活动。
blocks.text_en: In order to help students gain an in-depth understanding of the frontiers of scientific research and guide students to further clarify their goals and efforts in the university, on the morning of March 16, the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) organized some members of the smart medical community and student representatives of all grades to go to the Jiangbei New District Huichuang Park Base of the Smart Medical Research Institute of Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology to carry out visits and face-to-face exchanges between teachers and students.

blocks.text_zh: 人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授首先向同学生们详细介绍了智慧医疗研究院的建设背景、理念、目标和研究领域。他通过产业背景、地理位置、师资力量、发展机遇和态势等几方面介绍了智慧医疗研究院广阔的发展前景，分析了人类在健康领域仍然面临的诸多重大挑战性问题，指出人工智能技术赋能医疗领域的重要意义和潜在的临床价值。他鼓励学生们积极思考和努力培养自己感兴趣的领域和方向，设定自己未来的奋斗目标，希望同学们能努力学习，未来能够积极投身智慧医疗领域的科研事业。
blocks.text_en: Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute, first introduced the construction background, concepts, goals and research fields of the Smart Medical Research Institute to the students in detail. He introduced the broad development prospects of the Smart Medical Research Institute through industrial background, geographical location, faculty, development opportunities and trends, analyzed the many major challenges that humans still face in the health field, and pointed out the importance and potential clinical value of artificial intelligence technology in empowering the medical field. He encouraged students to actively think and work hard to cultivate their fields and directions of interest, and set their own goals for the future. He hoped that students could study hard and actively participate in scientific research in the field of smart medical care in the future.

blocks.text_zh: 同学们在徐军院长的带领下参观了智慧医疗研究院，深切地感受到了研究院浓厚的学术氛围。智慧医疗研究院的工学教师们也分别向参观的学生展示了研究院正在进行的前沿的研究领域，分享了多项令人激动的最新研究成果。在互动环节，师生们进行了深入沟通和交流，现场氛围热烈融洽。
blocks.text_en: The students visited the Smart Medical Research Institute under the leadership of Dean Xu Jun and deeply felt the strong academic atmosphere of the institute. The engineering teachers of the Smart Medical Research Institute also showed the cutting-edge research fields being conducted by the institute to the visiting students, and shared a number of exciting latest research results. During the interactive session, teachers and students had in-depth communication and exchanges, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.

title_zh: 智慧医疗研究院团队赴上海多家医院交流

blocks.text_zh: 随后，研究院团队与复旦肿瘤医院放射诊断科周正荣院长团队开展学术交流。 放射诊断 科 解添淞博士和刘伟博士分别进行了《神经内分泌肿瘤肝转移的影像诊断进展》和《胰腺癌影像学研究进展》的学术报告，向智慧医疗研究院工科团队介绍了当前神经内分泌肿瘤肝转移和胰腺癌的研究进展，提出了临床关切的科学问题。双方对如何使用先进的人工智能技术解决临床关切的问题开展了热烈的讨论，并拟定了进一步合作的计划。
blocks.text_en: Subsequently, the institute team conducted academic exchanges with the team of Director Zhou Zhengrong of the Department of Radiation Diagnosis of Fudan Cancer Hospital. Department of Radiation Diagnosis Dr. Xie Tiansong and Dr. Liu Wei gave academic reports on "Progress in Imaging Diagnosis of Neuroendocrine Tumor Liver Metastasis" and "Progress in Imaging Research of Pancreatic Cancer" respectively. They introduced the current research progress of neuroendocrine tumor liver metastasis and pancreatic cancer to the engineering team of the Smart Medical Research Institute, and raised scientific issues of clinical concern. The two parties had a heated discussion on how to use advanced artificial intelligence technology to solve clinical concerns and formulated plans for further cooperation.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院成立以来，在校领导及兄弟单位的关心支持下，积极向外拓展、交流合作，致力于促进人工智能新技术在临床工作中的创新性研究和应用落地。通过本次沟通和交流，智慧医疗研究院工科团队更进一步深入了解到医院的临床问题、需求和挑战，同时通过向临床医生分享智慧医疗研究院的最新研究成果和解决方案，可以加强双方的相互了解，以进一步凝练未来的合作方向。此次交流活动加强了智慧医疗研究院与国内顶尖医院之间的沟通和合作，有助于未来推动人工智能技术在医疗领域落地应用。
blocks.text_en: Since the establishment of the Smart Medical Research Institute, with the care and support of school leaders and sister units, it has actively expanded outward, communicated and cooperated, and is committed to promoting innovative research and application of new artificial intelligence technologies in clinical work. Through this communication and exchange, the engineering team of the Smart Medical Research Institute has a further in-depth understanding of the clinical problems, needs and challenges of the hospital. At the same time, by sharing the latest research results and solutions of the Smart Medical Research Institute with clinicians, the mutual understanding between the two parties can be strengthened to further condense the direction of future cooperation. This exchange event strengthened communication and cooperation between the Smart Medical Research Institute and top domestic hospitals, and will help promote the application of artificial intelligence technology in the medical field in the future.

title_zh: 智慧医疗研究院获批5项国家自然科学基金项目

blocks.text_zh: 8月24日，国家自然科学基金委员会发布《关于2023年国家自然科学基金集中接收申请项目评审结果的通告》，智慧医疗研究院宣锴、王向学、焦一平、张腾、李瑾获批国家自然科学基金项目。最近，智慧医疗研究院万卓和张腾还分别获批江苏省 自然科学基金青年项目，王向学获批江苏省高等学校自然科学项目。祝贺以上老师！
blocks.text_en: On August 24, the National Natural Science Foundation of China issued the "Notice on the Review Results of the National Natural Science Foundation's Centralized Acceptance of Application Projects in 2023". Xuan Kai, Wang Xiangxue, Jiao Yiping, Zhang Teng, and Li Jin of the Smart Medical Research Institute were approved for the National Natural Science Foundation project. Recently, Wan Zhuo and Zhang Teng of the Smart Medical Research Institute were approved for the Jiangsu Provincial Natural Science Foundation Youth Project, and Wang Xiangxue was approved for the Jiangsu Provincial College Natural Science Project. Congratulations to the above teachers!

title_zh: 数字病理+人工智能: 四亿细胞图谱解析乳腺癌生态型

blocks.text_zh: 从微观角度而言，一棵参天大树不仅只有树木本身，而是由众多不同生物及其复杂相互作用共同构成的庞大生态系统。同样， 乳腺癌 不仅只有 肿瘤细胞 ，也是由 炎症细胞、间质细胞 等众多不同细胞及其 复杂相互作用 共同构成的庞大 生态系统 。乳腺癌的生物学行为、预后和疗效不仅取决于 肿瘤细胞的特征 ，还取决于 其他细胞成分 及其 与肿瘤细胞的相互作用 。剖析乳腺癌生态系统组成及其不同类型细胞之间的关系，对于理解乳腺癌生物学行为和提高乳腺癌精准诊断治疗水平具有重要意义。 由于细胞是生命的基本单元，也是疾病发生、发展的基础。 传统病理利用苏木精伊红（H&E）染色切片和光学显微镜只能对少量细胞进行描述性分析； 随着数字病理被临床大规模采用 ，我们可以 运用 先进的数据和知识驱动的机器学习技术和数字图像处理技术 ，对高分辨数字化病理切片中 数以亿计的细胞及其组织结构中 多组学 海量数据开展 定量分析，以揭示疾病的发生、发展的趋势和规律，从而帮助我们更好地理解疾病并辅助医生制定最优的治疗策略。
blocks.text_en: From a microscopic perspective, a towering tree is not just the tree itself, but a huge ecosystem composed of many different organisms and their complex interactions. Similarly, breast cancer is not only composed of tumor cells, but also a huge ecosystem composed of many different cells such as inflammatory cells and stromal cells and their complex interactions. The biological behavior, prognosis and efficacy of breast cancer depend not only on the characteristics of tumor cells, but also on other cellular components and their interactions with tumor cells. Analyzing the composition of the breast cancer ecosystem and the relationship between different types of cells is of great significance for understanding the biological behavior of breast cancer and improving the level of accurate diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer. Since cells are the basic unit of life, they are also the basis for the occurrence and development of diseases. Traditional pathology can only perform descriptive analysis on a small number of cells using hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained sections and optical microscopy; as digital pathology is adopted on a large scale in clinical practice, we can use advanced data and knowledge-driven machine learning technology and digital image processing technology to carry out multi-omics and massive data on hundreds of millions of cells and their tissue structures in high-resolution digital pathology sections. Quantitative analysis can reveal the trends and patterns of disease occurrence and development, thereby helping us better understand the disease and assist doctors in formulating optimal treatment strategies.

blocks.text_zh: 2023年10月25日， 智慧医疗研究院徐军教授团队与 复旦大学附属肿瘤医院邵志敏教授团队合作的论文《单细胞形态和拓扑图谱揭示了乳腺癌的生态系统多样性》 的论文在 英国《自然》旗下《自然·通讯》杂志在线发表。 智慧医疗研究院硕士生陈德品和 复旦大学附属肿瘤医院赵珅、傅彤、杨竞成为本文共同第一作者 。复旦大学附属肿瘤医院 乳腺外科邵志敏教授、江一舟教授, 病理科杨文涛教授，智慧医疗研究院徐军教授为本文共同通讯作者。 在国家自然科学基金重大研究计划的支持下，由复旦大学乳腺外科与病理科以及智慧医疗研究院人工智能等多学科团队深度合作，融合 机器学习、数学图论、 数字图像处理 等多学科知识，首创 肿瘤单细胞形态与拓扑学分析算法（sc-MTOP） ，绘制了 包含4.1亿个细胞的乳腺癌单细胞图谱 ，全面刻画了 乳腺癌生态系统多样性 ，为 数字病理 与 人工智能 赋能乳腺癌精准诊疗提供了全新的视角。
blocks.text_en: On October 25, 2023, the paper "Single cell morphology and topological maps reveal the ecosystem diversity of breast cancer", a collaboration between Professor Xu Jun's team at the Smart Medical Research Institute and Professor Shao Zhimin's team at Fudan University Cancer Hospital, was published online in the "Nature Communications" magazine of the British "Nature". Chen Depin, a master's student at the Smart Medical Research Institute, and Zhao Shen, Fu Tong, and Yang Jing from Fudan University Cancer Hospital became the co-first authors of this article. Professor Shao Zhimin and Professor Jiang Yizhou from the Breast Surgery Department of Fudan University Cancer Hospital, Professor Yang Wentao from the Department of Pathology, and Professor Xu Jun from the Smart Medical Research Institute are the co-corresponding authors of this article. With the support of major research projects of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, multidisciplinary teams such as the Department of Breast Surgery and Pathology of Fudan University and the Artificial Intelligence of the Smart Medical Research Institute collaborated in depth, integrating multidisciplinary knowledge such as machine learning, mathematical graph theory, and digital image processing to create the first single-cell tumor morphology and topology analysis algorithm (sc-MTOP). A single-cell map of breast cancer containing 410 million cells was drawn, comprehensively depicting the diversity of the breast cancer ecosystem, and providing a basis for digital pathology and artificial intelligence. Empowering precise diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer provides a new perspective.

blocks.text_zh: 首先，研究人员将sc-MTOP应用于复旦大学附属肿瘤医院 637例 乳腺癌（ 405例 激素受体阳性HER2阴性、 85例 激素受体阳性HER2阳性、 66例 激素受体阴性HER2阳性、 81例 三阴性）数字病理切片图像进行定理分析，对约4.1亿个细胞提取单个细胞的核形态和细胞空间分布关系特征，从而可以对乳腺肿瘤生态系统进行定量分析。
blocks.text_en: First, the researchers applied sc-MTOP to 637 cases of breast cancer (405 cases of hormone receptor positive and HER2 negative, 85 cases of hormone receptor positive and HER2 positive, 66 cases of hormone receptor negative and HER2 positive, and 81 cases of triple negative) in the Tumor Hospital of Fudan University for theorem analysis. The nuclear morphology and cell spatial distribution relationship characteristics of single cells were extracted from approximately 410 million cells, allowing for quantitative analysis of the breast tumor ecosystem.

blocks.text_zh: 图1: sc-MTOP分析及其生成的数据集
blocks.text_en: Figure 1: sc-MTOP analysis and its generated data set

blocks.text_zh: 随后，该研究构建了 4.1亿个细胞的单细胞图谱 ，其中包括 1.9亿个肿瘤细胞（47.1%）、6685万个炎症细胞（16.3%）、1.4亿个基质细胞（34.6%）、860万个正常乳腺细胞（2.1%） ，并分别剖析了肿瘤细胞、炎症细胞、基质细胞的表现型多样性。
blocks.text_en: Subsequently, the study constructed a single cell atlas of 410 million cells, including 190 million tumor cells (47.1%), 66.85 million inflammatory cells (16.3%), 140 million stromal cells (34.6%), and 8.6 million normal breast cells (2.1%), and analyzed the phenotypic diversity of tumor cells, inflammatory cells, and stromal cells respectively.

blocks.text_zh: 图2: 炎症细胞的单细胞图谱
blocks.text_en: Figure 2: Single-cell atlas of inflammatory cells

blocks.text_zh: 图3：肿瘤细胞和基质细胞的单细胞图谱
blocks.text_en: Figure 3: Single cell atlas of tumor cells and stromal cells

blocks.text_zh: 最后，该研究通过空间分布对代表局部多细胞结构的 微生态模式 与 无复发生存 进行分析，揭示了不同 分子特征 与患者 无复发生存 相关的 四种乳腺癌生态型 。
blocks.text_en: Finally, this study analyzed microecological patterns representing local multicellular structures and recurrence-free survival through spatial distribution, revealing four breast cancer ecotypes with different molecular characteristics associated with patients' recurrence-free survival.

blocks.text_zh: 图4：肿瘤细胞和基质细胞的单细胞图谱
blocks.text_en: Figure 4: Single-cell atlas of tumor cells and stromal cells

blocks.text_zh: 图5：不同微生态模式的乳腺癌生态型与分子特征和患者无复发生存相关
blocks.text_en: Figure 5: Breast cancer ecotypes with different microbial patterns are associated with molecular characteristics and patient recurrence-free survival.

blocks.text_zh: 对多组学数据进一步分析，揭示了有临床意义的生态系统特征： 三阴性乳腺癌 局部聚集大量炎症细胞，可提示肿瘤微环境免疫激活，有利于免疫治疗效果； 激素受体阳性乳腺癌 肿瘤细胞核形态学异质性，可提示细胞周期通路激活和 CDK 抑制剂疗效。
blocks.text_en: Further analysis of multi-omics data revealed clinically significant ecosystem characteristics: Triple-negative breast cancer has a large number of local accumulation of inflammatory cells, which can indicate immune activation in the tumor microenvironment, which is beneficial to the effect of immunotherapy; hormone receptor-positive breast cancer has tumor cell nuclear morphological heterogeneity, which can indicate cell cycle pathway activation and the efficacy of CDK inhibitors.

blocks.text_zh: 图6：三阴性乳腺癌炎症细胞局部聚集丰度可以提示免疫治疗效果
blocks.text_en: Figure 6: The local accumulation and abundance of inflammatory cells in triple-negative breast cancer can indicate the effect of immunotherapy

blocks.text_zh: 图7：激素受体阳性乳腺癌肿瘤细胞核形态学异质性可以提示细胞周期通路活性和CDK抑制剂疗效
blocks.text_en: Figure 7: Nuclear morphological heterogeneity in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer tumors can indicate cell cycle pathway activity and CDK inhibitor efficacy.

blocks.text_zh: 因此，该研究结果表明， sc-MTOP 算法能够对数字病理切片图像从单细胞水平剖析肿瘤生态系统， 数字病理 联合 人工智能 已经成为复旦大学附属肿瘤医院乳腺癌精准分型体系下独具特色的研究方向及重要转化工具。
blocks.text_en: Therefore, the results of this study show that the sc-MTOP algorithm can analyze the tumor ecosystem from the single cell level on digital pathology section images. Digital pathology combined with artificial intelligence has become a unique research direction and important transformation tool under the breast cancer accurate classification system of Fudan University Cancer Hospital.
