blocks.text_zh: 李琼，博士，中共党员，南京信息工程大学人工智能学院（未来技术学院）师资博士后，智能医学图像计算江苏高校重点实验室及智慧医疗研究院核心成员。 2017 年于山东师范大学获得计算机科学与技术专业工学学士学位， 2020 年于广西大学获计算机应用技术专业工学硕士学位， 2026 年于北京师范大学获计算机应用技术专业工学博士学位。博士期间，参与多项跨学科研究项目，聚焦于计算机视觉、模式识别等领域，具备丰富的实验设计与算法开发经验。目前研究方向包括：计算机视觉、医学人工智能与辅助诊疗等。
blocks.text_en: Li Qiong, Ph.D., is a member of the Communist Party of China, a postdoctoral fellow at the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology), Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, and a core member of the Jiangsu University Key Laboratory of Intelligent Medical Image Computing and the Smart Medical Research Institute. He received a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Technology from Shandong Normal University in 2017, a Master of Engineering in Computer Application Technology from Guangxi University in 2020, and a Doctor of Engineering in Computer Application Technology from Beijing Normal University in 2026. During his PhD, he participated in a number of interdisciplinary research projects, focusing on computer vision, pattern recognition and other fields, and has rich experience in experimental design and algorithm development. Current research directions include: computer vision, medical artificial intelligence, and auxiliary diagnosis and treatment.

blocks.text_zh: 近五年以第一作者或共同作者身份在 IEEE/CAA JAS 、 IEEE JBHI 、 Neurocomputing 、 ICASSP 等国际期刊和会议发表多篇高水平论文，在图神经网络、 Transformer 、多模态融合及大语言模型应用等方面具有扎实的理论基础与工程实践能力。
blocks.text_en: In the past five years, he has published many high-level papers as the first author or co-author in international journals and conferences such as IEEE/CAA JAS, IEEE JBHI, Neurocomputing, ICASSP, etc. He has a solid theoretical foundation and engineering practice capabilities in graph neural networks, Transformer, multi-modal fusion and large language model applications.

title_zh: Anant Madabhushi

blocks.text_zh: Dr Madabhushi’s pioneering work in developing novel machine vision and AI based approaches for interrogating routinely acquired digital pathology and radiology scans is helping oncologists treat patients suffering from brain, lung, prostate, colorectal, breast, and blood cancer. Most recently, to help combat COVID-19, he adapted technology from his work on lung cancer to create a new artificial intelligence tool that uses computers to digitally analyze CT scans to identify patients who require ventilators for the coronavirus5. He places special emphasis on eliminating racial disparities in medicine by identifying underlying biological variations in disease appearance between populations, which can then be specifically targeted, to enable population-based personalized risk calculators. He is also taking this logic to another minority population, Veterans, where their unique exposure to wartime environments and particular lifestyle choices, make them different from the civilian population and thus requiring training with Veteran data.
blocks.text_en: Dr Madabhushi’s pioneering work in developing novel machine vision and AI based approaches for interrogating routinely acquired digital pathology and radiology scans is helping oncologists treat patients suffering from brain, lung, prostate, colorectal, breast, and blood cancer. Most recently, to help combat COVID-19, he adapted technology from his work on lung cancer to create a new artificial intelligence tool that uses computers to digitally analyze CT scans to identify patients who require ventilators for the coronavirus5. He places special emphasis on eliminating racial disparities in medicine by identifying underlying biological variations in disease appearance between populations, which can then be specifically targeted, to enable population-based personalized risk calculators. He is also taking this logic to another minority population, Veterans, where their unique exposure to wartime environments and particular lifestyle choices, make them different from the civilian population and thus requiring training with Veteran data.

blocks.text_zh: His work also addresses critical issues in bioethics, health disparities, and health care costs6. For example, he is part of a group of researchers at CWRU and in Uganda and Tanzania who recently received a $5M NIH global health grant to establish an HIV-associated malignancy research center focused on lung cancer in East Africa. The team will investigate novel approaches to characterize lung cancer epidemiology, somatic mutation burden, HIV and accelerated aging, and radiological features of lung cancer and the relationship to HIV-1 infection.
blocks.text_en: His work also addresses critical issues in bioethics, health disparities, and health care costs6. For example, he is part of a group of researchers at CWRU and in Uganda and Tanzania who recently received a $5M NIH global health grant to establish an HIV-associated malignancy research center focused on lung cancer in East Africa. The team will investigate novel approaches to characterize lung cancer epidemiology, somatic mutation burden, HIV and accelerated aging, and radiological features of lung cancer and the relationship to HIV-1 infection.

blocks.text_zh: Dr Madabhushi’s work places an emphasis on eliminating racial disparities in medicine by developing AI tools that employ population-specific risk-prediction models to identify underlying biological variations in disease appearance between races—allowing disease to be medically targeted with more accuracy. He also stresses the importance of recognizing potential bias in the data and understanding the diversity of the research pool. Under a new partnership, he will be working with Hampton University, a historically Black research university in Virginia, to develop AI tools for addressing cancer disparities. The technologies will help pinpoint which Black men undergoing proton therapy for prostate cancer are likely to respond to treatment. This partnership builds on Dr Madabhushi’s work showing critical cellular variations between Black and White prostate cancer patients (discussed below).

He also stresses the importance of recognizing potential bias in the data and understanding the diversity of the research pool. Under a new partnership, he will be working with Hampton University, a historically Black research university in Virginia, to develop AI tools for addressing cancer disparities. The technologies will help pinpoint which Black men undergoing proton therapy for prostate cancer are likely to respond to treatment. This partnership builds on Dr Madabhushi’s work showing critical cellular variations between Black and White prostate cancer patients (discussed below).

blocks.text_zh: The research thrust of Dr Madabhushi and his team is developing algorithms and similar computational approaches to visually highlight and extract complex, “sub-visual,” minute physical features from image data from MRIs, CT scans, and digital-pathology tissue images. Physicians can use the presence of these biomarkers—which they cannot typically see when reviewing the images unaided—for detecting and treating serious illnesses. For example, Dr Madabhushi has developed image-segmentation, detection, and feature-analysis algorithms to pinpoint the structure and arrangement of various cells and nuclei (i.e., biomarkers) in pathology images, physical features which are correlated with many types of cancer, rates of progression, and potential to benefit from specific treatments, e.g., immunotherapy vs. chemotherapy y. Dr Madabhushi’s work makes maximum use of routinely acquired medical imaging scans and tissue slide images. The digital tests he is developing are relatively low cost and can be deployed through the cloud and the internet, enabling a global footprint. His work flows from the fact that no matter how well trained and medically experienced, the limited human eye will inevitably miss crucial signs and signals in CT scans, MRIs, and digital pathology. His research is built on two further premises. First, applying computer science, machine learning, and AI to clinical problems will transform our ability to personalize treatment (precision medicine)—providing the right treatment to the right patient at the right time. Resources are also thereby conserved for both health systems, e.g., fewer trials of multiple therapies, and individuals, e.g., fewer visits and co-payments, lower out of pocket expenses, and a reduction in lost wages.

blocks.text_zh: Second, as a scientist Dr Madabhushi is committed to addressing the diagnostic and predictive needs of his physician colleagues. In addition to those from Case Western Reserve, he has partnered with many physician-scientists, clinicians, and researchers from Cleveland Clinic, Louis Stokes Cleveland VA Medical Center, University Hospitals, and MetroHealth, a nationally ranked public health care system in Cleveland. As noted above, international partnerships with global colleagues are vital to his modus operandi, and he has more than 40 collaborations on six continents.

blocks.text_zh: Dr Madabhushi’s approach to AI in health, stresses integrating domain knowledge from the medical and biomedical spectrum into sophisticated AI, machine learning, and computational-science templates—ensuring that clinicians play a central role in the solution. Care providers are more apt to trust and use technologies that they comprehend and to whose development they have contributed.

title_zh: 南京信息工程大学人工智能学院2024研究生招生宣讲
title_en: Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology School of Artificial Intelligence 2024 Graduate Admissions Announcement

title_zh: 智慧医疗研究院长期招收优秀硕士、博士研究生及博士后

blocks.text_zh: 招收方向
blocks.text_en: Recruitment direction

blocks.text_zh: 研究院长期招收人工智能、生物医学工程、计算机科学、自动化、数学、统计、生物信息学、脑科学、电子工程、机器学习、计算机视觉、图像分析、医学图像计算、机器人、医学材料、医疗器械、光学仪器等领域的 优秀硕士、博士研究生及博士后 。
blocks.text_en: The institute has long-term recruitment of outstanding master's degree students, doctoral students and postdoctoral students in the fields of artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, computer science, automation, mathematics, statistics, bioinformatics, brain science, electronic engineering, machine learning, computer vision, image analysis, medical image computing, robotics, medical materials, medical equipment, optical instruments and other fields.

blocks.text_zh: 招收条件
blocks.text_en: Recruitment conditions

blocks.text_zh: （一）硕士招收条件
blocks.text_en: (1) Master’s degree admission conditions

blocks.text_zh: 1. 通过南京信息工程大学硕士研究生初试和复试；
blocks.text_en: 1. Pass the preliminary examination and re-examination for master’s degree at Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology;

blocks.text_zh: 2. 具有人工智能、生物医学工程、计算机科学、自动化、数学、统计、生物信息学、脑科学、电子工程、机器学习、计算机视觉、图像分析、医学图像计算、机器人、医学材料、医疗器械或光学仪器等相关学科背景；
blocks.text_en: 2. Have a background in related disciplines such as artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, computer science, automation, mathematics, statistics, bioinformatics, brain science, electronic engineering, machine learning, computer vision, image analysis, medical image computing, robotics, medical materials, medical equipment or optical instruments;

blocks.text_zh: 3. 主观能动性好，较强的责任心和上进心，良好的沟通协调能力。
blocks.text_en: 3. Have good subjective initiative, strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation, and good communication and coordination skills.

blocks.text_zh: （二）博士招收要求
blocks.text_en: (2) PhD recruitment requirements

blocks.text_zh: 1. 通过南京信息工程大学博士研究生初试和复试；
blocks.text_en: 1. Pass the preliminary examination and re-examination for doctoral studies at Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology;

blocks.text_zh: 2. 具有人工智能、生物医学工程、计算机科学、自动化、数学、统计、生物信息学、脑科学、电子工程、机器学习、计算机视觉、图像分析、医学图像计算、机器人、医学材料、医疗器械或光学仪器等相关学科背景；
blocks.text_en: 2. Have a background in related disciplines such as artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, computer science, automation, mathematics, statistics, bioinformatics, brain science, electronic engineering, machine learning, computer vision, image analysis, medical image computing, robotics, medical materials, medical equipment or optical instruments;

blocks.text_zh: 3. 具有良好的科研潜力和综合能力；
blocks.text_en: 3. Have good scientific research potential and comprehensive ability;

blocks.text_zh: 4. 主观能动性好，较强的责任心和上进心，良好的沟通协调能力。
blocks.text_en: 4. Have good subjective initiative, strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation, and good communication and coordination skills.

blocks.text_zh: （三）博士后招收要求
blocks.text_en: (3) Postdoctoral recruitment requirements

blocks.text_zh: 1. 在国（境）内外获得博士学位的研究工作人员（含外籍人员）；获得博士学位不超过3年的博士毕业生，年龄在35周岁以下；
blocks.text_en: 1. Research staff (including foreign personnel) who have obtained a doctoral degree at home or abroad; doctoral graduates who have obtained a doctoral degree no more than 3 years ago and are under the age of 35;

blocks.text_zh: 2. 具有人工智能、生物医学工程、计算机科学、自动化、数学、统计、生物信息学、脑科学、电子工程、机器学习、计算机视觉、图像分析、医学图像计算、机器人、医学材料、医疗器械或光学仪器等相关学科背景；
blocks.text_en: 2. Have a background in related disciplines such as artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, computer science, automation, mathematics, statistics, bioinformatics, brain science, electronic engineering, machine learning, computer vision, image analysis, medical image computing, robotics, medical materials, medical equipment or optical instruments;

blocks.text_zh: 3. 具有良好的科研潜力和综合能力；
blocks.text_en: 3. Have good scientific research potential and comprehensive ability;

blocks.text_zh: 4. 主观能动性好，较强的责任心和上进心；
blocks.text_en: 4. Good subjective initiative, strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation;

blocks.text_zh: 5. 良好的团队合作和沟通协调能力，优秀的英文书面表达能力。
blocks.text_en: 5. Good teamwork, communication and coordination skills, and excellent written English skills.

blocks.text_zh: 博士后工资待遇
blocks.text_en: Postdoctoral salary

blocks.text_zh: 纳入南信大“龙山学者支持计划”，在学校博士后管理相关规定基础上提供有市场竞争性待遇条件，并可以协助申请中国博士后创新基金、博新计划、卓博计划、“引进项目计划”，”特别资助（站前）“计划相关项目等资助；年薪由学校和合作导师共同确定承担，年薪25万元起，同时帮助申请公寓或租房补贴、子女上学等优厚福利；出站后可参加学校人才招聘，同等条件下优先录取。
blocks.text_en: Included in the "Longshan Scholar Support Plan" of Nanjing University of Science and Technology, it provides market-competitive treatment conditions based on the relevant regulations of the school's postdoctoral management, and can assist in applying for China Postdoctoral Innovation Fund, Boxin Plan, Zhuobo Plan, "Introduction Project Plan", "Special Funding (in front of the Station)" plan related projects, etc.; the annual salary is jointly determined by the school and the cooperating tutor, with an annual salary starting from 250,000 yuan. It also helps to apply for apartments or rental subsidies, children's schooling and other generous benefits; after leaving the station, you can participate in the school's talent recruitment, and priority admission will be given under the same conditions.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院简介
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Smart Medical Research Institute

blocks.text_zh: 为响应国家“健康中国”“数字经济”战略，南京信息工程大学、中大医院依托南京江北新区“生命产业培育计划”和国家健康医疗大数据（东部）中心，集聚全球人才资源及创新要素，携手共建国内一流的医工交叉协同创新平台：智慧医疗研究院。 研究院的建设体现了“天时、地利、人和”，正在建设中的中大医院江北新院区与南京信息工程大学校园仅一墙之隔，院校之间的物理空间距离很近，因此，这里将是开展前沿医工交叉领域科学探索、临床转化研究、研究成果应用落地的最佳地点 。
blocks.text_en: In response to the national "Healthy China" and "Digital Economy" strategies, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology and Zhongda Hospital rely on the "Life Industry Cultivation Plan" of Nanjing Jiangbei New District and the National Health and Medical Big Data (Eastern) Center to gather global human resources and innovation elements to jointly build a first-class domestic medical-industry cross-collaborative innovation platform: the Smart Medical Research Institute. The construction of the institute embodies "the right time, the right location, and the right people." The new Jiangbei campus of Zhongda Hospital under construction is only separated from the campus of Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology. The physical distance between the institutions is very close. Therefore, it will be the best place to carry out scientific exploration, clinical translation research, and application of research results in the cutting-edge medical and engineering fields.

blocks.text_zh: 南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院瞄准智慧医疗的新理念、新技术、新方法，旨在打造国内一流、国际知名的前沿与交叉研究平台，由中国科学院院士滕皋军教授担任院长，徐军教授任执行院长。 研究院师资力量雄厚，包括滕皋军院士在内的资深医学专家 20 余名， 徐军教授等 工学专家 13 名。依托南京信息工程大学人工智能学院 ( 未来技术学院 ) ，研究院的工学专家平均年龄 31 岁，高级职称 3 人、国家级人才 1 人、省部级人才 4 人， 100% 具有海外留学经历， 62% 在海外获得博士学位， 90% 以上在中国、美国、英国等 QS 排名前 200 位的顶尖高校获得博士学位，是一支高水平、具有较好国际视野、来源多元化和多样化、年轻且富有朝气的队伍。 研究院以医工学科交叉为支撑，致力于探索解决医学与健康学科前沿领域的重大科学问题，促进人工智能、大数据、机器人、电子信息等信息工科与医学领域的深度融合与交叉，推动医学人工智能科技创新和成果转化。 研究院积极探索 “科研与教学有机结合、创新与应用相互促进、高校与医院协同发展” 的长效机制，通过校院之间平台建设、科研合作、成果转化等密切协作，促进创新资源深度融合，加快新工科和新医科发展，培养理、工、医兼具的复合型、创新型人才。
blocks.text_en: Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute aims at new concepts, new technologies, and new methods of smart medical care, aiming to create a domestic first-class and internationally renowned cutting-edge and cross-cutting research platform. Professor Teng Gaojun, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, serves as the dean, and Professor Xu Jun serves as the executive dean. The institute has a strong faculty, including more than 20 senior medical experts including Academician Teng Gaojun, and 13 engineering experts including Professor Xu Jun. Relying on the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) of Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, the average age of the institute's engineering experts is 31 years old. There are 3 senior professional titles, 1 national-level talent, and 4 provincial-level talents. 100% have overseas study experience, 62% have obtained a doctorate degree overseas, and more than 90% are ranked in the top 200 of QS in China, the United States, and the United Kingdom. They have obtained doctorate degrees from top universities. They are a high-level team with good international vision, diverse and diversified sources, young and energetic team. Supported by the intersection of medical and engineering disciplines, the institute is committed to exploring and solving major scientific problems in the frontier fields of medicine and health disciplines, promoting the in-depth integration and intersection of artificial intelligence, big data, robotics, electronic information and other information engineering and medical fields, and promoting scientific and technological innovation and achievement transformation of medical artificial intelligence. The institute actively explores the long-term mechanism of "organic integration of scientific research and teaching, mutual promotion of innovation and application, and coordinated development of universities and hospitals". Through close collaboration between schools and colleges, such as platform construction, scientific research cooperation, and achievement transformation, it promotes the deep integration of innovative resources, accelerates the development of new engineering and new medical disciplines, and cultivates comprehensive and innovative talents with a combination of science, engineering, and medicine.

blocks.text_zh: 研究院整合南京江北新区、南京信息工程大学、中大医院的优势学科、高端人才以及医疗数据等资源，聚焦 手术机器人域导航、医学影像智能诊断、医学大数据、医疗器械与材料、气候变化与健康风险 五个领域开展国际前沿和原创性研究。
blocks.text_en: The institute integrates the advantageous disciplines, high-end talents, and medical data resources of Nanjing Jiangbei New Area, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology, and Zhongda Hospital to carry out international cutting-edge and original research in five areas: surgical robot domain navigation, medical imaging intelligent diagnosis, medical big data, medical devices and materials, and climate change and health risks.

title_zh: 人工智能学院(未来技术学院)诚聘海内外优秀学者

blocks.text_zh: 一、学校简介
blocks.text_en: 1. School Introduction

blocks.text_zh: 南京信息工程大学是国家“双一流”建设高校 和江苏高水平大学建设高峰计划 A 类建设高校。学校主校区坐落于南京市江北新区（国家级新区）核心区域。现有 7 个一级学科博士点、 44 个一级学科（专业）硕士点以及 75 个本科专业，并设有 4 个博士后流动站。大气科学在学科评估中连续两轮名列全国第一，地球科学、工程学、计算机科学、环境科学与生态学、化学、农业科学、材料科学、社会科学总论等 8 个学科跻身 ESI 全球排名前 1% ，其中地球科学和计算机科学进入 ESI 全球排名前 1 ‰。
blocks.text_en: Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology is a national “double first-class” construction university and a Class A construction university in Jiangsu High-level University Construction Peak Plan. The main campus of the school is located in the core area of ​​Jiangbei New District (national-level new district) in Nanjing City. There are currently 7 first-level discipline doctoral programs, 44 first-level discipline (professional) master's degree programs, 75 undergraduate majors, and 4 postdoctoral mobile stations. Atmospheric science has ranked first in the country for two consecutive rounds in the subject evaluation. Eight disciplines including earth science, engineering, computer science, environmental science and ecology, chemistry, agricultural science, materials science, and general social science have ranked among the top 1% of ESI global rankings. Among them, earth science and computer science have entered the top 1‰ of ESI global rankings.

blocks.text_zh: 二、学院简介
blocks.text_en: 2. Introduction to the College

blocks.text_zh: （一）学科平台
blocks.text_en: (1) Subject platform

blocks.text_zh: 人工智能学院（未来技术学院）（以下统称学院）现有本科生 780 余人、全日制研究生 119 人。学院设有人工智能、信息工程 2 个本科专业 ，拥有 “ 人工智能 ” 二级学科博士、硕士学位授权点和 “ 电子信息 ” ( 人工智能方向 ) 专业硕士授权点，形成了涵盖本、硕、博的完整人 才培养体系。其中人工智能专业是教育部 2019 年批准设置的首批 35 个人工智能本科专业之一，人工智能学科是“十四五”江苏省重点学科，信息工程专业是江苏省一流本科专业。人工智能产业学院是我国首批教育部 50 个国家现代产业学院之一， 2020 年 6 月获批为江苏省首批重点建设产业学院。学院瞄准数字经济发展新赛道，凝练元宇宙、智慧气象、智慧医疗与大数据等 3 个特色学科发展方向，并组建了 3 个实体研究团队与研究院：元宇宙研究院、智慧气象研究院、智慧医疗研究院。其中智慧医疗研究院是我校与中大医院共建的具有医工交叉鲜明特色的学科平台。
blocks.text_en: The College of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) (hereinafter collectively referred to as the college) currently has more than 780 undergraduate students and 119 full-time graduate students. The college has two undergraduate majors: Artificial Intelligence and Information Engineering. It has Ph.D. and master's degree authorization points in the secondary discipline of "Artificial Intelligence" and professional master's degree authorization points in "Electronic Information" (artificial intelligence direction), forming a complete talent training system covering undergraduate, master's and doctoral degrees. Among them, the artificial intelligence major is one of the first 35 artificial intelligence undergraduate majors approved by the Ministry of Education in 2019. The artificial intelligence discipline is a key discipline in Jiangsu Province during the 14th Five-Year Plan, and the information engineering major is a first-class undergraduate major in Jiangsu Province. The College of Artificial Intelligence Industry is one of the first 50 national modern industrial colleges established by the Ministry of Education in my country. In June 2020, it was approved as one of the first batch of key industrial colleges in Jiangsu Province. Aiming at the new track of digital economic development, the college has condensed the development direction of three distinctive disciplines: Yuanverse, Smart Meteorology, Smart Healthcare and Big Data, and has established three physical research teams and research institutes: Yuanverse Research Institute, Smart Meteorology Research Institute, and Smart Medical Research Institute. Among them, the Smart Medical Research Institute is a disciplinary platform with distinctive features of the intersection of medicine and engineering, jointly built by our school and Zhongda Hospital.

blocks.text_zh: （二）师资队伍
blocks.text_en: (2) Teaching staff

blocks.text_zh: 学院师资力量雄厚，现有专任教师 60 余人，其中正高级职称 10 人，副高级职称 18 人， 95% 具有博士学位，大部分毕业于中国、美国、英国等国家顶尖高校，研究领域前沿且具有较好的国际视野。师资队伍中包括国家杰青 2 人，教育部特聘教授 1 人，教育部讲座教授 1 人，国家海外引才启明计划 1 人， IEEE Fellow 3 人，国家重点研发计划项目首席科学家 1 人；获国家科技进步二等奖 1 人，获国家自然科学二等奖 1 人；高被引学者 3 人；浙江省特聘教授，江苏省“ 333 工程 ” 培养对象等省部级人才 20 余人次。
blocks.text_en: The college has a strong teaching staff, with more than 60 full-time teachers, including 10 with senior professional titles and 18 with deputy senior professional titles. 95% have doctoral degrees. Most of them graduated from top universities in China, the United States, the United Kingdom and other countries. They have cutting-edge research fields and a good international perspective. The teaching staff includes 2 National Distinguished Young Scholars, 1 Distinguished Professor of the Ministry of Education, 1 Chair Professor of the Ministry of Education, 1 National Overseas Talent Introduction Qiming Program, 3 IEEE Fellows, 1 Chief Scientist of the National Key R&D Program; 1 winner of the Second Prize of the National Science and Technology Progress Award, 1 winner of the Second Prize of the National Natural Science Award; 3 Highly Cited Scholars; Distinguished Professor of Zhejiang Province, "333 Project" of Jiangsu Province More than 20 provincial and ministerial level talents have been trained.

blocks.text_zh: 三、招聘岗位
blocks.text_en: 3. Recruitment positions

blocks.text_zh: 1. 招聘人数： 面向海内外招聘各层次高端人才、学术骨干、优秀师资若干名 。
blocks.text_en: 1. Number of recruits: Recruiting several high-end talents, academic backbones, and outstanding teachers at all levels at home and abroad.

blocks.text_zh: 2. 招聘学科与领域方向：
blocks.text_en: 2. Recruitment disciplines and fields:

blocks.text_zh: ① 计算机科学、生物医学工程、人工智能、自动化、应用数学、统计、电子信息、虚拟现实与增强现实、机器学习、模式识别、计算机视觉、图像分析、医学图像计算、脑科学、生物信息学、数字媒体、人机交互、情感识别与交互、智慧气象、智能气候预测、智能遥感、机器人、医学材料、医疗器械等相关领域与研究方向；
blocks.text_en: ① Computer science, biomedical engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, applied mathematics, statistics, electronic information, virtual reality and augmented reality, machine learning, pattern recognition, computer vision, image analysis, medical image computing, brain science, bioinformatics, digital media, human-computer interaction, emotion recognition and interaction, smart weather, smart climate prediction, smart remote sensing, robots, medical materials, medical equipment and other related fields and research directions;

blocks.text_zh: ② 运用人工智能技术与元宇宙、气象、医学等多学科交叉的研究领域或研究方向。
blocks.text_en: ② Research fields or research directions that use artificial intelligence technology to intersect with the metaverse, meteorology, medicine and other disciplines.

blocks.text_zh: 3. 人才类别： （ 1 ）领军人才；（ 2 ）学术带头人；（ 3 ）学术骨干；（ 4 ）优秀师资。
blocks.text_en: 3. Talent categories: (1) Leading talents; (2) Academic leaders; (3) Academic backbones; (4) Excellent teachers.

blocks.text_zh: 四、招聘条件和待遇
blocks.text_en: 4. Recruitment conditions and benefits

blocks.text_zh: 学校给予录用人员 ( 非兼职 ) 高校事业编制，学校提供国内一流的薪资待遇、完善的科研条件和强大的团队支持。优秀人才还可申请南京信息工程大学“龙山学者支持计划”、“青年人才托举计划”、“名师培育工程”等人才项目。鼓励以团队形式加盟，团队成员须满足学校招聘条件。引进人才均须满足《南京信息工程大学高层次人才招聘启事（ 2022 年）》中相应类别基本条件，同时应满足以下学科条件。可叠加享受学校和学院提供的待遇。
blocks.text_en: The school provides the recruited personnel (non-part-time) with university career establishment. The school provides domestic first-class salary packages, perfect scientific research conditions and strong team support. Excellent talents can also apply for Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology's "Longshan Scholar Support Program", "Young Talent Promotion Program", "Famous Teacher Cultivation Project" and other talent projects. Joining as a team is encouraged, and team members must meet the school’s recruitment requirements. All introduced talents must meet the basic conditions for the corresponding categories in the "Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology High-Level Talent Recruitment Notice (2022)", and should also meet the following subject conditions. Benefits provided by schools and colleges can be stacked.

blocks.text_zh: （一）领军人才
blocks.text_en: (1) Leading talents

blocks.text_zh: 1. 招聘条件

title_zh: 新加坡科技局（A*STAR）余维淼教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 2023年4月10日下午，南京信息工程大学-中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡科技局（A*STAR）余维淼教授来校作学术报告，报告题目为《从传统病理转变到AI驱动的数字病理诊断五个必要步骤》。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，会议采用线下+线上（腾讯会议和蔻享学术）结合的方式，腾讯会议线上、线下参会的教师、学生共60余人，寇享直播平台听众点击量约2000次。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of April 10, 2023, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Professor Yu Weimiao from the Singapore Science and Technology Agency (A*STAR) to come to the school to give an academic report. The report was titled "Five Necessary Steps from Traditional Pathology to AI-driven Digital Pathology Diagnosis". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (School of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. The meeting adopted a combination of offline + online (Tencent Conference and Kouxiang Academic). There were more than 60 teachers and students participating in the Tencent Conference online and offline, and the Kouxiang Live Broadcast Platform received about 2,000 clicks from the audience.

blocks.text_zh: 余维淼博士的报告主要围绕着基于人工智能的病理诊断如何成功部署临床这一问题展开。余博士的报告首先回顾基于人工智能的病理诊断这一领域的发展现状，分析当前该领域面临的困难、挑战和瓶颈，包括技术和非技术方面的考虑。针对这些瓶颈和挑战，讨论和总结出加速临床应用AI病理诊断模型开发所需的五个必要步骤，包括图像质量方案-标准、数据标定方案-标准、训练数据方案、模型训练与优化方案、验证实用与模型迭代方案。余博士详细介绍了他的团队分别在这五个方面做的大量扎实的研究工作，包括开发了多个在现有生态系统中缺失的关键解决方案如数字病理质量管理系统、云端结构化并行标定系统、病理诊断方案优化和验证方案，同时推动新加坡标准化数字病理标定数据库的建立等。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Yu Weimiao's report mainly focused on how to successfully deploy pathological diagnosis based on artificial intelligence in clinical practice. Dr. Yu's report first reviewed the current development status of the field of pathological diagnosis based on artificial intelligence, and analyzed the difficulties, challenges and bottlenecks currently faced in this field, including technical and non-technical considerations. In response to these bottlenecks and challenges, the five necessary steps required to accelerate the development of AI pathological diagnosis models for clinical application were discussed and summarized, including image quality plan-standard, data calibration plan-standard, training data plan, model training and optimization plan, verification practical and model iteration plan. Dr. Yu introduced in detail the substantial research work his team has done in these five areas, including the development of a number of key solutions missing in the existing ecosystem, such as digital pathology quality management systems, cloud-based structured parallel calibration systems, pathological diagnosis solution optimization and verification solutions, and promoting the establishment of Singapore's standardized digital pathology calibration database.

blocks.text_zh: 报告期间学术氛围浓厚，线下参会的师生踊跃提问，余博士针对提问一一做出了细致的回答，同时就病理图像质量控制、病理图像标准化建设等领域内相关问题与余博士进行了广泛而深入的互动与交流。
blocks.text_en: During the report period, the academic atmosphere was strong. Teachers and students participating in the offline meeting enthusiastically asked questions. Dr. Yu gave detailed answers to the questions one by one. At the same time, they had extensive and in-depth interactions and exchanges with Dr. Yu on related issues in the fields of pathological image quality control, pathological image standardization construction, etc.

blocks.text_zh: 余 维 淼 博 士 简 介 ：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Dr. Yu Weimiao:

blocks.alt_zh: 新加坡科技局（A*STAR）余维淼教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 余 维 淼 博 士 于 2 0 0 7 年 获 得 新 加 坡 国 立 大 学 （ N U S ） 博 士 学 位 ， 主 修 图 像 处 理 和 机 器 视 觉 。 他 于 2 0 0 7 年 加 入 新 加 坡 科 技 研 究 局 （ A * S T A R ） ， 并 于 2 0 1 0 年 加 入 分 子 与 细 胞 生 物 学 研 究 所 （ I M C B ） 。 他 目 前 领 导 的 生 物 信 息 学 研 究 所 （ B I I ） 的 计 算 数 字 病 理 学 实 验 室 （ C D P L ） 和 I M C B 的 计 算 分 子 与 病 理 学 实 验 室 （ C M P L ） ， 旨 在 深 化 和 扩 展 与 临 床 和 工 业 合 作 伙 伴 的 研 发 。 他 的 研 究 兴 趣 是 计 算 生 物 医 学 图 像 分 析 和 生 物 医 学 图 像 中 的 定 量 图 像 信 息 学 。 余 博 士 的 研 究 成 果 发 表 在 国 际 顶 级 同 行 评 审 期 刊 上 ， 如 《 自 然 细 胞 生 物 学 》 、 《 自 然 通 讯 》 、 《 当 代 生 物 学 》 等 。 他 以 前 的 研 究 成 果 已 成 功 商 业 化 ， 并 对 诊 断 和 药 物 发 现 产 生 了 影 响 。 为 了 加 强 机 器 学 习 和 人 工 智 能 在 临 床 诊 断 / 预 后 中 的 应 用 ， 他 在 新 加 坡 成 立 了 一 家 名 为 A ! m a g i n o s t i c P t e . L t d 的 生 物 技 术 有 限 公 司 。 他 建 立 了 一 个 世 界 级 的 组 织 水 平 免 疫 诊 断 平 台 。 该 平 台 允 许 研 究 人 员 、 临 床 医 生 和 制 药 公 司 分 析 患 者 的 免 疫 特 征 ， 以 进 行 诊 断 、 预 后 和 药 物 反 应 研 究。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Yu Weimiao received his PhD from the National University of Singapore (NUS) in 2007, majoring in image processing and machine vision. He joined the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) in Singapore in 2007 and the Institute of Molecular and Cellular Biology (IMCB) in 2010. He currently leads the Computational Digital Pathology Laboratory (CDPL) of the Bioinformatics Institute (BII) and the Computational Molecular and Pathology Laboratory (CMPL) of IMCB, aiming to deepen and expand research and clinical research. Research and development of beds and industrial partners. His research interests are computational biomedical image analysis and quantitative image informatics in biomedical images. Dr. Yu’s research results have been published in top international peer-reviewed journals, such as Nature Cell Biology, Nature Communications, and Current Biology. His previous research results have been successfully commercialized and have impacted diagnostics and drug discovery. In order to strengthen the application of machine learning and artificial intelligence in clinical diagnosis/prognosis, he established a biotechnology company called A!maginostic Pte. Ltd. in Singapore. He established a world-class tissue-level immune diagnostic platform. The platform allows researchers, clinicians and pharmaceutical companies to analyze patients' immune signatures for diagnosis, prognosis and drug response studies.

title_zh: 新加坡南洋理工大学刘琳波教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 3月3日下午，南京信息工程大学-中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡南洋理工大学刘琳波教授来校作学术报告，报告题目为“微米分辨率OCT技术及应用”。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，会议采用线下+线上（腾讯会议和蔻享学术）结合的方式，参会的教师、学生共40余人。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of March 3, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Professor Liu Linbo from Nanyang Technological University in Singapore to give an academic report. The report was titled "Micrometer Resolution OCT Technology and Application". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. The meeting was a combination of offline + online (Tencent Conference and Koxiang Academic). There were more than 40 teachers and students participating in the meeting.

blocks.text_zh: 刘琳波教授的报告主要分为以下三个方面：（1）光学相干层析成像（Optical Coherence Tomography, OCT）的简介和应用场景；（2）现有OCT技术应用的瓶颈以及微米分辨率OCT（Micro-OCT）的创新点；（3）团队相关实验工作。
blocks.text_en: Professor Liu Linbo’s report is mainly divided into the following three aspects: (1) Introduction and application scenarios of Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT); (2) Bottlenecks in the application of existing OCT technology and innovations in micron resolution OCT (Micro-OCT); (3) Team-related experimental work.

blocks.text_zh: 首先，刘教授介绍了OCT检查的优势，即它不同于有创的病理检查，它是一种无损、无辐射、非接触的断层成像技术，更易于被患者所接受，并且OCT能够提供微米级的空间分辨率和毫米级的穿透深度，非常适合人体粘膜层的高速、大范围成像，所以广泛应用于粘膜疾病的临床诊断。接下来，刘教授分析了现有OCT技术应用的瓶颈，其中之一是其有限的空间分辨率（5-10微米），无法清晰分辨大部分人体细胞和亚细胞结构（1-2微米），而刘教授团队所研究的Micro-OCT是一种1微米级分辨率的OCT技术，这种技术通过采用干涉光谱拼接等方法能够达到1微米级的轴向分辨率，同时通过多孔径合成和数字重聚焦技术，提高了横向分辨率和扩展焦深。
blocks.text_en: First of all, Professor Liu introduced the advantages of OCT examination, that is, it is different from invasive pathological examination. It is a non-destructive, non-radiation, non-contact tomographic imaging technology, which is more easily accepted by patients. Moreover, OCT can provide micron-level spatial resolution and millimeter-level penetration depth, which is very suitable for high-speed and large-scale imaging of human mucosal layers, so it is widely used in the clinical diagnosis of mucosal diseases. Next, Professor Liu analyzed the bottlenecks in the application of existing OCT technology. One of them is its limited spatial resolution (5-10 microns), which cannot clearly distinguish most human cells and subcellular structures (1-2 microns). The Micro-OCT studied by Professor Liu's team is an OCT technology with a resolution of 1 micron. This technology can achieve axial resolution of 1 micron by using methods such as interference spectrum splicing. At the same time, it improves lateral resolution and extended depth of focus through multi-aperture synthesis and digital refocusing technology.

blocks.text_zh: 报告中，刘教授介绍了他们在南洋理工大学团队已经基于Micro-OCT技术进行了一系列动物和人体实验以验证这个先进的成像技术，包括针对动物子宫颈上皮和膀胱动脉外膜，以及针对人体动脉的成像等。这些实验成功证明Micro-OCT能够清晰分辨多种上皮组织的亚细胞结构。同时，得益于分辨率的提高，Micro-OCT可以检测到气管中的纤毛并捕捉到它的运动形态，这为开展黏膜清除机制的相关研究提供技术支持。不仅如此，这些实验实验还进一步表明了Micro-OCT能够清晰分辨正常、低度上皮内瘤变和高度上皮内瘤变的细胞学特征，这对早期癌症的筛查和诊断领域具有潜在的应用价值。
blocks.text_en: In the report, Professor Liu introduced that their team at Nanyang Technological University has conducted a series of animal and human experiments based on Micro-OCT technology to verify this advanced imaging technology, including imaging of animal cervical epithelium and bladder artery adventitia, as well as imaging of human arteries. These experiments successfully demonstrated that Micro-OCT can clearly distinguish the subcellular structure of various epithelial tissues. At the same time, thanks to the improved resolution, Micro-OCT can detect cilia in the trachea and capture their movement patterns, which provides technical support for research on mucosal clearance mechanisms. Not only that, these experimental experiments further demonstrated that Micro-OCT can clearly distinguish the cytological characteristics of normal, low-grade intraepithelial neoplasia and high-grade intraepithelial neoplasia, which has potential application value in the field of early cancer screening and diagnosis.

blocks.text_zh: 报告的最后，刘教授向我们讲述当前Micro-OCT仍然面临的三大技术瓶颈：1）高横向分辨率与成像景深的限制问题；2）光学元件和成像组织引起的相差畸变对图像质量的影响；3）成像穿透深度不足的问题。为了降低上述情况对图像的影响，刘教授团队分别开展了相应的系统优化研究，旨在进一步推动Micro-OCT在实际临床上的应用。同时，随着人工智能技术的发展，刘教授也期待在以后的研究中能够结合机器学习技术，帮忙提高成像系统的性能。
blocks.text_en: At the end of the report, Professor Liu told us about the three major technical bottlenecks that Micro-OCT still faces: 1) the limitation of high lateral resolution and imaging depth of field; 2) the impact of phase distortion caused by optical components and imaging tissue on image quality; 3) the problem of insufficient imaging penetration depth. In order to reduce the impact of the above situations on images, Professor Liu's team carried out corresponding system optimization research, aiming to further promote the application of Micro-OCT in actual clinical applications. At the same time, with the development of artificial intelligence technology, Professor Liu also looks forward to combining machine learning technology in future research to help improve the performance of imaging systems.

blocks.text_zh: 报告期间学术氛围浓厚，东南大学附属中大医院介入与血管外科张毅主任以及中国医学科学院皮肤病医院病理科姜祎群主任就感兴趣的问题通过线上与刘教授进行了深入的讨论和交流。线下参会的师生也踊跃提问，刘教授也针对问题一一做出了细致的回答。同时对Mico-OCT成像技术未来的发展方向，以及在临床皮肤疾病的检测、消化系统疾病的早癌筛查，以及眼科领域的潜在应用等相关合作进行了深刻的探讨。
blocks.text_en: The academic atmosphere was strong during the report. Zhang Yi, director of the Interventional and Vascular Surgery Department of Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, and Jiang Yiqun, director of the Pathology Department of the Dermatology Hospital of the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, had in-depth discussions and exchanges with Professor Liu online on issues of interest. Teachers and students participating in the offline meeting also actively asked questions, and Professor Liu also gave detailed answers to the questions one by one. At the same time, there was an in-depth discussion on the future development direction of Mico-OCT imaging technology, as well as related cooperation in the detection of clinical skin diseases, early cancer screening of digestive system diseases, and potential applications in the field of ophthalmology.

blocks.text_zh: 刘琳波教授简介：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Professor Liu Linbo:

blocks.text_zh: 刘琳波博士系新加坡南洋理工大学电气及电子工程学院、化工与生物医学工程学院副教授。新加坡国立大学生物工程博士。2011年获哈佛医学院麻省总医院医学发现博士后奖。长期从事高分辨率光学相干层析成像技术研究，是Micro-OCT技术的主要发明人。当前主要研究方向为用于早期癌症诊断的亚细胞分辨率OCT技术。在Nature Medicine、Optica等杂志发表SCI论文70余篇，申报国内外发明专利11项，其中6项获得授权，2项签署使用许可协议。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Liu Linbo is an associate professor at the School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering and the School of Chemical Engineering and Biomedical Engineering at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore. PhD in Bioengineering from the National University of Singapore. In 2011, he received the Medical Discovery Postdoctoral Award from Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital. He has long been engaged in research on high-resolution optical coherence tomography technology and is the main inventor of Micro-OCT technology. The current main research direction is subcellular resolution OCT technology for early cancer diagnosis. He has published more than 70 SCI papers in journals such as Nature Medicine and Optica, and applied for 11 domestic and foreign invention patents, of which 6 were authorized and 2 signed license agreements.

title_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 2023年3月6日下午，受新加坡科技局生物信息研究所余维淼教授的邀请，智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授访问生物信息研究所并受邀在生物信息研究所做题目为“Computational radiology and pathology for disease prevention, diagnosis, and prognosis（面向疾病预防、诊断和预后的放射影像和病理图像计算）”的学术报告。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of March 6, 2023, at the invitation of Professor Yu Weimiao from the Institute of Bioinformatics of the Singapore Institute of Technology, Professor Xu Jun, Executive Director of the Smart Medical Research Institute, visited the Institute of Bioinformatics and was invited to give an academic report titled "Computational radiology and pathology for disease prevention, diagnosis, and prognosis" at the Institute of Bioinformatics.

blocks.alt_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 报告主要围绕智慧医疗研究院正在开展的以机器学习驱动的放射影像学和组织学图像分析及影像和组织病理等多模态多尺度数据融合等相关研究成果的讨论。放射影像学和常规组织病理学切片图像中包含很多有价值的临床诊断、治疗和预后等信息。随着先进的医学图像分析和高分辨率数字病理扫及成像技术的快速发展，我们可以更方便地从放射影像学和常规组织病理学图像中获得疾病的多尺度图像生物标记物描述，例如毫米尺度和微米尺度的图像表型描述，其中很多是人眼无法区分的图像模式。通过定量地获取这些疾病的图像模式和表型描述，我们可以构建模型辅助医生更准确地检测和诊断疾病，并尝试评估或预测疾病的复发风险、疾病侵袭性程度、长期生存率以及患者对治疗的响应。近10多年来，智慧医疗研究院团队一直致力于机器学习驱动的放射影像学和组织学图像分析工具的研究和开发，通过构建基于放射影像和组织学图像的“图像生物标记物”模型，期望未来能够更好地辅助医生实现疾病的预防、诊断和预测疾病进展以及对患者对治疗的响应。
blocks.text_en: The report mainly focuses on the discussion of related research results being carried out by the Smart Medical Research Institute on machine learning-driven radiology and histology image analysis and multi-modal and multi-scale data fusion of imaging and histopathology. Radiographic imaging and conventional histopathological section images contain a lot of valuable information for clinical diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. With the rapid development of advanced medical image analysis and high-resolution digital pathology scanning and imaging technology, we can more easily obtain multi-scale image biomarker descriptions of diseases from radiological imaging and conventional histopathology images, such as millimeter-scale and micron-scale image phenotype descriptions, many of which are image patterns that are indistinguishable to the human eye. By quantitatively obtaining image patterns and phenotypic descriptions of these diseases, we can build models to assist doctors in detecting and diagnosing the disease more accurately, and try to assess or predict the risk of disease recurrence, disease aggressiveness, long-term survival, and patient response to treatment. For more than 10 years, the Smart Medical Research Institute team has been committed to the research and development of machine learning-driven radiological imaging and histological image analysis tools. By building an "image biomarker" model based on radiological imaging and histological images, it is expected that in the future it can better assist doctors in preventing, diagnosing and predicting disease progression as well as patient response to treatment.

blocks.alt_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 报告中徐军介绍了研究院近期发表的相关研究成果，主要包括：1）基于肝脏CT影像组学模型预测肝细胞癌的微血管浸润，2）慢性粒细胞白血病的计算机辅助诊断，3）胆管癌患者肿瘤微环境的定量分析和生存预测，4）非小型细胞肺癌患者对免疫治疗的响应预测，5）基于乳腺组织学图像定量分析的三阴性乳腺癌亚型分类和预后分析，以及 6）小鼠曲细生精管分期及细胞组成成分分析。最后，徐军还介绍了智慧医疗研究院的医工团队情况及研究领域。
blocks.text_en: In the report, Xu Jun introduced the relevant research results recently published by the institute, which mainly include: 1) prediction of microvascular infiltration of hepatocellular carcinoma based on liver CT radiomics model, 2) computer-aided diagnosis of chronic myelogenous leukemia, 3) quantitative analysis of tumor microenvironment and survival prediction of cholangiocarcinoma patients, 4) prediction of response to immunotherapy in patients with non-small cell lung cancer, 5) triple-negative breast cancer subtype classification and prognosis analysis based on quantitative analysis of breast histology images, and 6) Staging and cell composition analysis of mouse seminiferous tubules. Finally, Xu Jun also introduced the medical team and research fields of the Smart Medical Research Institute.

blocks.alt_zh: 徐军教授访问新加坡科技局并作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 本次学术报告由新加科技局生物信息研究所余维淼教授主持，旨在聚焦双方感兴趣的领域，进一步加强两个单位教师和学生的相互了解，深入合作和交流。在问答与互动环节，与会人员与徐军进行了广泛深入地讨论和交流。 最后， 生物信息研究所 Kwee Kuan教授对报告做了总结。 本次学术报告的参会人员 除了新加坡科技局本单位的研究人员外，还包括华大基因，默沙东等全球领先的医药公司的研究人员。报告采用了线下线上混合的方式，其中线下参会人员40多人，线上30多人。
blocks.text_en: This academic report was hosted by Professor Yu Weimiao from the Institute of Bioinformatics of the Singapore Institute of Science and Technology. It aimed to focus on areas of interest to both parties, further strengthen mutual understanding between teachers and students of the two units, and in-depth cooperation and exchanges. During the Q&A and interactive session, the participants had extensive and in-depth discussions and exchanges with Xu Jun. Finally, Professor Kwee Kuan from the Institute of Bioinformatics summarized the report. In addition to researchers from the Singapore Science and Technology Agency, participants in this academic report also include researchers from the world's leading pharmaceutical companies such as BGI and Merck. The report adopted a mixed offline and online approach, with more than 40 offline participants and more than 30 online participants.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院和 新加坡科技局生物信息研究所在人才培养、科学研究等方面已经开展了多年的合作。目前在计算病理、前列腺癌智能自动Gleason分级、小鼠生精管自动分期等方面已经合作发表了多篇高水平论文。此次报告也是疫情之后，中新双方团队的第一次面对面交流。双方计划在科研项目联合申请，教师的交流与合作，硕士、博士等高层次人才培养方面进一步加强合作。
blocks.text_en: The Smart Medical Research Institute and the Institute of Bioinformatics of the Singapore Science and Technology Agency have cooperated for many years in talent training and scientific research. Currently, many high-level papers have been jointly published in areas such as computational pathology, intelligent automatic Gleason grading of prostate cancer, and automatic staging of mouse seminiferous ducts. This report is also the first face-to-face communication between the Chinese and New Zealand teams after the epidemic. The two parties plan to further strengthen cooperation in joint applications for scientific research projects, teacher exchanges and cooperation, and the training of high-level talents such as masters and doctoral students.

blocks.text_zh: 延伸阅读
blocks.text_en: Further reading

blocks.text_zh: 新加坡科技研究局（ A gency for S cience, T echnology and R esearch；简写为 A*STAR ）， 是新加坡贸易和工业部下属的自治研究机构，其前身是成立于1991年的新加坡科学技术局。A*STAR成立的目标是促进新加坡科研和人才的整合，以协助新加坡向知识型经济体转型和迈进。其下属研究院分两个分支：生物医药研究和科学工程研究，各自统领若干下属研究所，开展相关方面的科学研究。还直辖交叉学科整合理事会、研究生学院、速创科技私人有限公司，以及企业公共事务服务部门，以达到各个研究所的资源共享。A*STAR是新加坡研究团体中重要的催化剂、推动者和召集者。通过开放式创新，A*STAR与公共和私营部门的合作伙伴进行合作，并利用科学技术使经济和社会受益。 生物信息学研究所 (Bioinformatics Institute, BII) 隶属A*STAR生物医药研究理事会，于 2001 年 7 月成立。BII位于新加坡的Biopolis街道，是A*STAR的计算生物学研究机构，同时也是国家生物信息学资源中心。BII旨在通过开发人工智能/机器学习分析方法来理解生物医学现象背后的生物分子机制。BII广泛地分析生物学和临床数据，包括组学数据（生物分子序列、表达谱、表观遗传学数据）、大分子的 3D 结构。BII的应用研究涉及传染病、计算病理、天然产物研究、精准医学、癌症研究和药物发现。
blocks.text_en: The Agency for Science, Technology and Research (abbreviated as A*STAR) is an autonomous research agency under the Ministry of Trade and Industry of Singapore. Its predecessor was the Science and Technology Agency of Singapore established in 1991. The goal of A*STAR is to promote the integration of scientific research and talent in Singapore to assist Singapore in its transformation and advancement into a knowledge-based economy. Its affiliated research institutes are divided into two branches: biomedical research and scientific engineering research, each of which leads a number of affiliated research institutes to carry out scientific research in related fields. It also directly governs the Interdisciplinary Integration Council, the Graduate School, Sutron Technology Pte Ltd, and the Corporate Public Affairs Service Department to achieve resource sharing among various institutes. A*STAR is an important catalyst, promoter and convener of the Singapore research community. Through open innovation, A*STAR collaborates with public and private sector partners and uses science and technology to benefit the economy and society. The Bioinformatics Institute (BII) is affiliated to the A*STAR Biomedical Research Council and was established in July 2001. Located in Biopolis Street, Singapore, BII is A*STAR's computational biology research institution and the National Bioinformatics Resource Center. BII aims to understand the biomolecular mechanisms behind biomedical phenomena by developing artificial intelligence/machine learning analysis methods. BII extensively analyzes biological and clinical data, including omics data (biomolecule sequences, expression profiles, epigenetic data), and 3D structures of macromolecules. BII's applied research involves infectious diseases, computational pathology, natural product research, precision medicine, cancer research and drug discovery.

title_zh: 新加坡A*STAR陈正华研究员来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 11 月 25 日下午，南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀新加坡 A*STAR 陈正华研究员来校作学术报告，报告主题为 “Data-Efficient and Model-Efficient Learning for Time- series Data Analytics” 。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持本次报告会，线下、线上参会的教师、研究生及本科生共 30 余人。
blocks.text_en: On the afternoon of November 25, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited researcher Chen Zhenghua from Singapore A*STAR to the school to give an academic report. The theme of the report was "Data-Efficient and Model-Efficient Learning for Time-series Data Analytics". Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over this report meeting. There were more than 30 teachers, graduate students and undergraduates participating offline and online.

blocks.text_zh: 陈正华博士的报告主要从数据高效和模型高效两方面介绍了三种时间序列数据的分析技术：（ 1 ）自监督学习；（ 2 ）领域适应；以及（ 3 ）知识蒸馏。陈博士首先介绍了适用于时间序列的自监督学习框架，不同于图像和 NLP ，该自监督框架引入了时间和上下文对比，更适用于学习未标记时间序列数据的表示。然后，陈博士介绍了时间序列信号在域适应方向的研究，并展示了其团队研发的基准测试评估套件 ADATIME ，该套件为广大科研人员提供了公平、全面的评估不同时间序列域适应的方法。最后，陈博士介绍了一种基于知识蒸馏的异构网络压缩方法，并从算法和计算能源的角度阐述并总结了模型高效的必要性和发展趋势。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Chen Zhenghua’s report mainly introduced three time series data analysis technologies from the aspects of data efficiency and model efficiency: (1) self-supervised learning; (2) domain adaptation; and (3) knowledge distillation. Dr. Chen first introduced a self-supervised learning framework suitable for time series. Different from images and NLP, this self-supervised framework introduces time and context contrast and is more suitable for learning the representation of unlabeled time series data. Then, Dr. Chen introduced the research on domain adaptation of time series signals, and demonstrated the benchmark evaluation suite ADATIME developed by his team, which provides researchers with a fair and comprehensive method to evaluate the domain adaptation of different time series. Finally, Dr. Chen introduced a heterogeneous network compression method based on knowledge distillation, and elaborated and summarized the necessity and development trends of efficient models from the perspectives of algorithms and computational energy.

blocks.text_zh: 在互动环节，与会师生积极踊跃提问，就复杂控制系统、大数据计算与模式识别、深度学习模型的软 - 硬件加速、算法优化等问题与陈博士进行了广泛而深入的交流，会场学术气氛浓厚。
blocks.text_en: During the interactive session, participating teachers and students actively asked questions and had extensive and in-depth exchanges with Dr. Chen on issues such as complex control systems, big data computing and pattern recognition, software-hardware acceleration of deep learning models, and algorithm optimization. The academic atmosphere at the venue was strong.

blocks.text_zh: 陈正华博士简介：
blocks.text_en: Introduction to Dr. Chen Zhenghua:

blocks.alt_zh: 新加坡A*STAR陈正华研究员来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 陈正华博士分别在电子科技大学和新加坡南洋理工大学获得学士和博士学位。目前担任新加坡科技研究局（ A*STAR ）研究科学家、 PI 、实验室主任和博士生导师。研究领域为小数据和小模型深度学习及其在物联网数据分析中的应用。近年来发表 90 余篇顶级期刊和会议论文（包括顶级期刊 IEEE TNNLS 、 Tcyber 、 TIE 、 TII 和 CCF A 类会议 AAAI 、 IJCAI 、 ICCV 、 NeurIPS 等）、其中 5 篇论文入选 ESI 高被引论文、 1 篇论文入选 ESI 热点论文、 1 篇论文入选中国百篇最具影响力国际学术论文；以第一作者编写英文专著一部（ World Scientific 出版、亚马逊在售）；论文谷歌学术引用 5000+ ；主持或共同主持 10 项新加坡国家研究基金会项目，总项目经费超 6000 万人民币；受邀担任中科院二区期刊 Neurocomputing 和 IEEE TIM 副主编和中科院一区期刊 IEEE JAS 青年编委；连续三年（ 2020 、 2021 和 2022 ）入选全球前 2% 顶尖科学家（斯坦福大学发布）、曾荣获 A*STAR 职业发展奖 (Career Development Award) 、 CCF A 类会议 CVPR 2021 UG2+ 挑战赛冠军、 IEEE 会议最佳论文提名奖等；目前担任 IEEE 传感器学会新加坡分部副主席（ 2023 年起担任主席）和 IEEE 高级会员。
blocks.text_en: Dr. Chen Zhenghua received his bachelor's and doctorate degrees from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and Nanyang Technological University, Singapore respectively. Currently serving as a research scientist, PI, laboratory director and doctoral supervisor at the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) in Singapore. The research field is small data and small model deep learning and its application in Internet of Things data analysis. In recent years, he has published more than 90 papers in top journals and conferences (including top journals IEEE TNNLS, Tcyber, TIE, TII and CCF Class A conferences AAAI, IJCAI, ICCV, NeurIPS, etc.), of which 5 papers were selected as ESI Highly Cited Papers, 1 paper was selected as ESI Hot Paper, and 1 paper was selected as one of the 100 Most Influential International Academic Papers in China; he wrote an English monograph (World) as the first author Scientific Publishing, available on Amazon); 5,000+ Google Scholar citations for papers; Hosted or co-hosted 10 Singapore National Research Foundation projects, with total project funding exceeding RMB 60 million; Invited to serve as deputy editor-in-chief of Neurocomputing and IEEE TIM, the journals of the second region of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and IEEE JAS Youth Editorial Board of the journals of the first region of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; selected into the top 2% in the world for three consecutive years (2020, 2021 and 2022) Top scientist (published by Stanford University), has won the A*STAR Career Development Award, CCF Class A conference CVPR 2021 UG2+ Challenge Champion, IEEE Conference Best Paper Nomination Award, etc.; currently serves as the Vice Chairman of the Singapore Branch of the IEEE Sensor Society (chairman from 2023) and a senior member of IEEE.

title_zh: 南京农业大学人工智能学院计智伟教授来校作学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 9 月 22 日上午，南京信息工程大学 - 中大医院智慧医疗研究院特邀南京农业大学人工智能学院计智伟教授来校作学术报告，报告的主题是“ Big data computing, modeling, and application ”。我校人工智能学院（未来技术学院）副院长、智慧医疗研究院执行院长徐军教授主持报告会，学院教师和研究生线下线上 30 多人参会。
blocks.text_en: On the morning of September 22, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology - Zhongda Hospital Smart Medical Research Institute invited Professor Ji Zhiwei from the School of Artificial Intelligence of Nanjing Agricultural University to give an academic report. The theme of the report was "Big data computing, modeling, and application." Professor Xu Jun, deputy dean of the School of Artificial Intelligence (College of Future Technology) and executive director of the Smart Medical Research Institute of our school, presided over the report meeting. More than 30 people, including teachers and graduate students from the school, attended the meeting offline and online.

blocks.text_zh: 计智伟主要从生物分子网络的系统建模方法、复杂生物系统的 3D 多尺度建模、人工智能优化的生物信息计算等三个方面，深入探讨了生物大数据挖掘和系统建模等多组学数据融合分析与计算等问题。在互动环节，与会师生踊跃提问，并就生物分子网络、大数据计算与模式识别、复杂生物系统的建模与预测等与计教授进行了广泛而深入的交流，会场学术气氛浓厚。
blocks.text_en: Ji Zhiwei mainly explored issues such as multi-omics data fusion analysis and calculation such as biological big data mining and system modeling from three aspects: system modeling methods of biomolecular networks, 3D multi-scale modeling of complex biological systems, and biological information computing optimized by artificial intelligence. During the interactive session, participating teachers and students actively asked questions and had extensive and in-depth exchanges with Professor Ji on biomolecular networks, big data computing and pattern recognition, modeling and prediction of complex biological systems, etc. The academic atmosphere at the venue was strong.

blocks.text_zh: 智慧医疗研究院致力于研究与开发医学影像、病理、多组学、电子病历等医疗大数据以及人工智能等信息技术，以辅助医生改善疾病的预防、诊断、治疗和预后。研究院正扎实推进各项工作，促进新工科和新医科融合发展。
blocks.text_en: The Smart Medical Research Institute is committed to researching and developing medical big data such as medical imaging, pathology, multi-omics, and electronic medical records, as well as information technologies such as artificial intelligence to assist doctors in improving disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis. The institute is making solid progress in various tasks to promote the integrated development of new engineering and new medical sciences.

title_zh: 徐军参加第一届亚洲数字病理学会年会并做学术报告

blocks.text_zh: 第一届亚洲数字病理学会年会于2024年10月2-4日在韩国首尔世宗大学（Sejong University）会议中心召开。本次年会的主题是：Unlock the Potential of Digital Pathology and AI (释放数字病理与人工智能的潜力)。会议邀请了包括美国，欧洲，以及亚洲各国家和地区病理学家、从事数字病理与人工智能研究的大学教授、数字病理工程师、数字病理学领域专家参会。徐军 受邀参会并做了题为：Explainable AI in Pathology(病理学中的可解释人工智能)的学术报告，同时主持了Generative AI and LLM in Pathology（病理学中的生成式人工智能与大语言模型）分会的学术报告。
blocks.text_en: The first annual meeting of the Asian Society of Digital Pathology will be held on October 2-4, 2024 at the Sejong University Conference Center in Seoul, South Korea. The theme of this annual meeting is: Unlock the Potential of Digital Pathology and AI. The conference invited pathologists from the United States, Europe, and Asia, university professors engaged in digital pathology and artificial intelligence research, digital pathology engineers, and experts in the field of digital pathology. Xu Jun was invited to attend the conference and gave an academic report titled: Explainable AI in Pathology (Explainable Artificial Intelligence in Pathology), and also chaired the academic report of the Generative AI and LLM in Pathology (Generative AI and Large Language Model in Pathology) branch.

blocks.text_zh: 延伸阅读
blocks.text_en: Further reading

blocks.text_zh: Asian Society of Digital Pathology (亚洲数字病理学会，简称ASDP）成立于 2024 年，是非营利组织，致力于连接一群由经验丰富的病理学家、开拓性工程师、数字病理学行业合作者以及亚洲各地的技术人员和受训人员组成的知名专家群体。
blocks.text_en: Founded in 2024, the Asian Society of Digital Pathology (ASDP) is a non-profit organization dedicated to connecting a renowned expert community of experienced pathologists, pioneering engineers, digital pathology industry collaborators, and technicians and trainees across Asia.

blocks.text_zh: ASDP的使命是促进数字病理学和人工智能 (DP-AI) 技术的广泛采用，在整个地区规范实践，并成为寻求参与亚洲充满活力的医疗保健行业的学术和行业合作伙伴的动态门户。
blocks.text_en: ASDP's mission is to promote widespread adoption of digital pathology and artificial intelligence (DP-AI) technologies, standardize practice across the region, and serve as a dynamic gateway for academic and industry partners seeking to participate in Asia's dynamic healthcare industry.

blocks.text_zh: 第一届 ASDP 年度大会是 ASDP 首次面对面会议，内容包括亚洲数字病理学和人工智能的现状和指南、与世界前沿数字病理学协会 (DPA、ESDIP) 联合举办的研讨会、数字病理学伦理和监管问题、病理学成像的最新进展、数字病理学教育会议以及与数字病理学专业人士、受训人员和行业的交流时间。本次大会得到了韩国病理学会的支持。
blocks.text_en: The 1st ASDP Annual Conference is ASDP's first face-to-face meeting and will include the status and guidance of digital pathology and artificial intelligence in Asia, a joint workshop with the world's leading digital pathology associations (DPA, ESDIP), ethical and regulatory issues in digital pathology, recent advances in pathology imaging, a digital pathology education session and networking time with digital pathology professionals, trainees and industry. This conference is supported by the Korean Pathological Society.

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 致力于促进成员国之间充满活力的知识交流，促进学术界和产业界的紧密合作，推动塑造病理学未来的研究和发展。在我们踏上这段旅程之际，我们邀请您加入我们，共同塑造一个数字病理学超越界限、提高诊断精度并最终改善亚洲及其他地区患者护理的未来。 ASDP 可以共同开辟一条通往更加互联、技术更先进的医疗保健领域的道路。加入我们这段激动人心的旅程，每一次点击都会让您更接近创新的脉搏。
blocks.text_en: ASDP promotes a vibrant exchange of knowledge between member countries, fosters close collaboration between academia and industry, and drives research and development that will shape the future of pathology. As we embark on this journey, we invite you to join us in shaping a future where digital pathology transcends boundaries, improves diagnostic accuracy and ultimately improves patient care in Asia and beyond. Together, ASDP can forge a path toward a more connected, technologically advanced healthcare landscape. Join us on this exciting journey, where every click brings you closer to the pulse of innovation.

blocks.text_en: The website of the 1st Asian Society of Digital Pathology Annual Conference: https://www.asdp2024.org/html/

blocks.text_zh: 亚洲数字病理学会的使命
blocks.text_en: Mission of the Asian Society of Digital Pathology

blocks.text_zh: 1. 促进和倡导数字病理学的采用
blocks.text_en: 1. Promote and advocate for the adoption of digital pathology

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 旨在带头推动鼓励亚洲国家广泛采用最先进的数字病理学技术和最佳实践的举措。这包括倡导政策变革、分享成功案例和提供教育资源以促进无缝集成。
blocks.text_en: ASDP aims to spearhead initiatives to encourage widespread adoption of state-of-the-art digital pathology technologies and best practices in Asian countries. This includes advocating for policy changes, sharing success stories and providing educational resources to facilitate seamless integration.

blocks.text_zh: 2. 促进合作研究和开发
blocks.text_en: 2. Promote collaborative research and development

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 寻求催化解决亚洲区域医疗保健挑战的合作研究和开发项目。通过促进研究机构、医疗保健从业者和技术创新者之间的伙伴关系，ASDP 致力于推动该领域的有影响力的进步。
blocks.text_en: ASDP seeks to catalyze collaborative research and development projects that address regional healthcare challenges in Asia. By fostering partnerships between research institutions, healthcare practitioners, and technology innovators, ASDP works to drive impactful advances in the field.

blocks.text_zh: 3. 组织国际知识传播活动
blocks.text_en: 3. Organize international knowledge dissemination activities

blocks.text_zh: 该协会致力于组织和举办国际知识、网络研讨会、研讨会、讲习班和教育计划。这些活动是传播前沿知识、分享最佳实践和为数字病理学领域的专业人士和研究人员营造动态环境的平台。
blocks.text_en: The association is dedicated to organizing and conducting international knowledge, webinars, seminars, workshops and educational programs. These events serve as a platform to disseminate cutting-edge knowledge, share best practices and create a dynamic environment for professionals and researchers in the field of digital pathology.

blocks.text_zh: 4. 制定和认可标准化指南
blocks.text_en: 4. Develop and endorse standardized guidelines

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 积极参与制定和认可标准化指南。这些准则涵盖了数据共享协议、系统互操作性标准和道德考量等关键方面。ASDP 对这些准则的承诺确保了在亚洲不同的医疗保健领域负责任且有效地实施数字病理学系统。
blocks.text_en: ASDP is actively involved in developing and endorsing standardized guidelines. These guidelines cover key aspects such as data sharing protocols, system interoperability standards and ethical considerations. ASDP's commitment to these guidelines ensures responsible and effective implementation of digital pathology systems in diverse healthcare sectors in Asia.

blocks.text_zh: 5. 与法人实体建立合作伙伴关系
blocks.text_en: 5. Establish partnerships with legal entities

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 认识到与法人实体合作的重要性，包括学术机构、医疗保健组织、技术公司和行业利益相关者。该协会积极培养合作伙伴关系以支持和推动创新，确保数字病理学的进步与医疗保健行业不断变化的需求保持一致。
blocks.text_en: ASDP recognizes the importance of working with legal entities, including academic institutions, healthcare organizations, technology companies, and industry stakeholders. The association actively cultivates partnerships to support and drive innovation, ensuring advances in digital pathology are aligned with the changing needs of the healthcare industry.

blocks.text_zh: 6. 鼓励继续教育和专业发展
blocks.text_en: 6. Encourage continuing education and professional development

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 强烈强调数字病理学领域的持续学习和专业发展。该协会支持为医疗保健专业人员提供持续教育、培训计划和认证机会的举措，确保熟练的劳动力能够利用数字病理学的最新进展。
blocks.text_en: ASDP strongly emphasizes continuous learning and professional development in the field of digital pathology. The association supports initiatives that provide ongoing education, training programs and certification opportunities for healthcare professionals, ensuring a skilled workforce capable of taking advantage of the latest advances in digital pathology.

blocks.text_zh: 6. 倡导监管支持和政策制定
blocks.text_en: 6. Advocate for regulatory support and policy development

blocks.text_zh: ASDP 积极参与倡导工作，以获得监管支持并为与数字病理学相关的政策制定做出贡献。通过与政府机构和相关利益相关者的合作，ASDP 旨在创建一个有利于数字病理技术负责任且有效地融入医疗保健系统的环境。
blocks.text_en: ASDP is actively involved in advocacy efforts to gain regulatory support and contribute to policy development related to digital pathology. Through collaboration with government agencies and relevant stakeholders, ASDP aims to create an environment conducive to the responsible and effective integration of digital pathology technologies into the healthcare system.

blocks.alt_zh: 复旦大学类脑智能科学与技术研究院程炜青年研究员来校作报告

blocks.text_zh: 报告主题： 基于神经影像大数据的精神分裂症研究
blocks.text_en: Report topic: Research on schizophrenia based on neuroimaging big data
Time: June 7, 2023 (Wednesday) 16:00-17:30

blocks.text_zh: 地 点： 信息科技大楼 A106 会议室（线下）
blocks.text_en: Location: Conference Room A106, Information Technology Building (offline)
Tencent conference number: 129-117-012 (online)

blocks.text_zh: 主 持 ：万卓 南京信息工程大学
blocks.text_en: Host: Wan Zhuo, Nanjing University of Information Science & Technology

blocks.text_zh: 报告摘要： 精神分裂症是一种严重的精神疾病，神经影像学大数据的发展为精神分裂症的精准诊疗提供新的契机。报告人将介绍其团队近几年在精神分裂症神经影像生物标志物方面的研究成果。首先，基于功能影像数据，发展新的全脑关联分析方法，在体素级别识别精神分裂症异常的神经环路;进一步针对精神分裂症高异质性问题,利用数据驱动的疾病进展模型和大规模影像数据，发现两种精神分裂症生物亚型，其大脑萎缩分别起源于海马和语言区，并且两者具有不同的治疗效果;最后，利用“震中映射”(epicenter mapping）方法构建精神分裂症新影像学指标，验证该指标的跨疾病敏感性以及对治疗的预测价值，并结合多模态数据阐释其背后的分子遗传机制。
blocks.text_en: Report summary: Schizophrenia is a serious mental illness. The development of neuroimaging big data provides new opportunities for precise diagnosis and treatment of schizophrenia. The speaker will introduce his team’s research results on neuroimaging biomarkers of schizophrenia in recent years. First, based on functional imaging data, develop a new whole-brain correlation analysis method to identify abnormal neural circuits in schizophrenia at the voxel level; further address the problem of high heterogeneity in schizophrenia, use data-driven disease progression models and large-scale imaging data to discover two biological subtypes of schizophrenia, whose brain atrophy originates from the hippocampus and language area respectively, and the two have different treatment effects; finally, use "epicenter mapping" (epicenter mapping) mapping) method to construct a new imaging index for schizophrenia, verify the index's cross-disease sensitivity and predictive value for treatment, and combine multi-modal data to elucidate the molecular genetic mechanism behind it.

blocks.text_zh: 报告人简介： 程炜，复旦大学类脑智能科学与技术研究院青年研究员，复旦大学附属华山医院双聘PI，英国华威大学荣誉研究员。研究领域为发展影像遗传大数据统计方法及其在神经精神疾病中的应用，实现临床早期诊断与精准治疗。入选国家级青年人才、上海市启明星人才计划，主持国自然面上、上海自然基金等项目。以通讯或第一作者(含共同)发表论文40余篇，包括 JAMA Psychiatry、NatureAging.NatureMental Health、Brain等，研究成果被成功应用于抑郁症的临床治疗。担任Journal of NeuroscienceMethods编委以及Nature Human Behaviour,Biological Psychiatry等多个期刊审稿人。
blocks.text_en: Brief introduction of the speaker: Cheng Wei is a young researcher at the Institute of Brain-inspired Intelligence Science and Technology of Fudan University, a dual-employed PI at Huashan Hospital affiliated to Fudan University, and an honorary researcher at the University of Warwick in the UK. The research field is the development of imaging genetic big data statistical methods and their application in neuropsychiatric diseases to achieve early clinical diagnosis and precise treatment. Selected as a national-level young talent, Shanghai Morning Star Talent Program, and presided over projects such as the National Natural Science Foundation of China and the Shanghai Natural Science Foundation. He has published more than 40 papers as the corresponding or first author (including co-author), including JAMA Psychiatry, NatureAging.NatureMental Health, Brain, etc., and his research results have been successfully applied to the clinical treatment of depression. He serves on the editorial board of Journal of NeuroscienceMethods and as a reviewer for several journals such as Nature Human Behavior and Biological Psychiatry.

title_zh: 重点实验室徐军和刘辉受邀出席第18届国际生物医学工程技术与系统大会并发表主旨演讲

blocks.text_zh: 2025 年 2 月 20-22日 ，重点实验室徐军和刘辉受邀出席在葡萄牙波尔图举行的第 18 届 国际 生物医学工程技术与系统大会（ BIOSTEC 2025 ）。此次会议汇聚了来自美国、德国、葡萄牙、瑞士、以色列、韩国、日本、巴西等国的学者及产业领袖，围绕 " 智能医疗技术与未来健康系统 " 主题展开深度研讨、发表最新科研成果。徐军在本次大会上做了大会主旨演讲，刘辉担任了大会博士论坛联合主席。
blocks.text_en: From February 20 to 22, 2025, Xu Jun and Liu Hui from the Key Laboratory were invited to attend the 18th International Biomedical Engineering Technology and Systems Conference (BIOSTEC 2025) held in Porto, Portugal. This conference brought together scholars and industry leaders from the United States, Germany, Portugal, Switzerland, Israel, South Korea, Japan, Brazil and other countries to conduct in-depth discussions and publish the latest scientific research results around the theme of "Intelligent Medical Technology and Future Health Systems". Xu Jun gave a keynote speech at this conference, and Liu Hui served as co-chairman of the conference's doctoral forum.

blocks.text_zh: 在为期三天的学术会议中，徐军作为大会特邀嘉宾出席了开幕式，参与了以“生医工可持续发展”为题的高峰论坛并发表观点，主持了西班牙加泰罗尼亚大学 脑电专家乔迪·索莱 - 卡萨尔斯（ Jordi Sol é -Casals ）教授名为 Crossing Borders: My Research Journey from Theory to Applications in Biomedical Signal Processing( 跨越边界：我的生物医学信号处理从理论到应用的研究历程 ) 的主旨演讲。
blocks.text_en: During the three-day academic conference, Xu Jun attended the opening ceremony as a special guest of the conference, participated in the summit forum with the theme of "Sustainable Development of Biomedical Engineering" and expressed his views, and chaired a lecture titled Crossing Borders: My Research Journey from Theory to Applications in Biomedical Signal Processing by Professor Jordi Solé-Casals, an EEG expert at the University of Catalonia in Spain. keynote speech.

blocks.text_zh: 徐军以 Data-Driven and Knowledge-Driven Medical Image Computing for Disease Prevention, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prognosis( 数据驱动和知识驱动的医学图像计算及其在疾病预防、诊断、治疗和预后的应用）为题做了主旨演讲。在一个小时的报告中，他系统地介绍了重点实验室近些年在影像和病理图像分析、多模态生理信号处理、疾病的预防、诊疗和预后等相关领域的最新研究成果。他详细阐述了实验室在面对多模态，跨尺度的复杂医学数据，研究与开发基于数据和知识驱动的影像学和病理学图像计算技术，从影像和常规病理切片中提取和分析疾病特异性图像表型或“图像生物标记”，以提高疾病检测和诊断的准确性。此外，还他还介绍了运用“图像生物标记”在预测关键临床结果方面的潜力，例如分子亚型、疾病侵袭性、患者生存率和治疗反应等，从而有助于医生为患者制定更个性化治疗方案和有效的临床护理。此外，报告还涉及实验室最几年运用基础模型和深度学习模型的体素、细胞和组织水平的图像分析。
blocks.text_en: Xu Jun gave a keynote speech titled Data-Driven and Knowledge-Driven Medical Image Computing for Disease Prevention, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Prognosis. In a one-hour report, he systematically introduced the latest research results of the key laboratory in recent years in the fields of imaging and pathological image analysis, multi-modal physiological signal processing, disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment and prognosis. He elaborated on the laboratory's research and development in the face of multi-modal, cross-scale complex medical data, imaging and pathology image computing technology driven by data and knowledge, and extraction and analysis of disease-specific image phenotypes or "image biomarkers" from images and conventional pathology slices to improve the accuracy of disease detection and diagnosis. In addition, he also introduced the potential of using "image biomarkers" to predict key clinical outcomes, such as molecular subtypes, disease aggressiveness, patient survival rate, and treatment response, thereby helping doctors develop more personalized treatment plans and effective clinical care for patients. In addition, the report also covers the voxel, cell and tissue level image analysis using basic models and deep learning models in the laboratory in recent years.

blocks.text_zh: 在大会的闭幕式上，刘辉和来自葡语人文科技大学的米卡耶拉 - 方瑟萨（ M icaela F onseca ）教授一同为本届会议的博士论坛最佳论文颁奖 。大会在与会专家和学者的一致好评中落下了帷幕，与会人员共同期待明年 第 19 届 BIOSTEC 2026 相聚于美丽的南西班牙。
blocks.text_en: At the closing ceremony of the conference, Liu Hui and Professor Micaela Fonseca from the University of Portuguese Language and Humanities and Sciences jointly presented awards to the best papers of this conference’s doctoral forum. The conference came to an end with unanimous praise from the experts and scholars present, and the participants are looking forward to gathering in the beautiful southern Spain for the 19th BIOSTEC 2026 next year.

blocks.text_zh: 报告摘要
blocks.text_en: Report Summary

blocks.text_zh: Human cognition arises from coordinated spiking dynamics in distributed cortical columns, where perceptual representations are shaped by experience-dependent plasticity in the vertical connections across cortical layers. Inspired by this notion, our central premise is a two-layer computational model of sensorimotor learning: upper-layer neurons encode sensory input while indexing a spatial reference frame anchored in the lower layer. Upon movement, the lower layer transitions to a new location, generating a prediction of the next sensory input in the upper layer. To that end, we develop a brain-inspired learning primitive in which cognition-level neural synchrony emerges through iterative bottom-up and top-down interactions between micro-scale dynamics of spiking neurons and a macro-scale mechanism of oscillatory synchronization. This research opens a new window into advanced learning-enabled intelligence by addressing fundamental questions about neural information representation and the mechanisms of cognition.
blocks.text_en: Human cognition arises from coordinated spiking dynamics in distributed cortical columns, where perceptual representations are shaped by experience-dependent plasticity in the vertical connections across cortical layers. Inspired by this notion, our central premise is a two-layer computational model of sensorimotor learning: upper-layer neurons encode sensory input while indexing a spatial reference frame anchored in the lower layer. Upon movement, the lower layer transitions to a new location, generating a prediction of the next sensory input in the upper layer. To that end, we develop a brain-inspired learning primitive in which cognition-level neural synchrony emerges through iterative bottom-up and top-down interactions between micro-scale dynamics of spiking neurons and a macro-scale mechanism of oscillatory synchronization. This research opens a new window into advanced learning-enabled intelligence by addressing fundamental questions about neural information representation and the mechanisms of cognition.

blocks.text_zh: 人类认知源于分布式皮层柱之间协调一致的神经元脉冲放电动力学，其中知觉表征由跨皮层层级垂直连接中的经验依赖性可塑性所塑造。受这一观点启发，我们提出了一种感觉—运动学习的双层计算模型：上层神经元在编码感觉输入的同时，对以下层为锚定的空间参考框架进行索引；当发生运动时，下层会迁移到新的空间位置，并据此生成对上层下一时刻感觉输入的预测。为此，我们构建了一种受脑启发的学习原语（ learning primitive ），其中认知层面的神经同步通过脉冲神经元微观尺度动力学与振荡同步宏观机制之间反复进行的自底向上和自顶向下交互而涌现。该研究通过探究神经信息表征的基本问题以及认知形成的机制，为迈向更高级的学习赋能智能开辟了新的研究窗口。
blocks.text_en: Human cognition arises from coordinated neuronal spike firing dynamics among distributed cortical columns, where perceptual representations are shaped by experience-dependent plasticity in vertical connections across cortical hierarchies. Inspired by this point of view, we propose a two-layer computational model of sensory-motor learning: while encoding sensory input, the upper layer neurons index the spatial reference frame anchored by the lower layer; when movement occurs, the lower layer will migrate to a new spatial position and generate a prediction of the upper layer's sensory input at the next moment accordingly. To this end, we construct a brain-inspired learning primitive in which neural synchronization at the cognitive level emerges through iterative bottom-up and top-down interactions between the microscale dynamics of spiking neurons and the macroscopic mechanisms of oscillatory synchronization. This research opens up a new research window towards more advanced learning-empowered intelligence by exploring basic issues of neural information representation and the mechanism of cognitive formation.

blocks.text_zh: 报告人简介
blocks.text_en: Brief introduction of the reporter

blocks.text_zh: Guorong Wu 教授现就职于美国北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校。他于 2006 年在上海交通大学获得计算机科学与工程博士学位，长期从事医学影像分析、机器学习等研究。其研究聚焦于利用先进计算模型和数据驱动方法理解人脑机制， 并发现阿 尔茨海默病等神经系统疾病的高灵敏度、高特异性生物标志物。已在 Nature Communications 、 PNAS 、 IEEE PAMI 、 IEEE TMI 、 NeurIPS 、 ICML 、 ICLR 、 AAAI 等国际顶级期刊和会议发表论文 360 余篇。他还积极参与国际学术服务，担任 / 曾任 IEEE TMI 等国际期刊的编辑、编委或审稿专家等。此外，吴教授正联合斯坦福大学 Pohl 教授、约翰 ∙ 霍普金斯大学 Prince 教授等国际顶 级学者，共同筹办以 “ 自主多模态 Agent 在医学影像中的应用 ” 为主题的生命科学与健康技术 ( AI4Science) 专题夏令营。 本次夏令营将围绕医学影像智能分析、多模态大模型、自主智能体及其在生命健康领域的前沿用展开，诚挚欢迎相关领域的学生咨询与参与 。
blocks.text_en: Professor Guorong Wu currently works at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, USA. He received a PhD in computer science and engineering from Shanghai Jiao Tong University in 2006 and has been engaged in research on medical image analysis and machine learning for a long time. Its research focuses on using advanced computational models and data-driven methods to understand human brain mechanisms and discover highly sensitive and specific biomarkers for neurological diseases such as Alzheimer's disease. He has published more than 360 papers in top international journals and conferences such as Nature Communications, PNAS, IEEE PAMI, IEEE TMI, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and AAAI. He is also actively involved in international academic services and serves as/has served as an editor, editorial board member or review expert for international journals such as IEEE TMI. In addition, Professor Wu is cooperating with top international scholars such as Professor Pohl from Stanford University and Professor Prince from Johns Hopkins University to jointly organize a special summer camp on life sciences and health technology (AI4Science) with the theme of "Application of Autonomous Multimodal Agents in Medical Imaging". This summer camp will focus on intelligent analysis of medical images, multi-modal large models, autonomous agents and their cutting-edge applications in the field of life and health. Students in related fields are sincerely welcome to consult and participate.
