blocks.text_zh: 报告摘要
blocks.text_en: Report Summary

blocks.text_zh: 本报告将系统阐述医工交叉学科“智能肿瘤学”的发展脉络、底层逻辑、基础理论及临床应用转化。重点介绍从宏观微观映射机制、单细胞病理组学到弱关联事件强化等原创性理论框架，并展示人工智能技术在消化道早癌筛查、肺癌 CT 无创分型、乳腺癌快速病理判读、泛癌 BRCA 突变预测及直肠癌新辅助疗效评估等方面的典型应用。此外，还将分享 “灵眸”病理大模型与 MDT Copilot 群体智能平台，探讨 AI 赋能肿瘤精准诊疗的新范式。
blocks.text_en: This report will systematically elaborate on the development context, underlying logic, basic theory and clinical application transformation of "intelligent oncology", an interdisciplinary field of medicine and engineering. It focuses on introducing original theoretical frameworks from macroscopic and microscopic mapping mechanisms, single-cell pathology omics to weakly correlated event enhancement, and demonstrates the typical applications of artificial intelligence technology in early digestive tract cancer screening, lung cancer CT non-invasive classification, rapid pathological interpretation of breast cancer, pan-cancer BRCA mutation prediction, and neoadjuvant efficacy evaluation of rectal cancer. In addition, the "Lingmo" pathology large model and the MDT Copilot swarm intelligence platform will be shared to explore a new paradigm of AI-enabled precise diagnosis and treatment of tumors.

blocks.text_zh: 报告人简介
blocks.text_en: Brief introduction of the reporter

blocks.text_zh: 徐波毕业于北京协和医学院（ 1998 年临床医学博士），现任重庆大学弘深杰出教授、重庆市肿瘤研究所执行所长，中组部海外高层次人才特聘专家、重庆英才·优秀科学家，同时担任教育部智能肿瘤学医药基础研究创新中心主任、中国抗癌协会肿瘤人工智能专委会首任主任委员。旅美工作 20 年，曾任美国康奈尔大学医学院附属卫理公会医院放射肿瘤学教授、阿拉巴马大学病理学教授及南方研究院肿瘤学系主任。全职回国后先后任天津医科大学肿瘤医院副院长、重庆大学附属肿瘤医院院长。他系统提出“智能肿瘤学”学科体系，创办英文期刊《 Intelligent Oncology 》并任主编， 2025 年当选为全球智能肿瘤学联盟主席。长期聚焦基因组稳定性与人工智能在肿瘤诊疗中的交叉应用，主持美国 NIH 基金 8 项及国家自然科学基金等多项课题，发表论文 130 余篇，被引超 16000 次， H 指数 54 ，其创办的《 Intelligent Oncology 》期刊入选中国科技期刊卓越行动计划高起点期刊。
blocks.text_en: Xu Bo graduated from Peking Union Medical College (Ph.D. in clinical medicine in 1998). He is currently Hongshen Distinguished Professor of Chongqing University, Executive Director of Chongqing Oncology Institute, Distinguished Overseas High-Level Talent Expert of the Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Chongqing Talents and Outstanding Scientist. He also serves as the Director of the Intelligent Oncology Medical Basic Research Innovation Center of the Ministry of Education and the first chairman of the Cancer Artificial Intelligence Committee of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association. He has been working in the United States for 20 years and served as professor of radiation oncology at the Methodist Hospital of Cornell University Medical College, professor of pathology at the University of Alabama, and director of the Department of Oncology at the Southern Research Institute. After returning to China full-time, he successively served as deputy director of Tianjin Medical University Cancer Hospital and director of Chongqing University Affiliated Cancer Hospital. He systematically proposed the "intelligent oncology" subject system, founded the English journal "Intelligent Oncology" and served as editor-in-chief. In 2025, he was elected as the chairman of the Global Intelligent Oncology Alliance. He has long been focusing on the cross-application of genome stability and artificial intelligence in tumor diagnosis and treatment. He has presided over 8 projects funded by the US NIH and the National Natural Science Foundation of China. He has published more than 130 papers, which have been cited more than 16,000 times, with an H-index of 54. The journal "Intelligent Oncology" he founded was selected as a high starting point journal in the China Science and Technology Journal Excellence Action Plan.

title_zh: 基于增强深度学习模型分析睾丸细胞组成快速检测小鼠生精缺陷

blocks.text_zh: 徐军教授团队与芝加哥大学/南京医科大学生殖医学国家重点实验室徐宇君教授团队在国际上教早把机器学习技术运用在小鼠睾丸常规H&E 病理 切片的定量分析，通过定量分析精子发生的组织学切片进行 精子发生 自动化分期与识别。最近，合作团队把该方法拓展到雄性不育的小鼠精子发生缺陷的快速检测，该合作工作最近在美国2024年男科学会议上引起较大反响（见下图）。本次会议上，来自美国生殖医学领域的与会人员就如何通过机器学习的手段去辨别含有生育缺陷基因的小鼠的可行性等相关问题与徐宇君教授进行了广泛而深入的互动与交流。这项工作发表在男科领域顶尖杂志Andrology上面。
blocks.text_en: Professor Xu Jun's team and Professor Xu Yujun's team from the State Key Laboratory of Reproductive Medicine at the University of Chicago/Nanjing Medical University have pioneered the application of machine learning technology in the quantitative analysis of conventional H&E pathological sections of mouse testicles, and carried out automated staging and identification of spermatogenesis through quantitative analysis of histological sections of spermatogenesis. Recently, the collaborative team expanded this method to the rapid detection of spermatogenesis defects in male infertile mice. This collaborative work recently caused great repercussions at the 2024 Andrology Conference in the United States (see the picture below). At this meeting, participants from the field of reproductive medicine in the United States had extensive and in-depth interactions and exchanges with Professor Xu Yujun on issues related to the feasibility of using machine learning to identify mice containing fertility defect genes. title_zh: 面向患者生存预测的组织病理学和基因组图谱之间的整体多模态相互作用模型

blocks.text_zh: 摘要： 癌症生存预测需要整合病理全切片图像 (WSI) 和基因组图谱，这是一项极具挑战性的任务，因为模型本身具有异质性，并且对模态间和模态内相互作用进行建模也十分复杂。当前的方法通常采用简单的融合策略进行多模态特征整合，无法全面捕捉模态特异性和模态共性相互作用，导致对多模态相关性的理解有限，预测性能也欠佳。为了弥补这些局限性，本文提出了一种多模态表征解耦网络 (MurreNet) 来推进癌症生存分析。具体而言，我们首先提出了一个多模态表征分解 (MRD) 模块，将成对的输入数据显式分解为模态特异性和模态共性表征，从而减少模态之间的冗余。此外，我们通过一种新颖的训练正则化策略进一步细化并更新解耦后的表征，该策略对模态特征的分布相似性、差异性和代表性施加了约束。最后，通过提出的深度整体正交融合 (DHOF) 策略，将增强的多模态特征集成到联合表示中。基于六个 TCGA 癌症队列进行的大量实验表明，我们的 MurreNet 在生存预测方面达到了最佳 (SOTA) 性能。这项工作被国际医学图像计算领域顶会MICCAI2025录用。
blocks.text_en: Abstract: Cancer survival prediction requires the integration of pathology whole-slice images (WSI) and genomic atlases, which is a challenging task due to the heterogeneity of the model itself and the complexity of modeling inter- and intra-modality interactions. Current methods usually adopt simple fusion strategies for multimodal feature integration, which cannot fully capture modality-specific and modality-common interactions, resulting in limited understanding of multimodal correlations and poor prediction performance. To compensate for these limitations, this paper proposes a multimodal representation decoupling network (MurreNet) to advance cancer survival analysis. Specifically, we first propose a multimodal representation decomposition (MRD) module to explicitly decompose pairs of input data into modality-specific and modality-common representations, thereby reducing redundancy between modalities. Furthermore, we further refine and update the decoupled representation through a novel training regularization strategy that imposes constraints on the distribution similarity, dissimilarity, and representativeness of modal features. Finally, the enhanced multi-modal features are integrated into the joint representation through the proposed deep ensemble orthogonal fusion (DHOF) strategy. Extensive experiments based on six TCGA cancer cohorts show that our MurreNet achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in survival prediction. This work was accepted by MICCAI2025, the top international conference in the field of medical image computing.

title_zh: IMIC实验室近期多项成果被领域内顶会录用

blocks.text_zh: 从顶刊到顶会，智能医学图像计算江苏省高校重点实验室（ IMIC ）的学术影响力正在多维拓展。 IMIC 实验室近期捷报频传，一批聚焦前沿探索的原创成果不仅稳定发表于顶级期刊，更成功跻身多个顶尖学术会议。本文将详细介绍 IMIC 实验室近期在领域内顶会舞台上的最新研究进展。
blocks.text_en: From top journals to top conferences, the academic influence of Jiangsu University Key Laboratory of Intelligent Medical Image Computing (IMIC) is expanding in multiple dimensions. The IMIC Lab has been reporting frequently recently. A number of original results focusing on cutting-edge exploration have not only been steadily published in top journals, but have also successfully entered many top academic conferences. This article will introduce in detail the latest research progress of the IMIC laboratory at the top conference stage in the field.

blocks.text_zh: 成果一： IMIC 实验室博士生刘明新的论文被 MICCAI 2026 录用
blocks.text_en: Result 1: The paper of Liu Mingxin, a doctoral student in IMIC laboratory, was accepted by MICCAI 2026

blocks.text_zh: 近日， IMIC 实验室博士生刘明新（导师：徐军教授）完成的研究论文《 Synergistic Information Disentanglement for Omni-modal Slide Representation Learning in Computational Pathology （基于协同信息解耦的全模态切片表征学习方法）》被国际医学图像计算领域顶会 “ 第 29 届国际医学图像计算与计算机辅助干预会议 (MICCAI 2026) ” 提前接收（ Top 9% ）。 MICCAI 是医学图像计算与计算机辅助干预领域最具影响力的国际顶级会议之一。该会议今年将于 9 月 27 日至 10 月 1 日在法国斯特拉斯堡会议中心举行。
blocks.text_en: Recently, the research paper "Synergistic Information Disentanglement for Omni-modal Slide Representation Learning in Computational Pathology" completed by Liu Mingxin (supervisor: Professor Xu Jun), a doctoral student in the IMIC laboratory, was accepted in advance (Top 9%) by the top international conference in the field of medical image computing, "The 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2026)". MICCAI is one of the most influential top international conferences in the field of medical image computing and computer-assisted intervention. The conference will be held this year from September 27 to October 1 at the Congress Center in Strasbourg, France.

blocks.text_zh: 该研究聚焦计算病理中全切片图像（ Whole-Slide Image, WSI ）建模长期面临的三大挑战：多模态信息利用不足、传统对比学习导致模态冗余对齐以及跨模态协同信号（ synergistic information ）难以有效建模等问题，提出了一种基于协同信息解耦理论的全模态切片表征学习框架 Φ-Omni 。该方法（如图 1 所示）以病理图像、基因组信息与病理报告三种模态为输入，通过模态专属编码器分别提取 WSI patch 特征、转录组表达特征以及临床文本语义特征。在此基础上，模型设计了 Synergistic Information Bottleneck （ SIB ）模块，通过逐层压缩的嵌入空间结构，在降低模态冗余噪声的同时保留跨模态关键信息交互，从而形成紧凑的全局联合表征。进一步地，该研究从 Partial Information Decomposition （ PID ）理论出发，提出 Synergistic Information Disentanglement （ ΦID ）优化目标，将多模态信息分解为冗余信息、特异信息与协同信息三类成分，并显式最大化跨模态不可分解的协同信息（ Φ ），同时抑制单模态可解释的冗余信息。通过结合高斯规范化投影（ Gaussian Canonical Projector, GCP ），该方法在可微高维空间中稳定估计信息熵，并实现对协同信息的可优化建模。在预训练阶段，模型同时引入对比学习对齐损失与 ΦID 协同解耦损失，通过双目标联合优化，使模型既能保持跨模态语义一致性，又能避免传统对比学习导致的表示塌缩问题，从而提升多模态表示的表达与泛化能力。
blocks.text_en: This study focuses on three long-term challenges faced by whole-slide image (WSI) modeling in computational pathology: insufficient utilization of multi-modal information, redundant alignment of modalities caused by traditional contrastive learning, and difficulty in effectively modeling cross-modal synergistic information. A full-modal slice representation learning framework Φ-Omni based on synergistic information decoupling theory is proposed. This method (shown in Figure 1) takes three modalities of pathology images, genome information, and pathology reports as input, and extracts WSI patch features, transcriptome expression features, and clinical text semantic features through modality-specific encoders. On this basis, the model designed a Synergistic Information Bottleneck (SIB) module, which reduces modal redundant noise while retaining cross-modal key information interactions through a layer-by-layer compressed embedding space structure, thereby forming a compact global joint representation. Furthermore, this study starts from the Partial Information Decomposition (PID) theory and proposes the Synergistic Information Disentanglement (ΦID) optimization goal, which decomposes multi-modal information into three types of components: redundant information, specific information and collaborative information, and explicitly maximizes the cross-modal non-decomposable collaborative information (Φ) while suppressing single-modal interpretable redundant information. By combining Gaussian Canonical Projector (GCP), this method stably estimates information entropy in a differentiable high-dimensional space and achieves optimal modeling of collaborative information. In the pre-training stage, the model simultaneously introduces contrastive learning alignment loss and ΦID collaborative decoupling loss. Through dual-objective joint optimization, the model can maintain cross-modal semantic consistency while avoiding the representation collapse problem caused by traditional contrastive learning, thus improving the expression and generalization capabilities of multi-modal representation.

blocks.text_zh: 该方法在乳腺癌与非小细胞肺癌两个 TCGA 大规模队列上进行了系统验证，并在 BRACS 、 CPTAC-BRCA 、 CPTAC-NSCLC 等五个独立外部数据集上开展下游任务评估。在少样本学习设定下（ k=1/5/10/25 ）， Φ-Omni 在多项分类任务中均取得领先性能。例如，在 BRACS 乳腺癌分型任务中， k=25 时 AUC 达到 83.3% ；在 CPTAC-NSCLC 数据集中， k=25 时 AUC 达到 99.4% ，整体性能优于包括 TANGLE, CLAM, TransMIL 及多种病理基础模型在内的现有方法。消融实验进一步表明， Synergistic Information Bottleneck （ SIB ）与 ΦID 解耦目标对模型性能具有关键贡献，其中协同信息最大化机制能够显著提升跨模态表征质量，而冗余压缩机制则有效抑制了模态塌缩现象，使模型在不同任务与数据分布下均表现出更强的稳定性与泛化能力。
blocks.text_en: The method was systematically validated on two TCGA large-scale cohorts of breast cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, and downstream task evaluation was carried out on five independent external data sets including BRACS, CPTAC-BRCA, and CPTAC-NSCLC. Under the few-shot learning setting (k=1/5/10/25), Φ-Omni achieves leading performance in multiple classification tasks. For example, in the BRACS breast cancer classification task, the AUC reaches 83.3% when k=25; in the CPTAC-NSCLC data set, the AUC reaches 99.4% when k=25. The overall performance is better than existing methods including TANGLE, CLAM, TransMIL and various pathological basic models. Ablation experiments further show that the Synergistic Information Bottleneck (SIB) and ΦID decoupling goals have a key contribution to model performance. The synergistic information maximization mechanism can significantly improve the quality of cross-modal representation, while the redundant compression mechanism effectively suppresses the modal collapse phenomenon, allowing the model to show stronger stability and generalization capabilities under different tasks and data distributions.

blocks.text_zh: 该研究在无需额外任务微调的情况下，实现了对 WSI 的高效少样本迁移学习能力，显著提升了多模态病理 AI 模型对复杂生物医学信息的建模能力。相关成果为全模态计算病理学习提供了新的理论框架与方法路径，也为跨模态协同建模在医学人工智能中的应用提供了重要参考。未来，该方法有望进一步扩展至跨中心数据融合、弱监督病理诊断以及多组学整合分析等场景，为精准医疗与智能诊断提供更加可靠的技术支撑。
blocks.text_en: This research achieves efficient few-shot transfer learning capabilities for WSI without the need for additional task fine-tuning, and significantly improves the modeling capabilities of multi-modal pathological AI models for complex biomedical information. Relevant results provide a new theoretical framework and method path for full-modal computational pathology learning, and also provide an important reference for the application of cross-modal collaborative modeling in medical artificial intelligence. In the future, this method is expected to be further expanded to scenarios such as cross-center data fusion, weakly supervised pathological diagnosis, and multi-omics integrated analysis, providing more reliable technical support for precision medicine and intelligent diagnosis.

blocks.text_zh: 成果二： IMIC 实验室罗月梅副教授课题组论文被 IEEE ICASSP 2026 录用
blocks.text_en: Result 2: The paper of Associate Professor Luo Yuemei’s research group in IMIC Lab was accepted by IEEE ICASSP 2026

blocks.text_zh: 近日， IMIC 实验室罗月梅副教授课题组的论文《 Automatic Identification of Retinopathy from Optical Coherence Tomography Images via a Similarity Matching Approach （基于相似性匹配方法的光学相干断层扫描图像视网膜病变自动识别）》被 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing （ IEEE ICASSP 2026 ）录用。 ICASSP 是 IEEE 信号处理学会的老牌顶尖国际会议。第 51 届 ICASSP 于 2026 年 5 月 4 日至 8 日在西班牙巴塞罗那举行。
blocks.text_en: Recently, the paper "Automatic Identification of Retinopathy from Optical Coherence Tomography Images via a Similarity Matching Approach" by the research group of Associate Professor Luo Yuemei of the IMIC Lab was accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (IEEE ICASSP 2026). ICASSP is the oldest and top international conference of the IEEE Signal Processing Society. The 51st ICASSP will be held in Barcelona, ​​Spain, from May 4 to 8, 2026.

blocks.text_zh: 该研究聚焦临床 OCT 影像标注成本高、专业标注样本稀缺，以及传统半监督方法易受低质量伪标签影响等问题，提出了一种同时融合语义级与实例级一致性的半监督视网膜病变识别方法。模型（如图 2 所示）以预训练 Vision Transformer （ ViT ）为骨干网络：对于有标注 OCT 图像，通过弱增强样本与真实标签完成监督学习；对于无标注图像，则构建弱增强与强增强视图，在语义预测层面生成并筛选伪标签，同时在特征空间计算实例相似性。进一步地，该方法通过扩展与聚合操作，使语义伪标签和实例伪标签相互校准、交互更新，并联合优化监督损失、语义级无监督损失和实例级一致性损失，从而提升极少标注条件下伪标签的可靠性与模型的分类鲁棒性。
blocks.text_en: This study focuses on issues such as the high cost of annotating clinical OCT images, the scarcity of professional annotated samples, and the vulnerability of traditional semi-supervised methods to low-quality pseudo-labels. It proposes a semi-supervised retinopathy recognition method that simultaneously integrates semantic-level and instance-level consistency. The model (shown in Figure 2) uses pre-trained Vision Transformer (ViT) as the backbone network: for labeled OCT images, supervised learning is completed through weakly enhanced samples and real labels; for unlabeled images, weakly enhanced and strongly enhanced views are constructed, pseudo labels are generated and filtered at the semantic prediction level, and instance similarities are calculated in the feature space. Furthermore, this method uses expansion and aggregation operations to calibrate and interactively update semantic pseudo-labels and instance pseudo-labels, and jointly optimizes supervised loss, semantic-level unsupervised loss, and instance-level consistency loss, thereby improving the reliability of pseudo-labels and the classification robustness of the model under very few labeling conditions.

blocks.alt_zh: IMIC实验室近期多项成果被领域内顶会录用

blocks.text_zh: 图 2. 本文提出的基于相似性匹配的半监督 OCT 分类框架示意图
blocks.text_en: Figure 2. Schematic diagram of the semi-supervised OCT classification framework based on similarity matching proposed in this article

blocks.text_zh: 该方法在 BOE 和 CELL 两个公开 OCT 数据集上进行了系统验证。在 BOE 数据集中，仅使用 55 幅标注图像（占全部样本的 1.70% ）进行训练，分类准确率达到 96.4% ， AUC 达到 99.7% ；在 CELL 数据集中，仅使用 80 幅标注图像（占全部样本的 0.095% ），分类准确率达到 97.0% ， AUC 达到 99.5% 。与多种传统监督学习和主流半监督学习方法相比，所提方法在两个数据集上的准确率分别提升 2.2 和 3.4 个百分点。消融实验进一步表明，语义级一致性与实例级相似性学习能够形成互补，完整模型获得最佳性能。
blocks.text_en: The method was systematically validated on two public OCT datasets, BOE and CELL. In the BOE data set, only 55 annotated images (accounting for 1.70% of all samples) are used for training, and the classification accuracy reaches 96.4%, and the AUC reaches 99.7%; in the CELL data set, only 80 annotated images (accounting for 0.095% of all samples) are used, the classification accuracy reaches 97.0%, and the AUC reaches 99.5%. Compared with various traditional supervised learning and mainstream semi-supervised learning methods, the accuracy of the proposed method on the two data sets is improved by 2.2 and 3.4 percentage points respectively. Ablation experiments further show that semantic-level consistency and instance-level similarity learning can complement each other, and the complete model achieves the best performance.

blocks.text_zh: 该研究在极低标注比例下仍能实现稳定、准确的 OCT 视网膜病变识别，显著降低了医学影像智能分析对大规模专家标注数据的依赖。相关成果为标注资源有限场景下的视网膜疾病自动筛查与辅助诊断提供了新的技术路径，也为语义信息和实例关系协同驱动的半监督医学影像学习提供了有价值的研究思路。未来，该方法可进一步拓展至跨设备、跨中心及多模态眼科影像分析，为眼病早期筛查和临床决策支持提供更加可靠的人工智能技术支撑。
blocks.text_en: This study can still achieve stable and accurate OCT retinopathy recognition at a very low annotation ratio, significantly reducing the reliance of medical image intelligent analysis on large-scale expert annotation data. Relevant results provide new technical paths for automatic screening and auxiliary diagnosis of retinal diseases in scenarios with limited annotation resources, and also provide valuable research ideas for semi-supervised medical image learning driven by semantic information and instance relationships. In the future, this method can be further expanded to cross-device, cross-center and multi-modal ophthalmic image analysis, providing more reliable artificial intelligence technology support for early screening of eye diseases and clinical decision support.

blocks.text_zh: 近日， IMIC 实验室明文龙老师课题组研究论文《 D²-Former: Mixture-Of-Experts Guided Dual Transformer for Multi-Scale Medical Image Segmentation （ D²-Former ：混合专家引导的双 Transformer 多尺度医学图像分割网络）》被 International Conference on Medical Imaging with Deep Learning （ MIDL 2026 ）录用。 MIDL 是新兴的医学影像与深度学习交叉领域顶级国际会议，聚焦深度学习方法在医学图像分析、计算机辅助诊断、疾病筛查、预后评估和治疗决策等方向的前沿研究，该会议今年将于 7 月 8 日至 10 日在中国台北市举行。
blocks.text_en: Recently, the research paper "D²-Former: Mixture-Of-Experts Guided Dual Transformer for Multi-Scale Medical Image Segmentation (D²-Former: Mixture-Of-Experts Guided Dual Transformer for Multi-Scale Medical Image Segmentation)" by the research group of Professor Ming Wenlong of IMIC Lab was accepted by the International Conference on Medical Imaging with Deep Learning (MIDL 2026). MIDL is an emerging top international conference at the intersection of medical imaging and deep learning, focusing on cutting-edge research of deep learning methods in medical image analysis, computer-aided diagnosis, disease screening, prognosis assessment and treatment decision-making. The conference will be held in Taipei, China, from July 8 to 10 this year.

blocks.text_zh: 医学图像分割是计算机辅助诊断和治疗规划中的关键任务，但真实临床影像常存在边界模糊、尺度变化大和组织形态复杂等问题，使模型难以同时兼顾全局语义理解与局部细节恢复。现有方法在多模态、多结构和多尺度场景下，仍面临特征融合不够自适应、边界刻画不够精细和泛化能力不足等挑战。针对上述问题，研究团队提出了 D²-Former 医学图像分割框架（如图 3 所示）。该方法采用双编码器 — 解码器结构，将 Swin Transformer 与 DINOv3 基础模型相结合，分别提取层次化结构特征和高质量语义表征。同时，模型在 Swin Transformer 中引入 Softer Mixture-of-Experts （ Softer-MoE ）机制，使网络能够根据输入内容自适应地细化特征，以更好地处理复杂解剖结构和模糊边界。在特征融合方面，研究设计了 Spatial-Frequency Gated Channel Attention （ SF-GCA ）模块，通过空间对齐和门控注意力机制融合两条编码分支的互补信息。随后，模型利用 Residual Attention Decoder （ RAD ）逐步恢复高分辨率分割结果，并结合空间与通道注意力及深监督策略，进一步提升边界重建能力和多尺度预测稳定性。
blocks.text_en: Medical image segmentation is a key task in computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning. However, real clinical images often have problems such as blurred boundaries, large scale changes, and complex tissue morphology, making it difficult for the model to simultaneously take into account global semantic understanding and local detail recovery. In multi-modal, multi-structure and multi-scale scenarios, existing methods still face challenges such as insufficient adaptive feature fusion, insufficient fine-grained boundary characterization, and insufficient generalization capabilities. In response to the above problems, the research team proposed the D²-Former medical image segmentation framework (shown in Figure 3). This method uses a dual encoder-decoder structure to combine Swin Transformer with the DINOv3 basic model to extract hierarchical structural features and high-quality semantic representation respectively. At the same time, the model introduces the Softer Mixture-of-Experts (Softer-MoE) mechanism in Swin Transformer, which enables the network to adaptively refine features based on input content to better handle complex anatomical structures and fuzzy boundaries. In terms of feature fusion, the study designed the Spatial-Frequency Gated Channel Attention (SF-GCA) module to fuse the complementary information of the two coding branches through spatial alignment and gated attention mechanisms. Subsequently, the model uses Residual Attention Decoder (RAD) to gradually restore high-resolution segmentation results, and combines spatial and channel attention and deep supervision strategies to further improve boundary reconstruction capabilities and multi-scale prediction stability.

blocks.alt_zh: IMIC实验室近期多项成果被领域内顶会录用

blocks.text_zh: 图 3. 本文提出的 D²-Former 多尺度医学图像分割框架示意图
blocks.text_en: Figure 3. Schematic diagram of the D²-Former multi-scale medical image segmentation framework proposed in this article

blocks.text_zh: 该方法在九个公开医学图像分割数据集上进行了系统验证，覆盖息肉分割、视网膜血管分割、多器官腹部 CT 分割和病理细胞核分割等任务。在 Synapse 多器官腹部 CT 分割数据集上， D²-Former 取得了 85.53% 的平均 Dice 和 77.32% 的 mIoU ，优于多种代表性方法；在 DRIVE 和 STARE 视网膜血管分割数据集上，分别取得 83.21% 和 82.11% 的 F1-score ，表现出对细小、低对比度血管结构的良好识别能力。此外，该方法在息肉分割和病理细胞核分割任务中也取得了具有竞争力的结果，体现出较好的跨任务适应能力。消融实验表明， DINOv3 分支、 SF-GCA 融合模块、 RAD 解码器和 Softer-MoE 机制均有助于提升模型性能。多次独立训练结果进一步显示，该方法在不同随机种子下性能波动较小，具有较好的稳定性和可复现性。
blocks.text_en: The method was systematically verified on nine public medical image segmentation datasets, covering tasks such as polyp segmentation, retinal blood vessel segmentation, multi-organ abdominal CT segmentation, and pathological cell nucleus segmentation. On the Synapse multi-organ abdominal CT segmentation data set, D²-Former achieved an average Dice of 85.53% and an mIoU of 77.32%, which is better than a variety of representative methods; on the DRIVE and STARE retinal blood vessel segmentation data sets, it achieved an F1-score of 83.21% and 82.11% respectively, showing good recognition of small, low-contrast vascular structures. In addition, this method also achieved competitive results in polyp segmentation and pathological cell nucleus segmentation tasks, demonstrating good cross-task adaptability. Ablation experiments show that the DINOv3 branch, SF-GCA fusion module, RAD decoder and Softer-MoE mechanism all help improve model performance. Multiple independent training results further show that the method has smaller performance fluctuations under different random seeds and has better stability and reproducibility.

blocks.text_zh: 该研究面向医学图像分割中的尺度变化、边界模糊和跨任务泛化等问题，探索了基础视觉模型、层次化 Transformer 与混合专家机制的协同建模方式。相关成果为多场景医学图像分割提供了新的网络设计思路，也为基础模型特征迁移、动态专家路由和多尺度特征融合在医学影像智能分析中的应用提供了参考。
blocks.text_en: This research addresses issues such as scale changes, boundary blur, and cross-task generalization in medical image segmentation, and explores a collaborative modeling approach of basic visual models, hierarchical Transformers, and hybrid expert mechanisms. Relevant results provide new network design ideas for multi-scene medical image segmentation, and also provide reference for the application of basic model feature migration, dynamic expert routing and multi-scale feature fusion in medical image intelligent analysis.

blocks.text_zh: 成果四： IMIC 实验室明文龙博士课题组论文被 MICCAI 2026 录用
blocks.text_en: Achievements 4: The paper of Dr. Ming Wenlong’s research group from IMIC Lab was accepted by MICCAI 2026

blocks.text_zh: 近日， IMIC 实验室明文龙老师课题组研究论文《 Noise-Aware Importance–Uncertainty Disentangled Multimodal Learning for Robust Cancer Survival Prediction （面向癌症生存预测的噪声感知重要性 - 不确定性解耦多模态学习）》被 2026 年国际医学图像计算与计算机辅助干预会议（ MICCAI 2026 ）录用。
blocks.text_en: Recently, the research paper "Noise-Aware Importance–Uncertainty Disentangled Multimodal Learning for Robust Cancer Survival Prediction" by the research group of Professor Ming Wenlong of the IMIC Lab was accepted by the 2026 International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2026).

blocks.text_zh: 该研究聚焦多模态癌症预后预测中模态特定的技术噪声与异质性预后特征难以协同建模的关键难题，提出了一种噪声感知的重要性 - 不确定性解耦多模态生存网络（ NADMSurv ）（如图 4 所示）。模型以全切片图像（ WSI ）和 mRNA 表达谱为双模态输入：针对 WSI 预后线索稳定但判别力有限、而 mRNA 预后相关性强却受技术噪声严重干扰的模态不对称性，方法首先通过重要性与不确定性双轨模块联合执行特征预筛选与患者级噪声量化，捕获异质性预后模式；进而利用噪声感知解耦机制将多模态表示分离为共享表示与模态特定表示，实现跨模态互补信息与模态独有信号的显式分离。为建模高阶患者相关性，方法引入超图神经网络构建群体级关联（如图 5 所示），并结合主观逻辑将风险评分转化为证据意见，最终通过交叉注意力与共识算子实现证据级的不确定性融合与鲁棒预后预测。
blocks.text_en: This study focuses on the key problem of modality-specific technical noise and the difficulty in collaborative modeling of heterogeneous prognostic features in multimodal cancer prognosis prediction, and proposes the importance of noise-awareness - Uncertainty Decoupled Multimodal Survival Network (NADMSurv) (as shown in Figure 4). The model takes whole-slice image (WSI) and mRNA expression profile as bimodal inputs: WSI has stable prognostic clues but limited discriminative power, while mRNA For modal asymmetry that has strong prognostic relevance but is severely interfered by technical noise, the method first jointly performs feature pre-screening and patient-level noise quantification through the importance and uncertainty dual-track module to capture heterogeneous prognostic patterns; then, the noise-aware decoupling mechanism is used to separate the multi-modal representation into shared representation and modality-specific representation, achieving explicit separation of cross-modal complementary information and modality-unique signals. In order to model high-order patient correlations, the method introduces a hypergraph neural network to construct group-level correlations (as shown in Figure 5), and combines subjective logic to convert risk scores into evidence opinions. Finally, evidence-level uncertainty fusion and robust prognosis prediction are achieved through cross-attention and consensus operators.

blocks.text_zh: 该方法在 TCGA 数据库的五个癌症队列（乳腺浸润癌 BRCA 、肺腺癌 LUAD 、胃腺癌 STAD 、脑低级别胶质瘤 LGG 和肾透明细胞癌 KIRC ）上进行了系统验证。与九种现有监督、单模态及多模态方法相比， NADMSurv 在所有五个队列中均取得了最优的 C-index 性能。此外，基于模型预测风险分层的 Kaplan-Meier 生存分析显示，高风险组与低风险组患者的生存概率具有显著差异（所有队列 Log-rank 检验 p 值均小于 0.001 ），充分验证了其在临床可行动风险分层中的有效性。
blocks.text_en: The method was systematically validated on five cancer cohorts from the TCGA database (breast invasive carcinoma BRCA, lung adenocarcinoma LUAD, gastric adenocarcinoma STAD, brain low-grade glioma LGG, and clear cell renal cell carcinoma KIRC). Compared with nine existing supervised, single-modal and multi-modal methods, NADMSurv achieves the best C-index performance in all five cohorts. In addition, Kaplan-Meier survival analysis based on model prediction risk stratification showed that the survival probabilities of patients in the high-risk group and the low-risk group were significantly different (log-rank test p values ​​for all cohorts were less than 0.001), fully verifying its effectiveness in clinically actionable risk stratification.

blocks.text_zh: 该研究通过显式建模 WSI 与 mRNA 之间的重要性 - 不确定性不对称性，为技术噪声条件下的多模态癌症生存预测建立了新的范式，提升了预后预测的鲁棒性与可靠性。相关成果为整合病理图像与基因组学数据的精准肿瘤学决策提供了新的技术路径，也为噪声感知的多模态表示学习及证据级融合机制提供了有价值的研究思路。未来，该方法可进一步拓展至更多癌种、多中心异构数据及多组学整合分析，为个性化治疗决策与临床预后评估提供更加可靠的人工智能技术支撑。
blocks.text_en: This study establishes a new paradigm for multimodal cancer survival prediction under technical noise conditions by explicitly modeling the importance-uncertainty asymmetry between WSI and mRNA, improving the robustness and reliability of prognostic prediction. Relevant results provide a new technical path for precise oncology decision-making by integrating pathological images and genomics data, and also provide valuable research ideas for noise-aware multi-modal representation learning and evidence-level fusion mechanisms. In the future, this method can be further expanded to more cancer types, multi-center heterogeneous data and multi-omics integrated analysis, providing more reliable artificial intelligence technology support for personalized treatment decision-making and clinical prognosis assessment.

title_zh: 居胜红

blocks.alt_zh: 居胜红

blocks.text_zh: 居 胜红 ，医学博士，东南大学首席教授、主任医师、博士生导师。现任东南大学医学院副院长、附属中大医院影像科主任。是国家杰出青年科学基金获得者、国家 “ **** ” 科技创新领军人才、科技部 “ 重点领域创新团队 ” 负责人。
blocks.text_en: Ju Shenghong, Doctor of Medicine, is chief professor, chief physician and doctoral supervisor of Southeast University. He is currently the deputy dean of the School of Medicine of Southeast University and the director of the Imaging Department of the Affiliated Zhongda Hospital. He is a winner of the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars, a national “****” leading scientific and technological innovation leader, and the head of the “Key Field Innovation Team” of the Ministry of Science and Technology.

blocks.text_zh: 主要研究方向为影像诊断、分子影像、人工智能和影像组学等。主持国家重点研发计划课题、国家自然科学基金重点项目、重大研究计划重点项目等国家级课题 10 余项。以第一作者 / 通讯作者发表论文 100 余篇。获国家科技进步二等奖、国家教学成果二等奖、教育部科技进步一等奖、江苏省科技进步二等奖等 10 余项。
blocks.text_en: The main research directions include imaging diagnosis, molecular imaging, artificial intelligence and radiomics. He has presided over more than 10 national-level projects such as national key research and development plan projects, key projects of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, and key projects of major research plans. Published more than 100 papers as the first author/corresponding author. He has won more than 10 awards, including the second prize of the National Science and Technology Progress Award, the second prize of the National Teaching Achievement Award, the first prize of the Ministry of Education’s Science and Technology Progress Award, and the second prize of the Jiangsu Province Science and Technology Progress Award.

blocks.text_zh: 现任中华放射学会常委、中国放射医师协会常委、教育部高等学校医学技术教学指导委员会委员、江苏省放射学会副主委，亚洲腹部影像学会执委。获中华放射学会年度金奖、全国 “ 住院医师心中好老师 ” 、江苏省第五期 “333 高层次人才 ” 、江苏省优秀教育工作者、江苏省 “ 六大人才高峰 ” 等荣誉。
blocks.text_en: He is currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Chinese Society of Radiology, a member of the Standing Committee of the Chinese Association of Radiologists, a member of the Medical Technology Teaching Steering Committee of Higher Education Institutions of the Ministry of Education, a deputy chairman of the Jiangsu Provincial Society of Radiology, and an executive committee member of the Asian Abdominal Imaging Society. Won the annual gold medal of the Chinese Society of Radiology, the national “Good Teacher among Resident Physicians”, the fifth batch of “333 High-level Talents” of Jiangsu Province, the Outstanding Educator of Jiangsu Province, and the “Six Talent Peaks” of Jiangsu Province.

Studied at Sheffield University in the UK and Virginia Commonwealth University in the US.

blocks.text_zh: 现任东南大学消化疾病研究所所长、东南大学学部委员、中华消化内镜学分会消化道癌筛查协作组副组长、中华消化内镜学会第五六七届全国委员、中国医师协会内镜介入专委会副主委、中国医师协会消化医师分会全国委员、江苏省医师协会消化内镜分会前任会长、江苏省消化和消化内镜学会原主任委员、世界内镜医师协会消化内镜联盟副理事长。教育部科技进步奖和国家科技进步奖评审专家。江苏省 “ 135 ”和“兴卫工程”医学重点人才，江苏省“ 333 ”工程重点培养人才。
blocks.text_en: He is currently the director of the Institute of Digestive Diseases of Southeast University, a member of the Faculty of Southeast University, the deputy leader of the Digestive Cancer Screening Collaboration Group of the Chinese Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, the 567th National Committee member of the Chinese Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, the vice chairman of the Interventional Endoscopy Committee of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association, the national committee member of the Gastroenterological Physician Branch of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association, the former president of the Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Branch of the Jiangsu Physician Association, the former chairman of the Jiangsu Society of Digestive and Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, and the vice chairman of the World Association of Endoscopists Digestive Endoscopy Alliance. Evaluation expert for the Science and Technology Progress Award of the Ministry of Education and the National Science and Technology Progress Award. Jiangsu Province's "135" and "Health Project" key medical talents, Jiangsu Province's "333" project focuses on cultivating talents.

blocks.text_zh: 系《中华消化杂志》、《中华消化内镜杂志》、《中华内科杂志》电子版、《世界华人消化杂志》、《胃肠病学杂志》、《南京医科大学学报》、《药学与临床》、《江苏医药》等杂志常务编委及编委；英文杂志《 world journal of gastroenterology 》、《 Journal of Crohn's and Colitis 》、《 BMC Cancer 》特约审稿专家， WJG 编委。
blocks.text_en: He is a standing editorial board member and editorial board member of the Chinese Journal of Gastroenterology, the Chinese Journal of Gastroenterology, the electronic version of the Chinese Journal of Internal Medicine, the World Chinese Journal of Gastroenterology, the Journal of Gastroenterology, the Journal of Nanjing Medical University, Pharmacy and Clinical Science, and Jiangsu Medicine; a special reviewer for the English magazines "world journal of gastroenterology", "Journal of Crohn's and Colitis", and "BMC Cancer", WJG Editorial Board Member.

blocks.text_zh: 发表中英文论文 130 余篇（ SCI60 余篇，通讯作者 40 余篇，中华系列文章 60 余篇），主编 / 副主编专著 4 部，主持科技部“十一五”支撑课题 1 项，国家自然科学基金 3 项，省部级课题 16 项，获省厅级奖项 10 余项。研究成果曾分别在 2007 年 UEGW （巴黎）和 2010 年和 2014 年美国 DDW （新奥尔良和芝加哥）上作大会发言交流。

blocks.text_zh: 擅长食管高级别上皮内瘤变的内镜下黏膜剥离术（ ESD ），已完成食管 ESD2500 余例，胃 ESD1500 余例，肠 ESD1000 余例。
blocks.text_en: He specializes in endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) of high-grade esophageal intraepithelial neoplasia, and has completed more than 2,500 cases of esophageal ESD, more than 1,500 gastric ESD cases, and more than 1,000 intestinal ESD cases.

blocks.text_zh: 擅长食管、胃、肠道起源于粘膜下和固有肌层平滑肌瘤和间质瘤的隧道内镜技术（ STER ），全壁层切除术（ EFR ）等，成功完成 STER 和 EFR 手术 1000 余例。
blocks.text_en: He specializes in tunnel endoscopic techniques (STER) for leiomyomas and stromal tumors originating from the submucosal and muscularis propria in the esophagus, stomach, and intestine, and total parietal resection (EFR). He has successfully completed more than 1,000 cases of STER and EFR surgeries.

blocks.text_zh: 擅长贲门失弛缓症、食管憩室的 POEM 术 800 余例，（其中，一岁余患儿 3 例，食管憩室近 20 例）。
blocks.text_en: He specializes in more than 800 cases of POEM surgery for achalasia and esophageal diverticulum (including 3 cases of children over one year old and nearly 20 cases of esophageal diverticulum).

blocks.text_zh: 擅长胃轻瘫、原发性胃排空障碍的 G-POEM 术（ 100 余例）。 ES D 术后疤痕切除术 30 余例，效果显著。
blocks.text_en: Specialized in G-POEM surgery for gastroparesis and primary gastric emptying disorder (more than 100 cases). More than 30 cases of scar excision were performed after ES D, with remarkable results.

blocks.text_zh: 擅长消化道良恶性狭窄的扩张和支架治疗，完成支架治疗逾万例。
blocks.text_en: He is good at dilation and stent treatment of benign and malignant strictures of the digestive tract, and has completed more than 10,000 stent treatments.

blocks.text_zh: 擅长消化道出血的内镜下治疗。
blocks.text_en: Specializes in endoscopic treatment of gastrointestinal bleeding.

blocks.text_zh: 擅长重症胰腺炎的救治。
blocks.text_en: Specialized in the treatment of severe pancreatitis.

blocks.text_zh: 擅长消化系统疑难杂症的诊治。 专家门诊时间：中大医院本部周二上午、周四上午 中大医院江北院区周一上午。
blocks.text_en: Specialized in the diagnosis and treatment of difficult and complicated diseases of the digestive system. Expert clinic hours: Tuesday morning and Thursday morning at the Zhongda Hospital headquarters and Monday morning at the Jiangbei campus of Zhongda Hospital.

title_zh: 李玲

blocks.text_zh: 李玲 ，德国医学博士，美国 UCLA 博士后，主任医师，教授，博士生导师。东南大学胰腺研究所所长，东南大学糖脂代谢研究中心主任，东南大学附属中大医院院长助理、内分泌科主任。长期致力于胰腺内、外分泌疾病与胰岛功能损伤相关研究，积极推进医工结合与创新转化，开展多方位国际合作。在 Nature Communications 等 SCI 期刊发表论文 50 余篇，其中 10 分以上高影响力论文 5 篇。担任国家自然科学基金委医学科学部通讯评委、教育部博士学位论文评审专家、 SCI 前沿期刊客座主编；中华医学会糖尿病学分会青年委员、江苏省医学会糖尿病分会副主委、南京医学会内分泌学分会副主委。
blocks.text_en: Li Ling, doctor of medicine from Germany, postdoctoral fellow at UCLA in the United States, chief physician, professor, and doctoral supervisor. Director of the Pancreatic Research Institute of Southeast University, Director of the Glucolipid Metabolism Research Center of Southeast University, Assistant to the President and Director of the Endocrinology Department of Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University. He has long been committed to research related to pancreatic endocrine and exocrine diseases and islet function damage, actively promotes the integration of medicine and engineering and innovative transformation, and carries out multi-faceted international cooperation. Published more than 50 papers in SCI journals such as Nature Communications, including 5 high-impact papers with scores of 10 or above. He serves as a communication reviewer for the Department of Medical Sciences of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, a doctoral dissertation review expert for the Ministry of Education, and a guest editor of SCI cutting-edge journals; a youth committee member of the Diabetes Branch of the Chinese Medical Association, a deputy chairman of the Diabetes Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association, and a deputy chairman of the Endocrinology Branch of the Nanjing Medical Association.

blocks.alt_zh: 李玲

blocks.text_zh: 主持项目：国家重点研发计划子课题 1 项、国家自然科学基金 5 项、江苏省重点研发计划项目 1 项、江苏省卫健委重点项目 1 项。以研究成果为依托，积极推动糖尿病与胰腺疾病的器官组织间对话前沿研究、开展国际多中心临床试验，以及大数据在医疗系统、信息平台建设、健康监测和临床辅助决策中的应用。
blocks.text_en: Hosted projects: 1 national key R&D plan sub-project, 5 National Natural Science Foundation projects, 1 Jiangsu Provincial key R&D plan project, and 1 Jiangsu Provincial Health Commission key project. Based on research results, we actively promote cutting-edge research on inter-organ tissue dialogue between diabetes and pancreatic diseases, conduct international multi-center clinical trials, and apply big data in medical systems, information platform construction, health monitoring and clinical decision-making assistance.

blocks.text_zh: 主要获奖及人才称号：获国家教育部高等学校科学研究优秀成果奖、江苏省青年科技奖、江苏医学科技奖、江苏省新技术引进奖。江苏省 “333 高层次人才培养工程 ” （二层次，领军人才），江苏省 “ 六大人才高峰 ” ，江苏省 “ 科教强卫 ” 医学重点人才，江苏省 “ 六个一工程 ” 高层次人才。
blocks.text_en: Main awards and talent titles: Won the National Ministry of Education’s Higher Education Institutions Scientific Research Outstanding Achievements Award, Jiangsu Province Youth Science and Technology Award, Jiangsu Medical Science and Technology Award, and Jiangsu Province New Technology Introduction Award. Jiangsu Province’s “333 High-level Talent Training Project” (second level, leading talents), Jiangsu Province’s “Six Talent Peaks”, Jiangsu Province’s “Science, Education and Health” key medical talents, Jiangsu Province’s “Six One Project” high-level talents.

title_zh: 马根山

blocks.alt_zh: 马根山

blocks.text_zh: 马根山 ，男，医学博士，二级教授，主任医师，博士生导师，东南大学附属中大医院心血管内科主任，东南大学心血管病研究所副所长。自1989年开始从事介入性心脏病工作，曾留学澳大利亚，擅长各种心血管病的介入诊治，尤其是冠心病的介入治疗技术在国内享有较高的声誉，已独立完成和指导完成冠状动脉球囊成型术和支架术10000余例，组织和主持国际性冠心病血运重建学术会议19次。
blocks.text_en: Ma Genshan, male, doctor of medicine, second-level professor, chief physician, doctoral supervisor, director of the Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, and deputy director of the Institute of Cardiovascular Diseases of Southeast University. He has been engaged in interventional cardiology since 1989. He studied in Australia and is good at the interventional diagnosis and treatment of various cardiovascular diseases. In particular, the interventional treatment technology of coronary heart disease enjoys a high reputation in China. He has independently completed and guided more than 10,000 cases of coronary artery balloon angioplasty and stent surgery, and organized and chaired 19 international academic conferences on coronary heart disease revascularization.

blocks.text_zh: 现为江苏省医学会心血管病分会候任主任委员、南京医学会心血管病学专科分会主任委员、江苏省医师协会心血管内科医师分会副会长、中华医学会心血管分会介入心脏病学组委员、中国医师协会心血管内科医师分会常务委员、中国医师协会心力衰竭专业委员会副主任委员、中国医师协会心血管内科医师分会委员会超声心动图和影像学组副组长、ISHR中国转化医学工作委员会副主任委员、中国胸痛中心执行委员会委员、中国医院协会心脏康复管理专业委员会常务委员、江苏省医师协会高血压专业委员会副主任委员、江苏省免疫学会心血管炎症和免疫专业委员会副主任委员、江苏省医学会心血管病学分会心力衰竭学组组长、美国心脏病学学会委员；江苏省医学重点学科带头人，江苏省优秀重点人才，江苏省医学领军人才；国家自然科学基金同行评议专家组成员、国家发改委药品定价委员、国家教育部国际合作项目评审专家；《中华心血管病杂志》、《中华心力衰竭和心肌病杂志》、《中国介入心脏病学杂志》、《中国分子心脏病学杂志》等多种医学期刊编委。
blocks.text_en: He is currently the Chairman-elect of the Cardiovascular Disease Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association, the Chairman of the Cardiovascular Medicine Branch of the Nanjing Medical Association, the Vice President of the Cardiovascular Physicians Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Doctors Association, the Interventional Cardiology Group Member of the Cardiovascular Branch of the Chinese Medical Association, the Standing Committee of the Cardiovascular Physicians Branch of the Chinese Medical Doctors Association, and the Cardiovascular Physicians Branch of the Chinese Medical Doctors Association. Deputy Chairman of the Heart Failure Professional Committee, Deputy Chairman of the Echocardiography and Imaging Group of the Cardiovascular Physicians Branch Committee of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association, Deputy Chairman of the ISHR Chinese Translational Medicine Working Committee, Member of the Executive Committee of the China Chest Pain Center, Standing Member of the Cardiac Rehabilitation Management Professional Committee of the Chinese Hospital Association, and Physician of Jiangsu Province Vice Chairman of the Hypertension Professional Committee of the Association, Vice Chairman of the Cardiovascular Inflammation and Immunity Professional Committee of the Jiangsu Society of Immunology, Leader of the Heart Failure Group of the Cardiovascular Disease Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association, and Member of the American College of Cardiology; Leader of key medical disciplines in Jiangsu Province, Outstanding Key Talents of Jiangsu Province, and Leading Medical Talents of Jiangsu Province ; Member of the National Natural Science Foundation of China peer review expert group, National Development and Reform Commission Drug Pricing Committee, National Ministry of Education international cooperation project evaluation expert; "Chinese Journal of Cardiovascular Diseases", "Chinese Journal of Heart Failure and Cardiomyopathy", "Chinese Journal of Interventional Cardiology", "Chinese Journal of Molecular Cardiology" and other medical journals.

blocks.text_zh: 完成和承担国家自然科学基金6项，江苏省科技厅重点研发计划1项，省部级课题11项，获江苏省科学技术奖二等奖1项、三等奖5项，江苏省卫生厅新技术引进奖12项，获得发明专利2项；培养指导博士研究生27名，硕士研究生58名；在国内外核心期刊发表论文180余篇，主编和参编专著10部。
blocks.text_en: He has completed and undertaken 6 National Natural Science Foundation projects, 1 key R&D plan of the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Science and Technology, 11 provincial and ministerial level projects, won 1 second prize and 5 third prizes of the Jiangsu Provincial Science and Technology Award, 12 New Technology Introduction Awards from the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Health, and obtained 2 invention patents. He has trained and mentored 27 doctoral students and 58 master's students. He has published more than 180 papers in core journals at home and abroad, and has edited or co-edited 10 monographs.

title_zh: 张晓良

blocks.text_zh: 张晓良 ，主任医师、英国 Cardiff 大学医学博士、博士生导师，现任东南大学附属中大医院肾脏内科主任、东南大学肾脏病研究所副所长。先后主持国家自然科学基金四项、江苏省自然科学基金一项、江苏省重点人才项目一项、江苏省临床医学研究中心（ BL2014080 ）项目子课题一项、中央高校及省级高校创新项目三项，东南大学校级教改课题二项，指导博士及硕士研究生 40 余名。第一及通讯作者发表专业研究文章 80 余篇，其中 SCI 文章 50 余篇，编写教材专著多部。
blocks.text_en: Zhang Xiaoliang, chief physician, doctor of medicine and doctoral supervisor at Cardiff University in the UK, is currently the director of the Department of Nephrology, Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, and the deputy director of the Institute of Nephrology of Southeast University. He has successively presided over four National Natural Science Foundation projects, one Jiangsu Provincial Natural Science Foundation project, one Jiangsu Provincial Key Talent Project, one Jiangsu Provincial Clinical Medical Research Center (BL2014080) project sub-project, three central and provincial university innovation projects, two Southeast University school-level teaching reform projects, and has supervised more than 40 doctoral and master students. The first and corresponding author has published more than 80 professional research articles, including more than 50 SCI articles, and written many textbooks and monographs.

blocks.alt_zh: 张晓良

blocks.text_zh: 曾任第八届中华医学会肾脏病学分会全国青年委员，现任江苏省中西医结合学会肾病专业委员会主任委员、中国肾脏病大数据应用创新联盟常务副理事长、中国医药教育协会临床肾脏病学专业委员会全国常委，江苏省医师协会肾脏病分会副会长、中国中药协会肾病中药发展研究专业委员会全国委员、中国研究型医院学会血液净化专业委员会及 CKD-MBD 学组委员、江苏省医学会肾脏病专科分会常委、江苏省医院协会血液净化中心分会常委、南京医学会肾病分会副主任委员、国家自然科学基金委评审专家，任 7 项学术及科技社会专家库成员。
blocks.text_en: He once served as the national youth committee member of the 8th Chinese Medical Association Nephrology Branch, and currently serves as the chairman of the Kidney Disease Professional Committee of the Jiangsu Association of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine, the executive vice chairman of the China Kidney Disease Big Data Application Innovation Alliance, the national standing committee member of the Clinical Nephrology Professional Committee of the China Medical Education Association, the vice president of the Kidney Disease Branch of the Jiangsu Physician Association, the national member of the Kidney Disease Traditional Chinese Medicine Development and Research Professional Committee of the Chinese Traditional Chinese Medicine Association, the Blood Purification Professional Committee of the Chinese Association of Research Hospitals and CKD-MBD. Member of the academic group, member of the Standing Committee of the Nephrology Branch of the Jiangsu Provincial Medical Association, standing member of the Blood Purification Center Branch of the Jiangsu Provincial Hospital Association, deputy director of the Nephrology Branch of the Nanjing Medical Association, review expert of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, and member of 7 academic and scientific and social expert databases.

blocks.text_zh: 先后获得国家教育部科学技术进步二等奖、江苏省科学技术进步二等奖、中华医学科技三等奖项。教学中勇于创新，获得校级教改项目多项，先后担任本科生、研究生理论教学，开创 PBL 教学法和针对留学生的全英文教学，多次获得东南大学医学院及中大医院优秀教师、临床教学奖、住院医师规培优秀导师、优秀住培基地主任等称号， 2019 年获得江苏省及国家级优秀住陪专业基地主任称号。
blocks.text_en: He has won the second-class Science and Technology Progress Award from the Ministry of Education, the second-class Science and Technology Progress Award from Jiangsu Province, and the third-class Chinese Medical Science and Technology Award. He has the courage to innovate in teaching and has won many school-level education reform projects. He has served as theoretical teaching for undergraduates and postgraduates, pioneered the PBL teaching method and all-English teaching for international students. He has repeatedly won the title of Outstanding Teacher at Southeast University School of Medicine and Zhongda Hospital, Clinical Teaching Award, Outstanding Tutor for Resident Training, Director of Outstanding Residential Training Base, etc. In 2019, he was awarded the title of Director of Jiangsu Province and National Outstanding Residential Accompanying Professional Base.

blocks.text_zh: 长期从事肾脏病学临床与相关研究工作，主要研究方向包括：罕见肾脏病分子诊断研究、炎症细胞在肾脏纤维化中的作用机制、慢性肾脏病患者钙化防御的基础与临床研究、肾脏病与人工智能。在肾脏病与人工智能方面，科室依托东南大学附属中大医院肾脏内科、东南大学肾脏病研究所、江苏省肾脏病临床研究中心，拥有独立的临床先进肾脏病理诊断中心、全自动病理制样、数字化病理系统及透射电镜等设备。着力开发肾脏病理诊断与人工智能相结合的高通量精准诊断方案，包括：肾脏病理图像的特征提取、肾脏组织病理诊断及其模式识别、临床大数据统计模型及基于机器学习的 IgA 肾病诊断方法、基于深度学习的膜性肾病病理诊断系统建立及应用研究、临床诊疗融合人工智能成果的应用研究。
blocks.text_en: He has been engaged in clinical and related research work in nephrology for a long time. His main research directions include: research on molecular diagnosis of rare kidney diseases, the mechanism of inflammatory cells in renal fibrosis, basic and clinical research on calciphylaxis in patients with chronic kidney disease, kidney disease and artificial intelligence. In terms of nephrology and artificial intelligence, the department relies on the Department of Nephrology, Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, the Institute of Nephrology of Southeast University, and the Jiangsu Provincial Kidney Disease Clinical Research Center. It has an independent clinical advanced renal pathology diagnosis center, fully automatic pathology sample preparation, digital pathology system, transmission electron microscope and other equipment. Focus on developing high-throughput accurate diagnosis solutions that combine renal pathology diagnosis with artificial intelligence, including: feature extraction of renal pathology images, renal tissue pathology diagnosis and pattern recognition, clinical big data statistical models and IgA nephropathy diagnosis methods based on machine learning, establishment and application research of a pathological diagnosis system for membranous nephropathy based on deep learning, and application research on the integration of artificial intelligence results in clinical diagnosis and treatment.

title_zh: 袁勇贵

blocks.alt_zh: 袁勇贵

blocks.text_zh: 袁勇贵 ，医学博士，主任医师，青年特聘教授，博士生导师，江苏省优秀重点医学人才，江苏省第五期“333工程”第二层次培养对象，江苏省“科教强卫”精神病学创新团队负责人，东南大学附属中大医院心理精神科主任，国际心身医学会（ICPM）会员，美国佛罗里达大学精神医学系访问学者。从事抑郁症临床诊治和发病机制、心身相关障碍的临床诊治和发病机制、心理评估与心理治疗的机制等研究近三十年。
blocks.text_en: Yuan Yonggui, MD, chief physician, young distinguished professor, doctoral supervisor, outstanding key medical talent in Jiangsu Province, second-level training target of the fifth phase of Jiangsu Province’s “333 Project”, leader of the psychiatry innovation team of Jiangsu Province’s “Strengthening Health through Science and Education”, director of the Department of Psychology and Psychiatry, Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, member of the International Council of Psychosomatic Medicine (ICPM), and visiting scholar at the Department of Psychiatry at the University of Florida. He has been engaged in research on the clinical diagnosis, treatment and pathogenesis of depression, the clinical diagnosis, treatment and pathogenesis of psychosomatic-related disorders, and the mechanisms of psychological assessment and psychotherapy for nearly thirty years.

blocks.text_zh: 现任中华医学会心身医学分会主任委员，江苏省医学会精神医学分会候任主任委员，江苏省医师协会心身医学专业委员会主任委员，江苏省医学会心身与行为医学分会前任主任委员，江苏省医师协会精神病学分会副会长，2019年被中华医学会心身医学分会评为“心身医学突出贡献专家”称号，被江苏省医学会评为“优秀主任委员”称号。
blocks.text_en: He is currently the chairman of the Psychosomatic Medicine Branch of the Chinese Medical Association, the elected chairman of the Psychiatry Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association, the chairman of the Psychosomatic Medicine Professional Committee of the Jiangsu Medical Association, the former chairman of the Psychosomatic and Behavioral Medicine Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association, and the vice president of the Psychiatry Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Doctor Association. In 2019, he was named the "Expert with Outstanding Contributions to Psychosomatic Medicine" by the Psychosomatic Medicine Branch of the Chinese Medical Association and the title of "Excellent Chairman" by the Jiangsu Medical Association.

blocks.text_zh: 主持国家自然科学基金面上项目（30970814、81071101、81371488，81571330，81771480和81971277）6项。获中华医学科技奖一等奖1项、三等奖1项，教育部自然科学奖一等奖2项，二等奖1项，华夏医学科技奖二等奖1项，江苏省科学技术一等奖1项，三等奖1项，省卫生厅新技术引进奖一等奖4项，二等奖1项，市科技进步二等奖2项，三等奖2项。主编著作25部，发表论文415篇，其中SCI论文187篇。
blocks.text_en: Hosted 6 National Natural Science Foundation of China projects (30970814, 81071101, 81371488, 81571330, 81771480 and 81971277). He has won 1 first prize and 1 third prize of the China Medical Science and Technology Award, 2 first prizes and 1 second prize of the Natural Science Award of the Ministry of Education, 1 second prize of the Huaxia Medical Science and Technology Award, 1 first prize and 1 third prize of the Jiangsu Provincial Science and Technology Award, 4 first prizes and 1 second prize of the New Technology Introduction Award of the Provincial Department of Health, and 2 second prizes and 2 third prizes of the Municipal Science and Technology Progress Award. He has edited 25 books and published 415 papers, including 187 SCI papers.

title_zh: 吴国球

title_zh: 谢春明

title_zh: 谢金兵

blocks.text_zh: 谢金兵 ，教授、博士生导师， 入选国家高层次人才项目“火炬计划”，南京市紫金山英才先锋计划人才。先后留学美国韦恩州立大学化学工程系、日本纳米医药创新中心。具有生命科学、医学影像学、生物医学工程等多学科研究背景 , 长期从事多功能纳米生物技术及分子影像和疾病治疗研究工作。近年来，在国际著名期刊 Nature Nanotechnology 、 Chemical Society Reviews 、 Nature Biomedical Engineering 、 Advanced Materials 、 ACS Nano 、 Biomaterials 、 Theranostics 、 Advanced Healthcare Materials 等发表论文 30 多篇。研究成果被多家媒体作为亮点专题报道和评述。获得国家高层次人才项目、国家自然科学基金面上、青年项目，日本学术振兴会 (JSPS) 特别研究员奖励等资助。应邀担任 SCI 杂志 Frontiers in Bioengineering and Biotechnology 及 Molecules 客座编辑，长期担任 Biomaterials, Theranostics ， Chemical Engineering Journal ， Biotechnology Journal 等多个国际学术期刊的审稿人。医工结合拟主要研究方向： 1) 应用人工智能研究肿瘤、神经血管类疾病的影像； 2 ）应用人工智能研究生物材料与机体的相互作用； 3 ）应用人工智能进行药物筛选研究等。
blocks.text_en: Xie Jinbing, professor and doctoral supervisor, was selected into the National High-level Talent Project "Torch Plan" and Nanjing Purple Mountain Talent Pioneer Plan Talent. He studied abroad in the Chemical Engineering Department of Wayne State University in the United States and the Nanomedicine Innovation Center in Japan. He has a multidisciplinary research background in life sciences, medical imaging, and biomedical engineering, and has long been engaged in research on multifunctional nanobiotechnology, molecular imaging, and disease treatment. In recent years, he has published more than 30 papers in internationally renowned journals such as Nature Nanotechnology, Chemical Society Reviews, Nature Biomedical Engineering, Advanced Materials, ACS Nano, Biomaterials, Theranostics, and Advanced Healthcare Materials. The research results have been highlighted and commented on by many media. He has received funding from the National High-level Talent Project, the National Natural Science Foundation of China and the Youth Project, and the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS) Special Researcher Award. He was invited to serve as a guest editor for the SCI magazines Frontiers in Bioengineering and Biotechnology and Molecules, and has long been a reviewer for many international academic journals such as Biomaterials, Theranostics, Chemical Engineering Journal, and Biotechnology Journal. The main research directions of the integration of medicine and engineering are: 1) Apply artificial intelligence to study imaging of tumors and neurovascular diseases; 2) Apply artificial intelligence to study the interaction between biological materials and the body; 3) Apply artificial intelligence to conduct drug screening research, etc.

blocks.text_zh: 芮云峰 ，教授、主任医师、博士生导师。东南大学医学院院长助理、外科学系副主任，东南大学附属中大医院骨科副主任，东南大学创伤骨科研究所副所长。香港中文大学博士、博士后。担任科技部生物材料核心库专家、国家自然基金委评审专家、教育部学位与研究生教育发展中心评审专家、上海市、江苏省和江西省科技专家库专家、江苏省医疗机构高值医用耗材集中采购评审专家和南京市卫健委重点项目评审专家。临床专业特长包括：老年髋部骨折患者的微创内固定和关节置换治疗、围手术期多学科协作诊疗（ MDT ）；骨质疏松性骨折的微创治疗；严重、多发创伤的多学科诊疗；足、踝部疾病的诊疗；急、慢性肌腱、韧带损伤。
blocks.text_en: Rui Yunfeng, professor, chief physician, doctoral supervisor. Assistant to the Dean of the School of Medicine of Southeast University, Deputy Director of the Department of Surgery, Deputy Director of the Department of Orthopedics, Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, and Deputy Director of the Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics of Southeast University. blocks.text_zh: 主持各级、各类课题 10 余项，其中国家自然基金项目 3 项。发表本专业相关学术论文 120 余篇，其中第一作者和通讯作者论文 70 余篇，其中 SCI 收录 30 余篇。主译《老年骨科学》，担任《中国修复重建外科杂志》、《足踝外科电子杂志》、 Journal of Orthopaedic Translation 和 World Journal of Stem Cells 等 6 本专业杂志编委；是《中华创伤骨科杂志》、《中华骨科杂志》、 Journal of Orthopaedic Research 、 Biomaterials 和 American Journal of Sport Medicine 等 35 个专业杂志特邀审稿人。
blocks.text_en: He has presided over more than 10 projects at all levels and of various types, including 3 National Natural Science Foundation projects. He has published more than 120 academic papers related to this major, including more than 70 papers as the first author and corresponding author, of which more than 30 papers have been included in SCI. He is the main translator of "Geriatric Orthopedics" and serves as an editorial board member of 6 professional magazines including "Chinese Journal of Reconstructive Surgery", "Electronic Journal of Foot and Ankle Surgery", Journal of Orthopedic Translation and World Journal of Stem Cells; and is a special reviewer of 35 professional magazines including "Chinese Journal of Traumatology and Orthopedics", "Chinese Journal of Orthopedics", Journal of Orthopedic Research, Biomaterials and American Journal of Sport Medicine.

title_zh: 顾小春

blocks.text_zh: 顾小春 ，博士，副教授，北京大学南京转化研究院（江北新区）研究员；东南大学博士， 2014 年至 2016 年赴美国纽约州立大学石溪分校生物医学工程系访问学者和博士后研究，主要利用先进的成像技术及表型组学新技术进行神经血管以及神经调制的相关研究，具有交叉学科研究背景，自主搭建了用于神经血管同步成像的多光谱成像系统，发现了胶质细胞在神经血管耦合作用中的新作用，对调控神经血管发育的 CR 细胞生物学进行了一系列研究，制作了一系列的相关基因修饰动物疾病动物模型，参与共建南京脑观象台并共同发起“介观脑功能联结图谱”大科学计划。
blocks.text_en: Gu Xiaochun, Ph.D., associate professor, researcher at Nanjing Translational Research Institute of Peking University (Jiangbei New District); Ph.D. of Southeast University, 2014 to 2016 He was a visiting scholar and postdoctoral researcher in the Department of Biomedical Engineering at the State University of New York at Stony Brook in the United States. He mainly used advanced imaging technology and new phenotypic technologies to conduct research on neurovascular and neuromodulation. With an interdisciplinary research background, he independently built a multispectral imaging system for synchronized neurovascular imaging and discovered the new role of glial cells in neurovascular coupling, which is important for CR in regulating neurovascular development. He has conducted a series of studies on cell biology, produced a series of relevant genetically modified animal disease animal models, participated in the co-construction of the Nanjing Brain Observatory and co-initiated the "Mesoscopic Brain Functional Connection Atlas" large scientific project.

blocks.text_zh: 开展中项目：肝癌 TACE 术后活性灶基于人工智能的相关研究（ 2022-2026 ）
blocks.text_en: Ongoing projects: Artificial intelligence-based research on active lesions after TACE for liver cancer (2022-2026)

blocks.text_zh: 经动脉化疗栓塞术（ TACE ）是中期肝癌的一线疗法。 TACE 术后活性灶的准确评价是评估疗效及制定后续治疗方案的关键。目前对活性灶的评价尚存在一系列问题，如人工评价效率低下，评价结果准确性欠佳，指导治疗价值有限。近年来，人工智能辅助下的影像评价模式得到快速发展，并在多个领域落地应用，但其用于 TACE 术后活性灶评价尚处起步阶段，有极大的研究和临床转化前景。本项目将通过优选深度学习算法，结合影像组学、人工评价等信息，实现活性灶敏感检出、精准诊断以及转归预测。
blocks.text_en: Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is the first-line treatment for intermediate-stage liver cancer. Accurate evaluation of active lesions after TACE is key to evaluating efficacy and formulating subsequent treatment plans. At present, there are still a series of problems in the evaluation of active lesions, such as low efficiency of manual evaluation, poor accuracy of evaluation results, and limited value in guiding treatment. In recent years, image evaluation models assisted by artificial intelligence have developed rapidly and been applied in many fields. However, its use in the evaluation of active lesions after TACE is still in its infancy and has great research and clinical translation prospects. This project will achieve sensitive detection, accurate diagnosis and outcome prediction of active lesions by optimizing deep learning algorithms and combining radiomics, manual evaluation and other information.

title_zh: 焦蕴

blocks.text_zh: 焦蕴 ，东南大学 - 美国宾夕法尼亚大学联合培养工学博士，东南大学附属中大医院网络信息中心主任，放射科副教授、硕士生导师，长期从事医学信息学和医学影像方面的研究。主要研究方向：生物医学信息学、医学影像和人工智能。目前已主持国家自然科学基金面上项目一项、青年项目一项，江苏省自然科学基金面上项目一项，作为学术骨干参与国家重点基础研究计划（ 973 计划），国家自然科学基金面上和重大研究项目多项，已获得 2016 年国家科技进步二等奖一项（排名第五）、 2012 年教育部科技进步一等奖（排名第七）、 2014 年江苏省科学技术二等奖（排名第四）以及 2013 年江苏省科学技术三等奖（排名第四）；获江苏省“科教强卫工程青年医学人才”（ 2017 年），担任中国卫生信息与健康医疗大数据学会信息及应用安全防护学术委员会常务委员、 CHIMA 青委会委员、中华医学放射学分会磁共振专业委员会物理和工程学组委员。累计发表 SCI 文章三十余篇。
blocks.text_en: Jiao Yun, a doctor of engineering jointly trained by Southeast University and the University of Pennsylvania, is the director of the Network Information Center of Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, associate professor of radiology, and master's tutor. He has long been engaged in research in medical informatics and medical imaging. Main research directions: biomedical informatics, medical imaging and artificial intelligence. Currently, he has presided over one National Natural Science Foundation of China general project, one youth project, one Jiangsu Provincial Natural Science Foundation general project, and participated in the National Key Basic Research Program (973 Program) as an academic backbone. He has participated in several National Natural Science Foundation of China general and major research projects. He has won the second prize of the National Science and Technology Progress Award in 2016 (ranked fifth), the first prize of the Science and Technology Progress Award of the Ministry of Education in 2012 (ranked seventh), the second prize of Jiangsu Province Science and Technology Award in 2014 (ranked fourth), and the 2013 Jiangsu Provincial Science and Technology Award. The third prize of Jiangsu Province Science and Technology Award (ranked fourth); won the "Young Medical Talents of Science, Education and Health Project" of Jiangsu Province (2017). He serves as a standing member of the Information and Application Security Protection Academic Committee of the Chinese Society for Health Information and Health Medical Big Data, a member of the CHIMA Youth Committee, and a member of the Physics and Engineering Group of the Magnetic Resonance Professional Committee of the Chinese Society of Medical Radiology. He has published more than 30 SCI articles in total.

blocks.alt_zh: 焦蕴

blocks.text_zh: 研究方向：医学影像大数据及人工智能： 1 、神经影像：利用多模影像、图像分析统计以及机器学习等技术，研究神经精神疾病、代谢性脑病、脑损伤等神经相关疾病的发生、发展以及转归的影像学标记物。 2 、医学影像大数据：建立医学影像数据的标准化处理流程，构建心脑血管以及肿瘤等疾病的影像大数据平台。 3 、影像组学及人工智能：构建多病种临床队列，融合临床指标、影像数据以及遗传学等大数据资源，形成影像组学大数据，应用深度学习等人工智能算法，快速精准完成疾病损伤评估，建立相关疾病早期诊断模型及预后模型，为诊疗提供依据。
blocks.text_en: Research direction: Medical imaging big data and artificial intelligence: 1. Neuroimaging: Use multi-modal imaging, image analysis statistics, machine learning and other technologies to study imaging markers for the occurrence, development and outcome of neurological-related diseases such as neuropsychiatric diseases, metabolic encephalopathy, brain injury and so on. 2. Medical imaging big data: Establish a standardized processing process for medical imaging data, and build an imaging big data platform for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, and tumor diseases. 3. Radiomics and artificial intelligence: Construct a multi-disease clinical cohort, integrate clinical indicators, imaging data, genetics and other big data resources to form radiomics big data, apply artificial intelligence algorithms such as deep learning to quickly and accurately complete disease damage assessment, and establish early diagnosis models and prognosis models for related diseases to provide basis for diagnosis and treatment.

blocks.text_zh: 长期致力于肝硬化门静脉高压诊治新技术研发及转化。共发表SCI论文168篇，影响因子1950.849分，引用6384次，H-index 41（数据更新于2023年6月1日）。主通讯作者论文：Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatol (45.042), J Hepatol (30.083), Gut (31.793), Radiology (29.146),Cell Rep Med (16.988), Ann Surg (13.787), Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol (13.576), Am J Gastroenterol (12.045) 。
blocks.text_en: He has long been committed to the research, development and transformation of new technologies for the diagnosis and treatment of portal hypertension in liver cirrhosis. A total of 168 SCI papers have been published, with an impact factor of 1950.849 points, 6384 citations, and H-index 41 (data updated on June 1, 2023). Main corresponding author papers: Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatol (45.042), J Hepatol (30.083), Gut (31.793), Radiology (29.146), Cell Rep Med (16.988), Ann Surg (13.787), Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol (13.576), Am J Gastroenterol (12.045) .

blocks.text_zh: 牵头制定《中国肝静脉压力梯度临床应用专家共识》 等指南共识3部，荣获亚太肝脏研究学会（APASL）Rising Star Award（中国唯一获奖专家），达摩院“青橙优秀入围奖”，省部级科技进步奖一等奖2项。
blocks.text_en: He took the lead in formulating 3 consensus guidelines including the "China Expert Consensus on the Clinical Application of Hepatic Venous Pressure Gradient" and won the Asia-Pacific Association for the Study of the Liver (APASL) Rising Star Award (the only award-winning expert in China), DAMO Academy's "Green Orange Outstanding Finalist Award", and 2 first prizes in provincial and ministerial level Science and Technology Progress Awards.

title_zh: 陆建

blocks.text_zh: 陆建 ，影像医学与核医学博士，东南大学附属中大医院介入与血管外科主治医师，东南大学至善青年学者、医学院研究生导师，江苏省“333高层次人才培养工程”中青年学术带头人。入选国家高层次人才计划。聚焦放射性粒子支架、介入手术机器人等肿瘤治疗创新领域，研究成果被7 部国内外医学指南推荐。主要研究方向：重大疾病智能诊疗、智能介入器械研发、人工智能临床研究。
blocks.text_en: Lu Jian, Ph.D. in Imaging Medicine and Nuclear Medicine, is an attending physician at the Interventional and Vascular Surgery Department of Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, a best young scholar at Southeast University, a postgraduate tutor at the School of Medicine, and a young and middle-aged academic leader in Jiangsu Province’s “333 High-Level Talent Training Project.” Selected into the National High-Level Talent Program. Focusing on innovative areas of tumor treatment such as radioactive particle stents and interventional surgical robots, the research results have been recommended by 7 domestic and foreign medical guidelines. Main research directions: intelligent diagnosis and treatment of major diseases, research and development of intelligent interventional devices, and clinical research on artificial intelligence.

blocks.text_zh: 主持国家重点研发计划分中心课题、江苏省重点研发计划、国家自然科学基金青年基金等国家级/省部级课题6项。已发表第一/通讯作者（含共同）英文高水平论文20篇，累计影响因子超200分。包括Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatology（封面文章），Journal of Hepatology等医学顶刊。授权/申请专利14项。
blocks.text_en: Hosted 6 national/provincial and ministerial level projects such as the National Key R&D Program Sub-Center Project, Jiangsu Provincial Key R&D Plan, and the National Natural Science Foundation Youth Fund. Has published 20 high-level papers in English as the first/corresponding author (including co-authors), with a cumulative impact factor of over 200 points. Including Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatology (cover article), Journal of Hepatology and other top medical journals. Authorized/applied for 14 patents.

blocks.text_zh: 担任中国抗癌协会肿瘤微创治疗粒子物理专家委员会副主任委员、江苏省医师协会介入医师分会青年委员会副主任委员等学术任职。先后获得北美、欧洲、亚太三大介入放射学会青年学术奖励，以及江苏省科学技术一等奖、江苏省医学新技术引进一等奖等科技奖励。
blocks.text_en: He serves as the deputy director of the Particle Physics Expert Committee for Minimally Invasive Tumor Treatment of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association and the deputy director of the Youth Committee of the Interventional Physician Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Doctors Association. He has successively won the Youth Academic Award from the three major interventional radiology societies in North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, as well as the first prize of Jiangsu Province Science and Technology Award, the first prize of Jiangsu Province Medical New Technology Introduction Award and other scientific and technological awards.

title_zh: 柴人杰

blocks.text_zh: 柴人杰 ，东南大学首席教授、二级教授，东南大学生命健康高等研究院执行院长、生命科学与技术学院副院长；先后入 选 **** ，科技部国家重点研发计划首席科学家，青年千人，国家优青等9项人才计划。主要研究方向：内源性干细胞再生毛 细胞和神经元的多基因协同调控机制研究。
blocks.text_en: Chai Renjie, chief professor and second-level professor of Southeast University, executive dean of the Institute of Advanced Life and Health, and deputy dean of the School of Life Sciences and Technology of Southeast University; has been selected into 9 talent plans including ****, chief scientist of the National Key R&D Program of the Ministry of Science and Technology, Youth Thousand Talents, and National Outstanding Youth. Main research direction: Study on the multi-gene coordinated regulation mechanism of endogenous stem cell regeneration of hair cells and neurons.

blocks.text_zh: 主持教育部 **** 特聘教授，科技部国家重点研发计划首席科学家、中组部青年 **** ，国家优秀青年科学基金，教育部霍英东教育基金会优秀青年教师基金，江苏省杰出青年基金，江苏省双创人才，江苏省双创团队，江苏省333工程人才，江苏省六大人才高峰高层次人才等人才计划；先后作为项目或课题负责人主持科技部国家重点研发计划干细胞及转化研究重点专项，科技部青年973计划，中国科学院“器官重建与制造”A类战略性先导科技专项，军委科技委军事脑科学项目和基础加强计划重点基础研究项目，国家自然科学基金委重点项目1项，重大集成项目1项，面上项目2项，青年项目1项，江苏省重点研发计划社会发展项目，四川省科技计划重点研发项目，江苏省自然科学基金委青年项目等29项课题。近5年以通讯作者在Cell等一流学术期刊上发表三类高质量论文125篇，其中4篇论文被Faculty1000列为推荐论文，1篇论文入选Cell正刊年度最佳论文，13篇论文入选了ESI高被引论文，2篇论文入选热点论文，总他引6000余次，h-index 48；作为主编出版3本专著，申报国家发明专利23项，授权5项国家发明专利1项实用新型专利。
blocks.text_en: In charge of the Ministry of Education **** Distinguished Professor, Chief Scientist of the National Key R&D Program of the Ministry of Science and Technology, Youth of the Organization Department of the Central Committee **** , National Outstanding Youth Science Fund, Ministry of Education Fok Ying-tung Educational Foundation Outstanding Young Teacher Fund, Jiangsu Provincial Outstanding Youth Fund, Jiangsu Provincial Entrepreneurship Talents, Jiangsu Provincial Entrepreneurship Team, Jiangsu Province 333 Engineering Talents, Jiangsu Province Six Talent Peak High-level Talents and other talent plans; has served as a project or subject leader in charge of the Ministry of Science and Technology’s National Key R&D Program Stem Cell and Transformation Research Key Special Project, the Ministry of Science and Technology’s Youth 973 Program, China Science and Technology The college's "Organ Reconstruction and Manufacturing" Class A strategic leading science and technology project, Military Brain Science Project and Foundation Strengthening Plan key basic research project of the Military Commission Science and Technology Commission, 1 National Natural Science Foundation of China key project, 1 major integrated project, 2 general projects, 1 youth project, Jiangsu Provincial Key R&D Plan Social Development Project, Sichuan Provincial Science and Technology Plan Key R&D Project, Jiangsu Provincial Natural Science Foundation of China Youth Project and other 29 projects. In the past five years, he has published 125 high-quality papers in three categories in first-class academic journals such as Cell as the corresponding author. 4 papers were listed as recommended papers by Faculty1000, 1 paper was selected as the best paper of the year in the regular issue of Cell, 13 papers were selected as ESI highly cited papers, 2 papers were selected as hot papers, with a total of more than 6,000 citations, h-index 48; As chief editor, he published 3 monographs, applied for 23 national invention patents, and authorized 5 national invention patents and 1 utility model patent.

blocks.text_zh: 现任中国生物物理学会听觉、言语与交流分会会长；中国生理学会干细胞生理专业委员会副主委，候任主委；中国听力医学发展基金会基础研究专家委员会主委和专家指导委员会常务委员；国际耳内科医师协会执委（Executive board member）；中国医促会耳内科分会副主委听觉基础研究学组组长；中国生物医药产业链创新与转化联盟医疗器械分会会长等任职，研究成果获得了全国创新争先奖、霍英东青年科学奖一等奖，中国青年科技奖，树兰医学青年奖，教育部自然科学一等奖等9项学术奖项项科技奖励。
blocks.text_en: He is currently the President of the Hearing, Speech and Communication Branch of the Chinese Biophysical Society; Vice Chairman and Chairman-elect of the Stem Cell Physiology Committee of the Chinese Physiological Society; Chairman of the Basic Research Expert Committee and Standing Member of the Expert Steering Committee of the China Hearing Medicine Development Foundation; Executive Board Member of the International Association of Otologists (Executive board Member); Vice Chairman of the Otology Branch of the China Association for Medical Promotion and Leader of the Hearing Basic Research Group; Chairman of the Medical Device Branch of the China Biomedicine Industry Chain Innovation and Transformation Alliance. His research results have won 9 academic awards and scientific and technological awards, including the National Innovation Award, the First Prize of the Huo Yingdong Youth Science Award, the China Youth Science and Technology Award, the Shulan Medical Youth Award, and the First Prize of the Natural Science Award of the Ministry of Education.

blocks.text_en: Ge Zheng, doctor of medicine, chief physician, professor, doctoral supervisor, and postdoctoral co-supervisor.

blocks.text_zh: 现任东南大学附属中大医院血液科科主任、东南大学血液病研究所所长，血液病国际合作实验室主任、江苏省研究型医院学会恶性血液病精准诊疗协同转化创新中心主任、 南京中大白血病和MDS中心主任。主要研究方向：血液恶性肿瘤的医工结合、临床转化、人工智能精准诊疗、医疗大数据等。主持美国MMAAP医学基金、国自然基金面上项目4项、省重点研发等科研项目20项，江苏省“333高层次人才工程”中青年领军人才，江苏省医学重点人才等。研究成果发表于Blood、Leukemia等血液病学领域权威期刊。担任中国医师协会血液科医师分会委员、中国中西医结合学会血液学分会委员、中华中医药学会血液病分会委员、中国老年医学会血液学分会委员、江苏省医学会血液学分会副主任委员及白血病学组副组长、江苏省医师协会血液科医师分会副会长、江苏省研究型医院学会白血病和MDS专委会主任委员、江苏省老年医学学会血液学分会副主委等。
blocks.text_en: Currently, he is the director of the Hematology Department of Zhongda Hospital Affiliated to Southeast University, the director of the Institute of Hematology of Southeast University, the director of the International Collaborating Laboratory of Hematology, the director of the Collaborative Transformation Innovation Center for Precision Diagnosis and Treatment of Malignant Hematological Diseases of Jiangsu Research Hospital Association, and the director of the Leukemia and MDS Center of Nanjing Zhongda. Main research directions: medical-engineering integration of hematological malignancies, clinical transformation, artificial intelligence precision diagnosis and treatment, medical big data, etc. He has presided over 4 projects of the MMAAP Medical Fund of the United States, 4 general projects of the National Natural Science Foundation of China, 20 provincial key research and development projects, etc., and is a young and middle-aged leading talent of Jiangsu Province’s “333 High-level Talent Project” and a key medical talent of Jiangsu Province. Research results have been published in authoritative journals in the field of hematology such as Blood and Leukemia. He serves as a member of the Hematology Branch of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association, a member of the Hematology Branch of the Chinese Society of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine, a member of the Hematology Branch of the Chinese Society of Traditional Chinese Medicine, a member of the Hematology Branch of the Chinese Geriatrics Society, the deputy director of the Hematology Branch of the Jiangsu Provincial Medical Association and the deputy leader of the leukemia group, the vice president of the Hematology Physician Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Doctors Association, the chairman of the Leukemia and MDS Special Committee of the Jiangsu Research Hospital Association, and the deputy chairman of the Hematology Branch of the Jiangsu Geriatrics Society.

title_zh: 张冰

blocks.text_zh: 张冰，南京鼓楼医院主任医师、教授、博导，医学博士，Mayo Clinic博士后，中华放射分会杰青；国之名医·优秀风范；江苏省高层次人才。现任南京大学医学院附属鼓楼医院党委副书记、医学影像中心主任；南京大学脑科学研究院副院长；南京大学影像与人工智能研究所所长；中国医师协会放射医师分会委员兼神经影像学组副组长中国医院协会医学影像中心分会副主任委员兼秘书长；江苏省医师协会副会长；江苏省医师协会放射医师分会副会长；江苏省医学会脑卒中分会副主任委员兼脑血管影像学组组长；江苏省医学会放射学分会常委兼质智学组组长；南京医学会放射分会主任委员；江苏省放射诊断质量控制中心南京分中心主任。
blocks.text_en: Zhang Bing, chief physician, professor, doctoral supervisor of Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, MD, postdoctoral fellow at Mayo Clinic, Outstanding Youth of the Chinese Radiology Association; a famous doctor in the country with outstanding style; a high-level talent in Jiangsu Province. Currently, he is deputy secretary of the Party Committee and director of the Medical Imaging Center of the Drum Tower Hospital Affiliated to Nanjing University School of Medicine; deputy director of the Institute of Brain Science of Nanjing University; director of the Institute of Imaging and Artificial Intelligence of Nanjing University; member of the Radiologist Branch of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association and deputy leader of the neuroimaging group; deputy director and secretary-general of the Medical Imaging Center Branch of the Chinese Hospital Association; Jiang Vice President of the Jiangsu Medical Association; Vice President of the Radiologist Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association; Vice Chairman of the Stroke Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association and leader of the Cerebrovascular Imaging Group; Member of the Standing Committee of the Radiology Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association and leader of the Quality Intelligence Group; Chairman of the Radiology Branch of the Nanjing Medical Association; Director of the Nanjing Branch Center of the Radiation Diagnosis Quality Control Center of Jiangsu Province.

blocks.text_zh: 张冰教授是科技部“脑科学”特重大项目的课题负责人，主持国家自然科学基金6项（重点项目2项 ，其中重点1--国家“一带一路”示范工程），获得省级一等奖3项（江苏医学科技一等奖），发表第一／通讯SCI论文110篇：主要成果发表在Radiology、Diabetes Care、Neuroimage 等顶级刊物，其中SCI一区论文33篇 ，发表论文最高影响因子为 29.146。 张冰教授 首创嗅觉、空间导航fMRI方法，授权专利 14项，软件著作权 15 项，国内外标准/共识 5 项。
blocks.text_en: Professor Zhang Bing is the subject leader of the "Brain Science" major project of the Ministry of Science and Technology. He has presided over 6 National Natural Science Foundation projects (2 key projects, including Key 1 - the National "Belt and Road" Demonstration Project), won 3 provincial first prizes (First Prize in Jiangsu Medical Science and Technology), and published 110 first/communication SCI papers: The main results were published in top journals such as Radiology, Diabetes Care, Neuroimage, etc., including 33 SCI area 1 papers, and the highest impact factor of published papers is 29.146. Professor Zhang Bing pioneered olfactory and spatial navigation fMRI methods, and has 14 authorized patents, 15 software copyrights, and 5 domestic and foreign standards/consensus.
