title_zh: 陈玖

blocks.text_zh: 陈玖，医学博士，留美访问学者，教授、研究员、江苏省产业教授，博士生导师，博士后合作导师。南京大学医学影像与人工智能研究所副所长、南信大-鼓医智能影像研究院执行院长、南京应用数学中心-鼓楼医院医学影像联合实验室执行主任。南京鼓楼医院‘高层次引进人才’、江苏省“333高层次人才” 培育对象、南京市“杰出青年基金项目”获得者、教育部学位中心评审专家。中国医院协会医学人工智能专业委员、中国医疗保健国际交流促进会-认知障碍病学分会委员。主持国自然、省部级等10余项。现从事AD疾病谱系（AD、MCI、SCD）的神经影像、人工智能、个体化精准干预。发表第一/通讯作者（含共同）SCI论文50余篇。担任《Journal of Alzheimer’s Disease》等副主编，副主译专著1部。曾获2023年“科创江苏”创新创业大赛二等奖，2022年江苏省新技术引进一等奖等10余项。
blocks.text_en: Chen Jiu, Doctor of Medicine, visiting scholar in the United States, professor, researcher, industrial professor of Jiangsu Province, doctoral supervisor, and postdoctoral cooperative supervisor. Deputy director of the Institute of Medical Imaging and Artificial Intelligence of Nanjing University, executive director of the Nanjing University-Gulou Hospital Intelligent Imaging Research Institute, and executive director of the Nanjing Applied Mathematics Center-Drum Tower Hospital Medical Imaging Joint Laboratory. Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital's "High-level Talent Introduction", Jiangsu Province's "333 High-level Talents" training target, Nanjing City's "Outstanding Youth Fund Project" winner, and the Ministry of Education's Degree Center Review Expert. He is a member of the Medical Artificial Intelligence Professional Committee of the Chinese Hospital Association and a member of the Dementia Disease Branch of the China Association for the Promotion of International Healthcare Exchange. Hosted more than 10 projects at national natural science, provincial and ministerial levels. Currently engaged in neuroimaging, artificial intelligence, and personalized precision intervention for the AD disease spectrum (AD, MCI, SCD). Published more than 50 SCI papers as the first/corresponding author (including co-authors). He serves as deputy editor-in-chief of “Journal of Alzheimer’s Disease” and deputy editor-in-chief of one monograph. He has won the second prize of the 2023 "Science and Technology Jiangsu" Innovation and Entrepreneurship Competition, the first prize of Jiangsu Province New Technology Introduction in 2022, and more than 10 other awards.

title_zh: 陈骏

blocks.alt_zh: 陈骏

blocks.text_zh: 陈骏，医学博士，主任医师，硕导，现任南京鼓楼医院病理科副主任，院生物样本库副主任（主持工作），南京市临床生物样本库质控中心主任。 擅长结合临床、影像、基因检测等，完成肝胆胰肿瘤、肝病、骨和软组织肿瘤、头颈部肿瘤等疑难病理诊断。曾作为执笔人之一参与《肝内胆管癌病理诊断专家共识（2022版）》，《CSCO胆道恶性肿瘤诊疗指南（2020-2024）》，《原发性肝癌规范化病理诊断指南(2015版) 》等撰写工作。 现任国际肝胆胰协会中国分会肝脏肿瘤专委会委员，中国抗癌协会胆道肿瘤专委会 委员，CSCO胆道肿瘤委员会和肝癌委员会委员、中国研究型医院学会病理学专业委员会委员、江苏省医学会病理学分会常委兼消化学组组长，江苏省抗癌协会肿瘤病理分会常委，江苏省医师协会胰腺病分会常委，江苏省医学会肝脏病分会委员。曾获“江苏省六大高峰人才”，“南京市卫生青年人才”，江苏省医学科技奖二等奖，江苏省医学新技术引进奖二等奖等。主持南京市医学科技发展重大项目等课题，近5年作为第一作者或通信作者发表论文18篇，其中SCI收录15篇。
blocks.text_en: Chen Jun, MD, chief physician, master's supervisor, currently serves as deputy director of the Pathology Department of Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital, deputy director (in charge) of the hospital's biobank, and director of the Nanjing Clinical Biobank Quality Control Center. He is good at combining clinical, imaging, genetic testing, etc. to complete difficult pathological diagnosis of hepatobiliary and pancreatic tumors, liver diseases, bone and soft tissue tumors, head and neck tumors, etc. As one of the authors, he participated in the writing of "Expert Consensus on Pathological Diagnosis of Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma (2022 Edition)", "CSCO Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Biliary Malignant Tumors (2020-2024)", and "Standardized Pathological Diagnosis Guidelines for Primary Liver Cancer (2015 Edition)". He is currently a member of the Liver Tumor Special Committee of the China Branch of the International Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Association, a member of the Biliary Tumor Special Committee of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association, a member of the Biliary Tumor Committee and Liver Cancer Committee of CSCO, a member of the Pathology Committee of the Chinese Association of Research Hospitals, a standing member of the Pathology Branch of the Jiangsu Provincial Medical Association and leader of the Gastroenterology Group, a standing member of the Tumor Pathology Branch of the Jiangsu Anti-Cancer Association, a standing committee member of the Pancreatic Disease Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Doctors Association, and a member of the Liver Disease Branch of the Jiangsu Medical Association. He has won the "Six Peak Talents of Jiangsu Province", "Nanjing Young Health Talents", the second prize of Jiangsu Province Medical Science and Technology Award, the second prize of Jiangsu Province Medical New Technology Introduction Award, etc. He presided over major projects for the development of medical science and technology in Nanjing and other topics. In the past five years, he published 18 papers as the first author or corresponding author, 15 of which were included in SCI.

blocks.text_zh: 二、个人简历
blocks.text_en: 2. Personal resume

blocks.text_zh: •里斯本NOVA大学新科学院物理系的终身教授，也任职于LIBPHYS-UNL研究中心
blocks.text_en: •Tenured professor at the Department of Physics, New Academy of Sciences, NOVA University, Lisbon, and also works at the LIBPHYS-UNL Research Center

blocks.text_zh: •里斯本技术大学附属里斯本高等技术学院Instituto Superior Técnico电气和计算机工程博士
blocks.text_en: •Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Instituto Superior Técnico, Affiliated to the Technical University of Lisbon

blocks.text_zh: •博士论文《基于HCI和电生理学的多模态行为生物识别》，提出了新的行为生物识别模式，为该领域的最新技术做出了重要贡献，于2008年获得了葡萄牙国家奖“Futuras Promessas” ISA/Millennium BCP奖，该奖授予物理、电子、信息或生物医学工程领域最佳博士论文
blocks.text_en: •The doctoral thesis "Multimodal behavioral biometrics based on HCI and electrophysiology" proposed a new behavioral biometric model and made an important contribution to the latest technology in the field. In 2008, it won the Portuguese National Award "Futuras Promessas" ISA/Millennium BCP Award, which is awarded to the best doctoral thesis in the field of physics, electronics, information or biomedical engineering.

blocks.text_zh: •IEEE高级会员
blocks.text_en: •IEEE Senior Member

blocks.text_zh: •德国弗劳恩霍夫（Fraunhofer）协会葡萄牙分支前科学委员会主席、高级科学家，重点是硬件设计、信号处理和机器学习应用研究和行业技术转移。弗劳恩霍夫协会是德国也是欧洲最大的应用科学研究机构
blocks.text_en: •Former scientific committee chairman and senior scientist of the Portuguese branch of the German Fraunhofer Association, focusing on hardware design, signal processing and machine learning application research and industry technology transfer. The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft is the largest applied scientific research institution in Germany and Europe.

blocks.text_zh: •葡萄牙Madan Parque高新技术产业孵化院院长（已孵化65家企业）
blocks.text_en: •Director of Madan Parque High-tech Industry Incubator in Portugal (65 companies have been incubated)

blocks.text_zh: •PLUX可穿戴式无线生物信号传感器公司创始人兼总裁，领导该技术创新公司的跨学科团队实现司研究愿景，涵盖微电子、生物信号处理和软件开发。与国家风投公司CAIXA CAPITAL谈判实现投资市场开发计划，将PLUX引入欧洲医疗器械市场
blocks.text_en: •Founder and President of PLUX Wearable Wireless Biosignal Sensors, leading the technology innovation company's interdisciplinary team to achieve the company's research vision, covering microelectronics, biosignal processing and software development. Negotiated with national venture capital company CAIXA CAPITAL to implement the investment market development plan and introduce PLUX to the European medical device market

blocks.text_zh: •2007获美葡发展基金会的资助，前往国际著名科学家Anil Jain指导的密歇根州立大学模式识别和图像处理实验室进行研究
blocks.text_en: •In 2007, he received funding from the US-Portuguese Development Foundation and went to the Pattern Recognition and Image Processing Laboratory of Michigan State University under the guidance of internationally renowned scientist Anil Jain to conduct research.

blocks.text_zh: •2000—2007于塞图巴尔技术学院担任教授，教授人工智能领域的课程
blocks.text_en: •Served as a professor at Setubal Institute of Technology from 2000 to 2007, teaching courses in the field of artificial intelligence
